raw.description:
VERSIONE ITALIANA

CDP Venture Capital – insieme a Mutti, Sipcam Oxon, Crédit Agricole Italia e GELLIFY – lancia Novagria Ventures, il nuovo venture builder dedicato alla filiera agroalimentare italiana.

🎯 Obiettivo:creare fino a 6 nuove startup in 3 anni, mobilitando oltre 45 milioni di euro di investimenti complessivi per colmare i gap di digitalizzazione e sostenibilità della filiera.

🚀Il ruolo: Entrepreneur in Residence (EIR) —Future CTO

Cerchiamo builder tecnologici pronti a diventare CTO & co-founder di una delle prossime startup che nasceranno dentro Novagria Ventures.

Come EIR sarai il motore tech della futura venture.
Partirai da una value proposition già pre-validata dal team GELLIFY e avrai la responsabilità di:

Product & Tech Ownership

  • Disegnare l’architettura della soluzione (anche no-code/low-code nelle fasi iniziali)
  • Coordinare lo sviluppo dell’MVP con designer e developer
  • Validare use case, feature, prototipi e metriche
  • Guidare la tech roadmap verso product-market fit

Market Validation & Growth

  • Testare MVP e iterare rapidamente sul prodotto
  • Supportare go-to-market, acquisire early users e sviluppare primi PoC
  • Identificare le metriche chiave per PMF

Fundraising & Leadership

  • Contribuire alla preparazione del round seed
  • Presentare la soluzione a investitori e partner
  • Costruire il futuro team tech (engineering, data, AI)

Obiettivo finale: diventare CTO & co-founder della startup dopo lo spin-off.

💡Chi cerchiamo

Un/una imprenditore·trice con anima da builder e forte competenza tecnologica.

Must have

  • 5–10 anni in: Product, Engineering, Tech Leadership, Startup, Venture Building
  • Provata esperienza con:
    • Architetture Full stack: sviluppo end-to-end di applicazioni web (frontend + backend + DB + deploy) su stack tecnologico React/Node.js con almeno un prodotto portato in produzione.
    • Architetture cloud: progettazione e sviluppo di sistemi scalabili, affidabili e sicuri da ambienti Cloud (microservizi / API-first).
    • Data & integrazione: progettazione di basi dati (SQL + NoSQL), data pipeline di base, integrazione via API.
    • Security & privacy: principi di sicurezza applicativa, gestione identità e accessi.
    • DevOps / Delivery: CI/CD, containerizzazione (es. Docker), monitoring, logging.
  • Esperienza pratica con MVP digitali, prototipazione e validazione rapida
  • Ottima capacità di tradurre problemi complessi in soluzioni scalabili
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, ownership, velocità, execution

Nice to have

  • Esperienza da founder o first-hire in startup early stage
  • Background in: AI/ML, SaaS, IoT, piattaforme B2B, cloud architecture
  • Interesse per agritech, foodtech, supply chain, sustainability

💰 Cosa offriamo

  • Retribuzione durante il periodo di lavoro all’interno di Novagria
  • Equity nella startup che sarà scorporata
  • Lavoro full-remote
  • Opportunità concreta di diventare CTO e co-founder di una startup backed da corporate top-tier

🌍Perché unirti a Novagria Ventures

  • Costruisci startup con un impatto reale sulla filiera agroalimentare italiana grazie al supporto dei partner CDP Venture Capital, GELLIFY, Mutti, Sipcam Oxon e Crédit Agricole Italia
  • Lavori in Le Village by CA Parma, cuore dell’innovazione agri-food
  • Impari un metodo di venture building replicabile e scalabile
  • Cresci come imprenditore, con supporto finanziario, operativo e strategico

🎬Come candidarti

Crediamo che i futuri founder si riconoscano dal modo in cui pensano.

Oltre al CV / LinkedIn, inviaci un breve video Loom (max 1 minuto) in cui racconti:

  • Quali problemi tech ti appassionano oggi e perché
  • Un prodotto o MVP che hai costruito o validato
  • Perché vuoi diventare CTO/co-founder con Novagria adesso

Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle leggi 903/77 e 125/91 e D.Lgs 198/2006

ENGLISH VERSION

CDP Venture Capital, Mutti, Sipcam Oxon, Crédit Agricole Italia and GELLIFY have just launched Novagria Ventures, the new venture builder dedicated to the Italian agrifood value chain.

🎯 Goal: build up to 6 new startups in 3 years, mobilizing over €45M in total investments to bridge the digitalization and sustainability gaps across the supply chain.

🚀 The Role: Entrepreneur in Residence (EIR) — Future CTO

We are looking for technology builders ready to become CTO & co-founder of one of the next startups created within Novagria Ventures.

As an EIR, you will be the tech engine of a future venture.
You will start from a value proposition already pre-validated by the GELLIFY team, and you will be responsible for:

Product & Tech Ownership

  • Design the solution architecture (including no-code/low-code approaches in early stages)
  • Coordinate MVP development with designers and developers
  • Validate use cases, features, prototypes, and metrics
  • Drive the tech roadmap toward product–market fit

Market Validation & Growth

  • Test the MVP and iterate rapidly on the product
  • Support go-to-market activities, onboard early users, and develop initial PoCs
  • Identify the key metrics required for PMF

Fundraising & Leadership

  • Contribute to the preparation of the seed round
  • Present the solution to investors and strategic partners
  • Build the future tech team (engineering, data, AI)

🎯 Ultimate goal: become CTO & co-founder of the startup after the spin-off.

💡 Who We’re Looking For

An entrepreneurial builder with strong technological expertise.

Must Have

5–10 years of experience in Product, Engineering, Tech Leadership, Startup or Venture Building roles.

Proven experience with:

  • Full-Stack Architectures: end-to-end development of web applications (frontend + backend + DB + deployment) using React/Node.js, with at least one product shipped to production.
  • Cloud Architectures: designing and developing scalable, reliable, and secure cloud-based systems (microservices / API-first).
  • Data & Integration: SQL + NoSQL database design, basic data pipelines, API integrations.
  • Security & Privacy: application security principles, identity and access management.
  • DevOps / Delivery: CI/CD, containerization (e.g., Docker), monitoring, logging.
  • Hands-on experience with MVPs, prototyping, and rapid validation
  • Excellent ability to translate complex problems into scalable solutions
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, ownership, speed, execution

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience as a founder or first-hire in an early-stage startup
  • Background in AI/ML, SaaS, IoT, B2B platforms, cloud architecture
  • Interest in agritech, foodtech, supply chain, sustainability

💰 What We Offer

  • Compensation during your residency within Novagria
  • Equity in the spin-off startup
  • Full-remote work option
  • A concrete opportunity to become CTO & co-founder of a startup backed by top-tier corporate players

🌍 Why Join Novagria Ventures

  • Build startups with real impact on the Italian agrifood supply chain, supported by CDP Venture Capital, GELLIFY, Mutti, Sipcam Oxon, and Crédit Agricole Italia
  • Work from Le Village by CA Parma, a leading hub for agrifood innovation
  • Learn a replicable, scalable venture-building method
  • Grow as an entrepreneur with strategic, operational, and financial support

🎬 How to Apply

We believe future founders reveal themselves through how they think.

Along with your CV / LinkedIn profile, send us a short Loom video (max 1 minute) explaining:

  • Which tech problems excite you today—and why
  • A product or MVP you built or validated
  • Why you want to become a CTO/co-founder with Novagria right now

This job advertisement is open to candidates of all genders, in accordance with Laws 903/77 and 125/91 and Legislative Decree 198/2006

raw.excerpt: About Homeaglow Homeaglow’s mission is to create happy homes.
raw.description:
About Homeaglow

Homeaglow’s mission is to create happy homes. We delight customers and empower cleaning professionals by building the leading platform for home services. Today, we are the world’s largest marketplace for home cleanings. Tomorrow, we’ll be the world’s leading platform for all home services.

We are transforming the home services industry by making high-quality home cleanings more accessible, affordable, and transparent for everyone. We connect customers with independent, background-checked cleaning professionals through a modern technology platform that simplifies booking, pricing, and communication.

Why Join Homeaglow?

A True Startup Environment

Join a high-growth, entrepreneurial company where speed, ownership, and impact define the culture.

Sustained, Profitable Growth

Double-digit year-over-year growth at a nine-figure revenue scale, while serving less than 0.5% of U.S. households — with significant runway ahead.

Strong Unit Economics

Disciplined focus on LTV/CAC and long-term value creation drives sustainable expansion.

Bootstrapped & Focused

No liquidation preferences. No distracting investor pressure. Just stable priorities and long-term thinking.

Real Economic Impact

Over 100,000 cleaning professionals have earned $250M+ through our platform. Average earnings are ~50% higher than traditional hotel housekeeping roles.

Vertical Expansion Strategy

Significant opportunity to expand into adjacent services and deepen customer relationships.

Building a World-Class Team

Be part of a professional, high-caliber team scaling a category-defining platform.

About the Role

Homeaglow is looking for a Director of Finance who thinks like an operator and acts like a strategist. This is not a role for someone who lives in variance reports. We want someone who uses financial data as a lens to understand our business, identify leverage points, and help leadership make better decisions faster.

You will be a key voice in the room when we are deciding where to invest, what to cut, how to price, and how to grow. You will own the financial narrative of the company — not just the numbers behind it.

What You’ll Do

Strategic Financial Leadership

  • Partner directly with the leadership team to translate financial data into strategic recommendations — pricing, unit economics, capital allocation, and growth bets.
  • Build and maintain financial models that drive decision-making, not just report history. Your models should answer “what should we do” as much as “what happened.”
  • Identify inflection points in the business before they show up in the income statement — through cohort analysis, leading indicators, and operational metrics.
  • Evaluate new initiatives, partnerships, and investments with rigorous but fast financial analysis. Be the person who pressure-tests ideas without killing momentum.
  • Develop a deep understanding of our unit economics (CAC, LTV, RNR, contribution margin) and communicate them clearly to inform resource allocation and prioritization.

Finance & Accounting Oversight

  • Lead and develop the Finance and Accounting teams, setting high standards for accuracy, timeliness, and analytical rigor.
  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process — but orient your team toward forward-looking insight, not just backward-looking reconciliation.
  • Ensure financial reporting is clean, consistent, and audit-ready. Establish controls and processes that scale with the business.
  • Manage cash flow, runway, and treasury with a clear-eyed view of the company’s financial position at all times.
  • Oversee tax strategy and compliance, working with external advisors as needed.

Planning & Forecasting

  • Drive the annual planning process — not as an exercise in spreadsheet management, but as a tool for aligning the company on priorities and trade-offs.
  • Maintain a rolling forecast that reflects real business dynamics, not just last year plus a growth rate.
  • Build scenario models that help leadership understand the financial implications of different strategic paths.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of progressive finance experience, with meaningful time in FP&A, investment banking, management consulting, or a high-growth startup.
  • Demonstrated experience influencing business strategy with financial analysis — not just building models, but changing decisions.
  • Strong command of unit economics, cohort modeling, and the financial drivers of marketplace or subscription businesses.
  • Exceptional communicator who can translate complex financial concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-finance stakeholders.
  • Prior experience managing a finance or accounting team.
  • High comfort with ambiguity. You don’t need perfect data to form a useful point of view.
  • Low ego, high standards. You’d rather be right than look smart.

Who Thrives Here

This role is ideal for a finance leader who is energized by the question “what does this mean for the business?” — not “how do we explain the variance?” You should be as comfortable in a strategic planning meeting as you are reviewing a reconciliation. You move fast, communicate crisply, and treat financial analysis as a means to an end: building a better business.

This role is not for someone looking to run a tightly scoped accounting function or whose primary output is monthly close packages. We have operational finance needs and you will own them — but that is the floor, not the ceiling.

Perks and Benefits

  • Health insurance fully covered by the company.
  • Parental leave.
  • Flexible / unlimited PTO policy.
  • Cleaning membership perk – Free Homeaglow membership with complimentary cleanings. Enjoy up to 2x cleanings a month, capped at $200 USD per cleaning.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Homeaglow is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

Accommodations

We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout our hiring process. Please let us know if you require any adjustments.

Pay Transparency

Compensation ranges are available upon request. Final offers are based on experience, skills, and location in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws.

raw.title: Senior Staff Accountant
raw.excerpt: Who We AreScratch Financial (“Scratch”) is a late stage venture-backed financial technology business based in Pasadena, California.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Scratch Financial (“Scratch”) is a late stage venture-backed financial technology business based in Pasadena, California. At Scratch, everything starts and ends with our mission: being the payment partner of choice for veterinary practices and helping pet parents access the care their animals need without financial barriers. Driven by our award-winning technology, Scratch has become the fastest growing financing provider in veterinary care, with a partner network of 17,000+ practices across the U.S. and Canada.

Scratch has 2 main products:

  1. Scratch Pay: Point-of-sale lending, including a BNPL offering and longer-term payment plans
  2. Scratch Checkout: Payment processing that is integrated with the veterinary practice management software

We are a company built on the foundation of transforming the way pet healthcare payments are done, and we are looking for innovators who share our commitment to shaping the future of veterinary care financing. If putting compassion first, helping tell the story of groundbreaking products and continuously learning & refining to achieve exceptional outcomes sounds like you, then we encourage you to apply.

Position Overview

Senior Staff Accountant to assist primarily in daily, weekly and monthly accounting and reconciliation for our payments processing side of the business and is a core partner to the Director of Accounting/Controller in the monthly close. The position will also support all monthly close tasks and reconciliations across the entire business, including relating to our loan portfolio and other revenue streams.

What You'll Do

  • Pull and analyze transactions from our BigQuery database, transforming it in Google Sheets/Excel, and importing detailed and summarized entries into QuickBooks Online for the payments processing business.
  • Calculate, run, and analyze monthly billing for the payments processing business including ensuring and tracking AR related to billing, ensuring payments from our customers are drafted timely and entering payments for AR into QuickBooks Online timely for proper review and analysis.
  • Reconcile payments processing activity by clinic and clinic consolidators on a monthly basis to ensure data integrity, analyzing discrepancies and working with the Product and Revenue Teams to resolve differences in a timely manner.
  • Own a defined set of month end close tasks against the month end close calendar including journal entries, accruals, and other required schedules.
  • Support month end close tasks for the lending business, including journal entries and account reconciliations as needed and serving as a backup for daily and monthly lending reporting as needed.
  • Assist in preparing schedules for the annual audit and other various financial audits including searching for and providing support requested by the auditors for testing.
  • Other special projects as assigned by the Director of Accounting/Controller.

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.
  • Working knowledge of US GAAP and accrual accounting.
  • Hands-on experience with month-end close and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and working with large transaction files.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, especially Google Sheets, Docs and Drive.
  • High attention to detail

Nice to Have

  • Experience with QuickBooks Online (Advanced preferred), including bulk journal entry and transaction imports through native or third-party import tools.
  • Ability to write and run queries in Google BigQuery (or similar SQL tools) to pull, join, and analyze transaction data.
  • Experience in payments, merchant services, fintech, or lending.
  • Exposure to multi-currency accounting or Canadian operations.
  • Experience with a loan servicing platform such as LoanPro.
  • Experience in Stripe or related platforms.
  • CPA (or progress toward it)

What You Can Expect From Our Process

While these steps may vary slightly from role to role, we aim for a well-rounded interview approach for all involved.

  1. A quick chat with People Ops (HR): To ensure logistics and team fit make sense from both sides.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview: To dive deeper into your experience, fit for the role, and answer any questions you have about the team.
  3. Panel Style Interview/Presentation or Live Coding (Tech roles): A practical exercise to showcase your skills and approach with a cross-functional panel.
  4. Executive-Level Interviews & Reference Checks: A chance for you to meet our leaders, discuss big-picture alignment, and introduce us to your professional references.
  5. In-Person Connection: We include an in-person visit at our Pasadena HQ, either as a final interview step or during your first week of onboarding, so we can connect face-to-face right from the start!

Why You'll Love Working Here

Competitive base salary ranging from $120,000 - $130,000 + equity

While Scratch supports remote work for most roles, we believe the secret sauce to our team culture is meaningful connection and close collaboration. For those nearby or visiting, our Pasadena office is fully open and stocked with snacks and drinks for hybrid work. We also bring the whole company together each year for Hub Day, our annual onsite where everyone gathers in person to bond, align, and celebrate our wins together!

Alongside our collaborative team environment, we offer unlimited PTO, covered healthcare, flex benefits, 401(k) matching, cell plan reimbursement, monthly recognition opportunities, continuous learning resources, an equity retention program, and generous parental leave!

How to Apply

Ready to join our team? To apply, please visit our Scratch Careers Page. Be sure to:

  1. Submit your resume.
  2. Answer the custom questions provided.
  3. Feel free to add any additional information or documents you believe are relevant to your application.

We look forward to reviewing your application!

*Our team will ONLY contact you from the domain @scratchpay.com or @ats.rippling.com

Our Commitment

We’re innovators who care deeply about the lives of pets, their owners, and veterinary professionals. We believe diversity strengthens our team and drives better solutions.

Scratch is committed to diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Scratch considers qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

raw.description:
What will you get to do in this Senior Account Executive, Mid-Market UKI role?

As a Senior Account Executive at HubSpot, you will leverage outbound selling strategies to identify and close new business opportunities. You will play a crucial role in helping prospects enhance their operations and growth using the HubSpot software.

  • You employoutbound sales methodologies including prospecting, cold calling, and networking to reach potential clients and build a robust pipeline.
  • You collaborate effectively with Business Development Representatives to research prospects and develop targeted outreach strategies.
  • You deliver compelling online demos of the HubSpot software to showcase its features and successfully communicate the HubSpot value proposition.
  • You drive the entire sales process from initial contact to closing, ensuring a seamless onboarding experience for new clients.
  • You target and engage primarily with small and mid-sized businesses, understanding their unique needs and positioning HubSpot solutions for maximum impact.
  • You maintain accurate records of sales activities and customer interactions in the HubSpot CRM system.

This role offers flexible work arrangements, allowing you to choose your preferred work style—whether in-office, hybrid, or fully remote within the United Kingdom. For more insights into our flexible work culture and hybrid company model, we invite you to read: "The Future of Work at HubSpot: How We're Building a Hybrid Company."

Qualifications:

  • Proven track record in outbound sales with a focus on closing.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage and build relationships with a variety of clients.
  • Proficient in conducting virtual sales presentations and demonstrating software solutions.
  • Self-motivated with excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience working within SaaS environments and a good understanding of the small to mid-sized business market is a plus.

Responsibilities of a Senior Account Executive, Mid-Market UKI

In this dynamic role, you will:

  • Swiftly diagnose the challenges faced by prospective customers and tailor the most effective inbound marketing solutions to meet their business needs.
  • Consistently achieve, and strive to exceed, sales targets through successful new business closures.
  • Cultivate strong relationships with highly qualified prospects in small to mid-sized companies, turning opportunities into long-term partnerships.
  • Foster connections with potential clients and internal stakeholders to drive business growth and enhance customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with HubSpot’s marketing and technology teams to refine sales strategies in line with the introduction of new products and features.
  • Contribute to HubSpot’s mission by bringing your unique perspectives, innovative ideas, and expertise to help shape the future of our company.

Role Requirements:

  • Applicants must be located in the United Kingdom to qualify for remote opportunities.
  • Possess 3+ years of experience in full closing, 360 sales roles ideally in Tech/SaaS.
  • Demonstrated fluency in English.
  • Exceptional consultative selling and closing abilities.
  • Proven skills in accurate forecasting and pipeline management.
  • A consistent record of high performance, such as exceeding quotas or achieving President's Club status.
  • A strong focus on achieving goals with a strategic approach.

Who Thrives in This Role?

Successful Senior Account Executives typically exhibit:

  • Excellent communication, time management, and adaptability skills to excel in a remote and hybrid setting.
  • Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth, "scale-up" environments.
  • A passion for driving business growth and a keen interest in the tech industry.
  • A blend of humility and enthusiasm in their professional endeavours.
  • Join HubSpot and become part of a dynamic team dedicated to driving client success and business growth.

What are some of the benefits of working at HubSpot?

  • Generous remuneration and stock units
  • Interactive employee training and onboarding
  • An education allowance up to £3,650 per annum
  • Pension
  • Health Insurance
  • Life Assurance (x4 times your annual salary)
  • Amazing colleagues to learn from and enjoy company social outings, parties, and events

Interested in learning more about our Remote Program? Learn more here!

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

Explore more:

  • HubSpot Careers
  • Life at HubSpot on Instagram

Are you a well-rounded Animator who is passionate about working on upcoming film, television and advertising projects?The Embassy is hiring an Animator to join their team!

About The Embassy

The Embassy is a Canadian, Oscar-nominated production house, specializing in live-action production, post-production, and animation for feature films, television, and commercials. We are an independent creative studio with expertise in visual effects and production. Located in the heart of Vancouver’s Digital District, we work with global production companies, agencies and brands in film, television and advertising.

Award-Winning

We have crafted award-winning visual effects for the world’s most recognized brands and film franchises. Our work has received accolades including Oscar nominations and numerous VES, Cannes, D&AD, Clio & ADCC awards.

About You

The Animator will be responsible for creating animated elements, shots, and sequences under the guidance of the Lead Animator and VFX Supervisors. This role involves delivering both keyframe animation and animation utilizing motion capture data, to be integrated into live-action feature films, TV Series or commercials.

Your Role

  • Responsible for assignments including animation tests, shots, and final render
  • Occasionally tasked with previs and layout requirements, ensuring delivery on time and to an acceptable standard
  • Expected to produce a high volume of shots with multiple iterations, maintaining both speed and accuracy
  • Conduct initial self-directed troubleshooting and quality control of work, escalating issues to leads and supervisors as needed
  • Capable of working independently as well as collaborating effectively within a team
  • Fully engage to ensure the highest quality of animation is achieved within the project schedule

Your Qualifications

  • 3+ years of industry experience in live-action commercials, film, or television
  • Strong understanding of physical motion, weight, balance, timing, and form
  • Proficiency in platforms such as Blender and Maya
  • Familiarity with rigging, camera work, and scene layout
  • Ability to take direction positively, work well within a team and thrive under the pressure of tight deadlines
  • Strong understanding of multiple aspects of the VFX pipeline
  • Strong written and verbal English language skills
  • Excellent in proactive problem-solving and finding solutions
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment remotely
  • The ability to efficiently organize and prioritize work across multiple areas

We Offer

  • Strong emphasis on work-life balance with standard working hours of 9am–5pm
  • Paid lunch break
  • Paid Sick days from day one
  • Group benefits for eligible employees
  • Employee Assistance Program for eligible employees
  • Paid Float Days for eligible employees
  • Summer and Christmas parties
  • Centrally located office space
  • Fully stocked kitchen with complimentary snacks and drinks
  • Friday Happy Hour - join the team every Friday at 4pm for a casual wind-down chat over drinks

The Embassy Visual Effects Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer.

Please note: At this time, we are only accepting applications from those who are legally eligible to work in Canada and are currently BC residents or willing to establish BC residency for the duration of the contract.

As a leading provider of AI-powered extended managed detection and response (MXDR) services, Ontinue is on a mission to be the most trusted, 24/7, always-on security partner that empowers customers to embrace the future by using AI to operate more strategically, at scale, and with less risk. We believe that the combination of AI and human expertise is essential for delivering effective managed security that is tailored to a customer’s unique environment, operational constraints, and risks.

Our MXDR service combines powerful proprietary AI with a one-of-a-kind collaboration model to continuously build a deep understanding of our customers’ environments, informing how we prevent, detect, and respond to threats. Our unrivaled Microsoft expertise allows customers to achieve these outcomes with the Microsoft Security tools they already own. The result is highly localized managed protection that empowers security teams to be faster, smarter, and more cost efficient than ever before.

Continuous protection. Always-on prevention Services. Nonstop SecOps. That’s Ontinue.

At Ontinue, we’re building an environment where you can thrive. We encourage collaboration and cross-functional learning. We’re more than just a steppingstone on your resume. We’re a company where you can thrive and grow.

As a Associate Cyber Defender, you are at the forefront of our defenses, being first to react and respond to new threats. You work on the full stack for detection and response, ranging from identity over endpoint to the network, including cloud. Your curiosity drives you to constantly learn and grow from responding to a variety of attacks. Your diligence and attention to detail enable you to spot attacks accurately and deliver topmost quality.

Next to direct operations work, you contribute to projects interfacing with other internal teams as well as customers to constantly move our service forward.

Must haves:

  • Detect and respond to threats in our Cyber Defense Center (SOC) by performing end-to-end investigations

  • Reliable character, self-starter, hungry to do more, good communication and interpersonal skills

What we offer:

Come as you are! We search for amazing people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. Ontinue welcomes and encourages diversity in the workplace regardless of race, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

raw.title: Product Launch Manager
raw.excerpt: ABOUT onXWe’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors.
raw.description:
ABOUT onX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

onX is seeking a Product Launch Manager to help bring an exciting new connected product experience to market, designed to work seamlessly with the onX Hunt app and create new possibilities for our customers.

This role will play a key part in bringing that experience to life, independently driving launch execution from beta through broader availability. You'll coordinate across engineering, operations, marketing, and customer experience, keeping timelines, dependencies, and teams aligned as we navigate the complexities of a new product launch.

Working closely with leadership, you'll translate launch plans into coordinated action, proactively identifying risks, navigating day-to-day challenges, and helping teams stay focused on shared milestones. As onX expands into new product experiences, you'll have the opportunity to apply lessons learned, improve launch processes, and help establish a strong foundation for future launches.

This role reports to the Director of Connected Devices.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

  • Own and manage the end-to-end launch timeline, milestones, and deliverables across hardware, software, marketing, operations, and customer experience.
  • Coordinate launch activities from beta through broader availability, ensuring key milestones and dependencies are aligned across teams.
  • Partner with manufacturing partners to coordinate production timelines and ensure internal teams are prepared for critical launch milestones.
  • Proactively identify, track, and manage cross-functional dependencies, risks, and potential roadblocks to keep launch activities on track.
  • Drive day-to-day launch execution, ensuring teams have clear ownership, priorities, and accountability for their deliverables.
  • Monitor launch readiness and progress, identifying gaps and working with cross-functional partners to address issues before they impact timelines.
  • Facilitate clear, consistent communication across stakeholders, providing visibility into launch status, key decisions, risks, and upcoming milestones.
  • Navigate day-to-day execution challenges independently, escalating complex trade-offs or competing priorities that require broader leadership alignment.
  • Demonstrate onX's Company Values by fostering accountability, building trust across cross-functional teams, and proactively addressing challenges to keep launch activities moving forward.
  • Look for opportunities to embed AI as a repeatable co-pilot in daily workflows, integrating experimentation into real work and refining its use with sound judgment and validation.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in program management, project management, product launches, or related work involving complex, cross-functional initiatives.
    • Experience with physical or hardware products is required.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently coordinate multiple workstreams, manage competing deadlines, and drive projects toward successful completion.
  • Strong project management skills, including timeline development, milestone tracking, dependency management, and risk mitigation.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, building alignment, and driving accountability without direct authority.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate challenges, work through day-to-day obstacles, and recognize when issues require escalation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate progress, risks, and priorities to diverse stakeholders.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, adapt to evolving priorities, and maintain momentum in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to thoughtfully explore and apply AI tools to streamline launch planning, track dependencies, improve stakeholder communication, and enhance day-to-day execution, while exercising sound judgment and validating outputs.
  • A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX’s Company Values.
  • Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.
  • Ability to travel up to quarterly for multiple days to a corporate office or other onX strategic location, such as a Basecamp.

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

  • Experience supporting the launch of a new physical product or product category, particularly from beta through commercial availability.
  • Experience with devices or products that integrate hardware, software, and subscription or membership services.
  • Experience coordinating production schedules, launch milestones, and dependencies with overseas manufacturing partners.

THE ONX EXPERIENCE

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX is a distributed company with employees across the U.S. We have physical offices in Bozeman and Missoula, MT, along with virtual workforce “Basecamps” in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. Basecamps are not physical offices; they are geographic hubs made up of remote employees who live within a 60-mile radius of the city center, creating opportunities for local connection and collaboration.

We have a strong preference for hiring candidates who live near one of our offices or within a Basecamp, and we prioritize candidates in these locations first. Candidates who live elsewhere in the U.S. may still be considered, provided they reside in a state where onX is currently able to employ team members.

At this time, we are NOT able to employ individuals whose primary work location is in: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia (D.C.), Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Kansas, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, applicants can expect to make between $120,000 and $150,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based upon experience, skills, certifications, education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and an annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.

WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU

  • Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan
  • Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non-birthing parents
  • 401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3-5%
  • Company-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks
  • Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle
  • Flexible time away package that includes PTO, STO, VTO, and paid holidays

PERFORMANCE ESSENTIALS

In this role, success is driven by cognitive abilities such as concentration and problem-solving, essential for our computer-centric tasks. onX will explore reasonable accommodations to ensure that individuals with diverse abilities can fully engage in and contribute to the essential physical and mental functions of the job. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact us at .

Position open until filled.

At onX, we believe that unique perspectives make us stronger. By bringing together people with different experiences, ideas, and viewpoints, we fuel innovation and move closer to our mission of awakening the adventurer in everyone. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fairness not only in hiring, but also in development, compensation, and promotion. Our goal is to build an inclusive community where every team member can show up authentically and thrive. Together, we win as one team. Come join us!

onX Maps will never ask for credit card or SSN details during the initial application process. For your digital safety, apply only through our legitimate website at onXmaps.com or directly via our LinkedIn page.

onX does not sell any Personal Information, but we may transfer employment related records to our service providers or third parties that provide business services to onX or as required by law. For more information, see our Privacy Policy.

As part of our interview process, your conversation may be recorded for documentation purposes to allow interviewers to focus fully on the discussion. Recordings are confidential and accessible only to authorized personnel. Please note, onX respects all applicable laws regarding recording consent, and you will have an opportunity to opt-out if preferred.

Senior Account Executive, Expansion

This Role will Support the UKI Market & Candidates can be based in Ireland or the United Kingdom - (Office, Flex or Remote)

This is a hunter role with deep product specialisation serving HubSpot’s mid-market segment. You build your own pipeline by prospecting aggressively into HubSpot's existing customer base, and you run deals from end to end — from first outreach through close — for our specialized offerings: Service Hub, Customer Agent, and Revenue Hub.

You'll run both fast paced and complex, strategic sales cycles with service leaders, CS teams, IT, and business stakeholders, pairing a relentless prospecting motion with the technical fluency to make the platform real for technical and business buyers alike. Specialization is a P0 for HubSpot in 2026: we're building, experimenting, and pivoting fast, so this role is best for sellers who own their outcomes and thrive in change.

What you'll do

  • Build your own pipeline. Self-source the majority of your opportunities through multi-channel outbound prospecting into the install base, using tools like IB Workspace, Claude & LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
  • Own the full cycle and your number. Carry an individual quota and run every deal from prospecting through close.
  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles. Sell into leaders across, CS, IT, and business buyers in Corporate-sized organizations.
  • Own discovery and solutioning. Uncover needs, build the business case, and drive consensus across the buying committee.
  • Own the technical sale end to end. Run your own discovery, demos, and solution design. You're the one who makes the platform real for both technical and business buyers.
  • Translate technical value. Connect tech (APIs, integrations, platform capabilities) to business outcomes for technical and executive audiences across Service Hub, Customer Agent, and Revenue Hub.
  • Collaborate across internal customer-facing teams. Growth Account Executives, Customer Success, Solutions Engineers, and other partners — to move deals forward and deliver a connected customer experience.
  • Contribute to team learning. Share wins, losses, and what's working in prospecting.

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of full-cycle SaaS sales with consistent quota attainment as an individual contributor.
  • Proven, self-sourced pipeline generation. A track record of building your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, not relying on inbound or overlay support.
  • Top producer in your current role, with a demonstrated record of closing and expanding business in complex environments.
  • Strong technical aptitude and natural curiosity. Drawn to complexity, quick to ramp, and able to translate what you learn into conversations that land at any level.
  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations that connect Service Hub, Customer Agent, and Revenue Hub capabilities to each stakeholder's specific goals and pains.
  • Multi-stakeholder cycle management across service, CS, IT, and business buyers, including C-level.
  • Exceptional consultative and value-based selling with the discipline to build comprehensive business cases.
  • Growth mindset and comfort with change in a fast-evolving, build-as-you-go environment.
  • Repeatable, metrics-driven process and sharp organizational skills.

The ideal candidate

  • Hunter first who builds pipeline relentlessly and can navigate technical conversations.
  • Owns their number — measures success by individual attainment, not shared credit.
  • Team Seller who is comfortable with operating within a sales cycle involves multiple stakeholders internally and externally.
  • Change-agent who thrives where they can test, build, and iterate quickly.
  • Expansion hunter who finds whitespace and drives adoption inside existing accounts.

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Integrated DNA Technologies (IDT), one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Our team at Integrated DNA Technologies (IDT), is united by a commitment to collaboration and scientific excellence, building on a strong foundation of innovation, expertise, and reliability. Guided by our vision to help researchers rapidly move from the lab to life-changing advances, we work closely with global partners to accelerate progress and genomics breakthroughs across fields like cancer, infectious disease, rare genetic disorders, and more. At IDT, you’ll be part of a culture rooted in continuous learning and improvement—where your growth fuels our mission to accelerate the pace of genomics and helps shape a healthier, brighter future for all.


Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.


The Product Manager identifies and commercializes future growth opportunities through market intelligence, business analytics, innovation scouting, and external partnerships. Reporting to the Sr. Commercial Product Manager Synthetic Biology, this role owns market and competitive intelligence, translates market and technology trends into actionable growth strategies, evaluates emerging technologies and partners, and drives prioritized opportunities from identification through business case development, validation, and commercialization. The role requires strong analytical and commercial judgment, the ability to synthesize ambiguous external signals into clear recommendations, and the ability to build consensus with minimal guidance.

This position reports to the Senior Commercial Product Manager and is part of the Product Management team and will be fully remote.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to

  • Lead market intelligence and competitive analysis to identify customer needs, competitive threats, market opportunities, and inform portfolio strategy.
  • Drive business analytics and market trend assessments, building financial models to quantify growth opportunities, investment requirements, and ROI.
  • Scout emerging technologies and strategic partners, evaluating fit and leading early-stage partnership development through pilot design and commercialization planning.
  • Assess new technologies and integration opportunities to expand the portfolio, shaping long-term growth roadmaps and executive recommendations.
  • Influence cross-functional decision-making by synthesizing data-driven insights, building alignment, and facilitating collaboration across Commercial, Product, Marketing, Operations, and R&D.

The essential requirements of the job include

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in product management, growth strategy, market/competitive intelligence, business analytics, corporate/business development, strategic partnerships, consulting, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated success independently owning intelligence, analytics, or growth workstreams, or leading cross-functional strategic initiatives and hands-on experience with analytics and market-intelligence tools and methods
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, and business judgment capabilities.
  • Ability to influence without formal authority and build consensus.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time

IDT, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.

At IDT we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement in which you can work remotely from your home. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for IDT can provide.


The salary range OR the hourly range for this role is $120,000-$150,000. This is the range that we in good faith believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future.

This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay.

We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.



Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

raw.excerpt: About us:At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours.
raw.description:
About us:

At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company.

Position Overview:

The Salesforce Developer owns Fullbay’s Salesforce platform end to end, from day-to-day administration and configuration through custom Apex and Lightning Web Component development. This role determines when a requirement calls for declarative configuration and when it calls for code, then builds the solution directly. Working closely with Sales, Finance, and Operations stakeholders across Sales Cloud, Einstein AI, and the Nue CPQ platform and its integrations with QuickBooks and Stripe, the Salesforce Developer is accountable for both the daily health of the platform and its long-term technical architecture.

Right Wrench for the Job:

The right wrench for this job enjoys the full spectrum of Salesforce work, from resolving a user’s support request in the morning to delivering a custom Apex integration in the afternoon. This individual takes ownership of both the daily health of the platform and its long-term architecture, builds solutions that scale, and partners with Sales, Finance, and Operations to understand the business need before building.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Platform Ownership & Administration
    • Own the day-to-day administration, configuration, and health of the Salesforce platform across Sales Cloud, Einstein AI, and Nue CPQ
    • Debug and resolve production issues in a timely manner across both configuration and code
    • Manage sandbox environments and CI/CD / change-set deployment processes
  • Development & Engineering
    • Design and develop custom Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, and scheduled jobs
    • Build and maintain Lightning Web Components (LWC) for custom UI experiences
    • Develop and maintain REST/SOAP API integrations between Salesforce and third-party systems (QuickBooks, Stripe, Nue CPQ)
    • Write clean, well-documented, testable code with a minimum of 85% code coverage
    • Determine whether a given requirement is best solved with declarative tools (Flow, validation rules) or custom code, and build accordingly
  • Project Delivery & Architecture
    • Gather requirements from stakeholders and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions
    • Build and deploy Flows, validation rules, custom objects, fields, and page layouts
    • Ensure solutions are scalable, governor-limit compliant, and built for long-term maintainability
    • Document configurations, technical designs, data models, and integration specifications for ongoing maintainability
    • Participate in sprint planning and project intake prioritization with RevOps leadership
  • Consulting & Strategy
    • Proactively identify and recommend improvements to existing processes and data models
    • Partner with Revenue Operations to align Salesforce capabilities to business goals
    • Stay current on Salesforce releases, Einstein AI features, developer tools, and platform updates; evaluate and implement relevant new functionality
  • General
    • Adheres to all confidentiality, compliance, and company standards
    • Performs other duties as assigned

Minimum Education & Work Experience:

  • 7+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration / development experience, including Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and Salesforce data model design
  • 1 year of AI experience and switching processes over to using AI
  • Strong proficiency with Salesforce Flow (Screen Flows, Record-Triggered Flows, and Scheduled Flows)
  • Experience building Lightning Web Components (LWC) and an understanding of the Lightning component framework
  • Experience with Sales Cloud, including opportunity management, lead routing, and forecasting
  • Experience building and maintaining REST or SOAP API integrations
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce governor limits, bulkification, and asynchronous processing patterns
  • Demonstrated ability to manage projects end to end, from requirements through deployment
  • At least 2 active Salesforce certifications spanning both the administrator and developer tracks, with preference for:
    • Salesforce Certified Administrator
    • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I
    • Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator
    • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II
    • Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant
    • Salesforce Certified Integration Architecture Designer
    • Agentforce Specialist
  • Preferred qualifications
    • Experience with CPQ tools (Nue, Salesforce CPQ, or similar) and order-to-cash / quote-to-cash workflows
    • Familiarity with QuickBooks and/or Stripe integrations and APIs
    • Experience with Einstein AI features, including Einstein Copilot, Lead Scoring, or Opportunity Insights
    • Knowledge of Agentforce or generative AI tooling within the Salesforce ecosystem
    • Experience with Salesforce DX (SFDX), scratch orgs, and CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset)
    • Exposure to platform events, Change Data Capture (CDC), or the Salesforce streaming API
    • Experience working in a SaaS or subscription-based business model

Key Skills and Qualifications:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders
  • Sound judgment in choosing between declarative configuration and custom code, and the ability to build either
  • Strong requirements-gathering and project management skills, from intake through deployment
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including diagnosing production issues across configuration and code
  • Commitment to clean, documented, testable, and maintainable work
  • Consultative mindset, with the initiative to recommend improvements to existing processes and data models

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

  • Regularly required to sit at a desk in front of a computer and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls (including a computer keyboard and operating a telephone), lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
  • Frequently requires the use of hands and arms for reaching, as well as the ability to walk and communicate effectively through speaking and listening.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
  • Type on a computer keyboard and look at a computer monitor, and operate a cell phone or a computer-based phone.
Salary: $151,465.68 - $185,545.46

raw.description:
About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals with U.S. and Canadian companies, building remote teams across Latin America, the Philippines, South Africa, Europe, and beyond. We believe great candidates deserve access to meaningful work, wherever they live. For this opportunity, you’ll support a law firm’s California personal injury litigation practice.

About the Role

You’ll support attorneys by preparing discovery requests and responses, drafting litigation documents, and creating reusable legal templates. The firm needs an experienced paralegal who can take ownership of assigned documentation with minimal training and supervision. Your accuracy and organization will help attorneys access reliable case materials, stay ahead of discovery deadlines, and move cases forward. You’ll also have the opportunity to improve documentation processes, using your technical skills to make drafting and case preparation more efficient.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare attorney-ready discovery requests, including interrogatories, requests for production, and requests for admission.
  • Draft accurate discovery responses in coordination with attorneys, identifying missing information and supporting materials that need follow-up.
  • Produce clear, properly formatted pleadings, litigation documents, and correspondence for attorney review.
  • Build and maintain reusable legal templates that improve consistency and reduce repetitive document preparation.
  • Organize discovery materials, supporting evidence, and case files so attorneys can quickly locate the information they need.
  • Track discovery deadlines and document readiness, flagging outstanding items early to support timely case progression.
  • Use legal case management software and document management tools to keep case records, assignments, and documentation organized.
  • Anticipate attorney documentation needs, communicate progress reliably, and identify practical improvements to litigation workflows.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • At least 2 years of U.S. civil litigation experience, including hands-on experience supporting California personal injury litigation cases.
  • A strong working understanding of California civil litigation procedures, civil discovery, and litigation workflows.
  • Proven experience drafting interrogatories, requests for production, requests for admission, discovery responses, and reusable legal templates.
  • Excellent written English and legal drafting skills, including accurate legal terminology and advanced Microsoft Word skills for formatting and document preparation.
  • Strong technological proficiency, including experience with legal case management software and document management tools, plus the ability to learn new systems efficiently.
  • Ability to organize large volumes of documents, manage multiple deadlines, communicate reliably, and deliver accurate work with minimal training and supervision.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience using Clio.
  • Paralegal certification or formal legal studies training. Equivalent hands-on litigation experience is welcome; a formal credential is not required.

raw.description:
Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey empowers our members to achieve their best health. For over 90 years, we have been New Jersey’s health solutions leader driving innovations that improve health care quality, affordability, and member experience. Our members are our neighbors, our friends, and our families. It is this understanding that drives us to better serve and care for the 3.5 million people who place their trust in us. We pride ourselves on our best-in-class employees and strive to maintain an innovative and inclusive environment that allows them to thrive. When our employees bring their best and succeed, the Company succeeds.

About the Role

The Certified Professional Coder (CPC) is responsible for performing reviews, audits and coding oversight of medical records to ensure the appropriate CPT codes, diagnosis codes and modifiers according to Generally Accepted Medical Coding Guidelines, CPT-4; HCPCS; ICD-10 Guidelines; and, CMS Correct Coding. Also, the incumbent will complete and take appropriate action in gathering, analyzing and interpreting requisite documentation to conduct low level investigations. The incumbent will also support the investigators related to research and resolution of fraudulent activity. Manage the Special Investigations Unit pended claims to insure we are meeting SLAs and service standards associated with ASO accounts and Blue Card requirements. The incumbent will also be responsible for handling low level investigative activities (external) related to claims, enrollment, accounting, receive and review suspected fraud and to complete cases with all information and analysis for resolution, as the manager and prior approved guidelines may direct.

What You'll Do

  • Accurately reviews, interprets, audits, codes and analyzes medical record documentation for claims that are suspended for Special Investigations pre-payment process. Review may include inpatient, outpatient treatment and/or professional medical services, according to ICD-9/ICD-10 CM coding guidelines.

  • Follow established procedures, guidelines and research utilizing multiple systems and tools.

  • Assure timely, accurate and efficient processing and resolution of pended claims and service requests.

  • Analyze and review confidential and highly sensitive investigative material/documents concerning employees, subscribers, providers and groups.

  • Obtain documentation, claims forms, checks, medical records, utilization records, specialized printouts and other data needed to determine if fraud or misrepresentation of fact is present in claims submissions.

  • Primary contact for other Blues Plans on any claim inquiries related to fraud investigations.

  • Collecting, collating, analyzing and interpreting data in a timely, accurate fashion, both internally and externally, to gather the requisite documentation to conduct an investigation.

  • Personally handles subpoena requests, coordinates efforts with law enforcement state agencies and claims stakeholders.

  • Investigates calls received to the Fraud Hotline with legitimate allegations of fraud. Gathers information related to the hotline call which includes provider and member outreach, request medical records, and claims review. Routes all other calls (i.e. customer service related) to the appropriate business unit for proper handling.

  • Knowledge of CPT coding, HCPCS coding, and ICD 10.

What You Bring

Education/Experience:

  • High School Diploma/GED required.

  • 2 years’ experience in Health Insurance/quality chart audits and/or Utilization Review.

  • 2-3 years’ medical coding experience.

  • ITS/BlueCard Knowledge preferred.

Additional licensing, certifications, registrations:

  • AAPC - Certified Professional Coding (CPC) Designation Required.

Knowledge:

  • Requires knowledge of health insurance operations (i.e. claims, enrollment, underwriting, etc.)

  • Prefers knowledge of claims processing and customer service systems (NASCO adjustment and pend processing, UPS, UCSW, Research Station, Cognos, and ImagePlus)

  • Prefers knowledge of ITS/Blue card process

  • Prefers knowledge in Microsoft products (Word, Excel, and Access)

  • Requires Medical Coding experience

  • Requires proficiency in the CPT-4, HCPC, ICD-9/ICD-10 coding

  • Requires knowledge of medical terminology and anatomy & physiology related to of medical procedures, abbreviations and terms

  • Requires knowledge of the health care delivery system

Skills and Abilities:

  • Requires excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Requires the ability to effectively handle confrontational situations

  • Requires demonstrated ability in MS Office applications, in particular Excel and Access

  • Requires strong organizational skills

  • Requires strong interpersonal skills

  • Prefers strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret data and conduct root cause analysis

Travel:

  • Travel as needed to support investigative activity within Company's service area.

Why Horizon?

At Horizon, you’ll do meaningful work that directly improves lives—while being supported by a mission‑driven organization that values expertise, collaboration, and growth. We believe that when our people thrive, our communities do too. If you are passionate about making an impact, we’d love to hear from you!

Salary Range:

$70,500 - $94,395

​This compensation range is specific to the job level and takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to: education, experience, licensure, certifications, geographic location, and internal equity. This range has been created in good faith based on information known to Horizon at the time of posting. Compensation decisions are dependent on the circumstances of each case. Horizon also provides a comprehensive compensation and benefits package which includes:

  • Comprehensive health benefits (Medical/Dental/Vision)

  • Retirement Plans

  • Generous PTO

  • Incentive Plans

  • Wellness Programs

  • Paid Volunteer Time Off

  • Tuition Reimbursement

Disclaimer:

Horizon BCBSNJ employees must live in New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Connecticut or Delaware. This job summary has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by colleagues within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of colleagues assigned to this job.

Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status or status as an individual with a disability and any other protected class as required by federal, state or local law. Horizon will consider reasonable accommodation requests as part of the recruiting and hiring process.

About The Job

Students come to Berlitz not just to learn a language, but also to gain an understanding of the culture. As a part-time, Freelance English Instructor, you will work in a diverse environment that offers you a flexible schedule and casual dress code. While working with your students, you will use the Berlitz Method of instruction to create an environment where students feel free to experiment with the language and motivate them to achieve their language goals.

We provide you with a flexible training course where you will learn how to perform the Berlitz Method. You will also gain access to our platforms and technology which will allow you to deliver successful instruction.

This is all you need! We provide the students and support; you provide the instruction.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare for your lessons by going through the provided material and deciding what should be taught and how it can be customized based on the student’s needs.
  • Create a risk-free environment where students can feel free to make mistakes and experiment with the language.
  • Document their progress after the lesson.
  • Your schedule is based solely on your availability. We ask that you commit to providing 15-20 hours per week.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
  • Teaching experience is a plus but not required.
  • Expert-level English.
  • Exceptional communication skills.

Technical requirements:

  • A minimum of 15 Mbps download speed / 15 Mbps upload speed.
  • A stable wired connection to the internet (Wi-Fi is not sufficient).
  • A PC or laptop running Windows 11 or higher, or macOS 11 or higher (Linux does not support our applications).
  • A USB headset and a camera.
  • For those living in areas where load shedding occurs, it is required to have a backup system to support your devices.
  • At least 2 GHz of base processing speed and RAM equal or above 8GB.

We offer:

  • As an instructor you can attend group language sessions free of charge.
  • Flexible scheduling to fit your personal needs (must keep original schedule for the first 3-4 months)
  • The ability to work from home, allowing you to save time and money on your daily commute.
  • Free intensive training of the Berlitz Method
  • Rate per 45-minute lesson is $5.50 USD.

Watch our video to find out more! “Becoming a Live Online Instructor”:

Salary: $5.50 USD per 45-minute lesson.
