raw.description:
Interim Managing Director

California Coalition for Worker Power (CCWP)
Housed at Koreatown Immigrant Workers Alliance (KIWA)

About CCWP

The California Coalition for Worker Power (CCWP) is a statewide table of worker centers, labor policy advocates, and unions advancing strategies that build durable worker power across California. Our coalition focuses on structural reforms that strengthen worker organizations, expand collective voice, and protect workers, including immigrant and Black workers, from retaliation and exploitation.California Coalition for Worker Power seeks an Interim Managing Director who understands coalition dynamics, coalition tables, operational systems and finances and can work collaboratively with CCWP leadership team, staff, and partners.

Overview

  • Position Type: At-will, temporary, exempt
  • Location: Remote, must be California-based
  • Duration: 6-18 months
  • Reports To: KIWA’s Executive Director, Coalition Co-Presidents and Co-Managing Directors

Position Summary

California Coalition for Worker Power seeks an experienced and hands-on Interim Managing Director to provide financial leadership and operational support during a short-term transition period. The Interim Managing Director will set up systems and oversee the organization’s financial operations, strengthen organizational digital security protocols, partner with the leadership team to fundraise strategy, and provide oversight of organizational activities, priorities, projects and decisions.

The ideal candidate is a proven operations and executive leader who can quickly create unified finance systems, oversee priorities, and work effectively with directors, staff, finance, and coalition partners to execute plans.

Job Description

We are seeking a proven and experienced Interim Managing Director who will provide strategic and operational leadership to set up systems to the coalition’s continued growth, effectiveness, and alignment during a period of transition. Working closely with coalition leadership, staff, and member organizations, the Interim Managing Director will create and strengthen internal systems, facilitate cross-coalition coordination, and ensure that organizational priorities are translated into clear plans and effective execution.

The Interim Managing Director will partner with CCWP leadership and workgroups to lead the following areas:

Finance & Administration

  • Working with coalition leadership, drive a process to consolidate the coalition’s organizational structure, including transition to a single fiscal entity.
  • Oversee the completion of the coalition’s financial systems, including identifying gaps and implementing practical systems to improve financial visibility, accountability, compliance and decision-making.
  • Lead and oversee the 2027 budget process and subgrants process including the development of overall strategy, support decision-making regarding overall budget and subgrant amounts, coordinate with staff, manage disbursements, and ensure appropriate financial documentation and accountability
  • Work with all relevant parties to ensure compliance with coalition’s financial policies and procedures, as well as applicable grant requirements, accounting standards, and other financial obligations
  • Monitor budget-to-actual performance, identify trends, variances and potential areas of over- or underspending and proactively collaborate with staff and leadership team.
  • Support the development and implementation of organizational security protocols.

Organizational Operations

  • Lead the day-to-day operations of the coalition; ensure that decision-making structures, roles, responsibilities, and processes are clear, effective, and aligned with the coalition's long term agenda and goals.
  • Ensure continuity between coalition meetings and decision-making spaces, communicate decisions, next steps, ownership, and timelines so that collective work moves forward between convenings, and retreats.
  • Serve as strategic thought partner to coalition leadership, help navigate competing priorities, resolve organizational and governance challenges, and maintain focus on shared goals.
  • Maintain clear governance documentation, include decisions, policies, roles, meeting records, workplans, and other materials necessary to support institutional memory and accountability.
  • Evaluate and strengthen coalition governance practices over time, use feedback and experience to improve how the coalition makes decisions, shares power, manages conflict, and advances collective work.

Leadership Support

  • Coordinate and facilitate staff and Leadership team meetings including develop agendas, sequence and prioritize topics, manage scheduling, and ensure clear decisions and next stepsPlan and coordinate Leadership Team and Coordinating Committee retreats, ensuring clear objects, effective agendas, strong facilitation, and alignment with organizational priorities
  • Provide strategic oversight of organizational priorities, ensuring that key initiatives, projects, and meetings remain focused on the coalition’s measurable outcomes, and long term vision..
  • Track organizational commitments, priorities and deliverables, proactively identifying potential delays, competing demands or capacity challenges and sounding the alarm when commitments or timelines are at risk

Job Qualifications

The ideal candidate is a strategic, systems-oriented leader who brings strong attention to detail while maintaining a clear understanding of the organization’s broader goals and mission. They are comfortable operating in complex, fast-moving environments and have the ability to translate strategy into effective systems, processes, and action.

The successful candidate will have:

  • Strong systems thinking and attention to detail, with the ability to see the big picture, connect across functions, and build practical systems that support organizational effectiveness.
  • Strong project and program management skills, including the ability to develop plans, establish timelines, coordinate stakeholders, and ensure projects move from strategy to completion.
  • The ability to thrive in complexity, manage competing priorities, and exercise sound judgment in a dynamic, mission-driven environment.

Job Description:

Job Description – Client Services Consultant – ICB4

Broadcom offers multiple positions in Europe for experience IBM Mainframe System Engineers.

We are looking for candidates with expertise (SME) in one of the following domains:

  • IBM Mainframe Workload Manager and Performance Management, with strong knowledge of Broadcom Workload Solutions, Tivoli Workload Solutions and BMC Control-M solutions
  • IBM Mainframe Storage Management with strong knowledge of CA-Vantage, CA-Disk or IBM DFHSM/DFSMS, CA-1 FS or IBM RMM or BMC Control-T.
  • IBM Mainframe expert in AIOPs & Auto Domain , with strong knowledge of IBM WLM, IBM System Automation , Omegamon , CA-Sysview , CA OPS/MVS or CA Netmaster

Candidates must speak a European Language and have the expected Education Degree (Bachelor diploma at least).

This position must be seen by Broadcom customer as bringing tangible value in terms of experience, knowledge and expertise.

This is achieved through a combination of broad real-world experience and IT industry-specific certifications.

The candidate will be responsible of Broadcom Software Adoption using techniques as Presentation, Demonstration, Installation, Configuration, Deployment and Proof of Concept.

Key Responsibilities

This position is responsible for delivering positive, quantifiable results for Broadcom measured across five primary areas:

  • Customer Focus: Effectively and compellingly communicate Broadcom's key capabilities to address customer and partner needs
  • Financial Targets: Meet or exceed Broadcom's stated financial quotas and targets
  • Internal Business Processes: Demonstrate mastery with Broadcom's internal processes, systems and support structure
  • Professional Development: Demonstrate high-level proficiency and skill
  • Leadership, Teamwork and Planning: Collaborate with, and effectively run virtual team(s)

Customer Focus

  • Assist the Broadcom sales team in technically qualifying solutions, specifically Broadcom MAINFRAME Solutions, and their benefits to customers and/or partners.
  • Work closely with the account team and the customer or partner to obtain a deep understanding of the customer's technology needs or partner's offerings and architect a solution to meet them.
  • Build relationships across customer's or partner's IT silos and offerings to understand, build, document and share our knowledge of their infrastructure, challenges and potential technical impact of planned projects.
  • Understand and act as a valued resource early and often within the customer's decision making process (e.g.: during the idea or conceptual stages).
  • Execute complex product integration demonstrations and proofs of concept, customizing the demonstrations as necessary to address the customer's specific needs and environment.
  • Maintain a deep technical knowledge of the products developed by the business unit.
  • Provide technical specifications and requirements documentation as necessary to support the proposed solution.
  • Effectively position and present the benefits of Broadcom's solutions and specifically how our solutions will support the client's technical and functional requirements.
  • Provide technical leadership and oversight during Trials, Proof-of-Concept (POCs), complex demos, etc., as warranted.
  • Ensure technical requirements required by the proposed solution are clearly communicated to and understood by the client and meet the client's expectations.
  • Effectively communicate Broadcom's key competitive differentiators.
  • Foster and build relationships with customers and partners to develop references.
  • Strive to constantly improve the quality of all customer interactions.

Financial Target

  • Directly assist account teams in achieving financial targets via the opportunity planning process.
  • Assist sales in accurately assessing and forecasting opportunities.
  • Evaluate alternative options to execute opportunities by the most cost effective means without negatively impacting deliverable quality or customer's perceptions.
  • Ensure long-term stability and sustainability of book-of-business.

Broadcom’s Internal Business Processes

  • Coordinate internal/external resources to effectively pursue opportunities.
  • Disseminate feedback to business units gained from client experiences and issues to facilitate product improvements or enhancements.
  • Mastery of processes and tools for:
  • Proposal Development
  • Solution Architecture Overview
  • Statement of Work (SOW) Development
  • Need-based Sales Methodology
  • Enterprise Management tools and accelerators (Profilers, Maturity Modeler, and Blueprints)
  • Contribute constructive feedback for improvement and enhancement of above processes.
  • Assist in the Partner Enablement process (partner selection, technical training and opportunity engagement).
  • Marshal appropriate CA resources to effectively execute partner-led opportunities.
  • Understand and adhere to compliance requirements and Code of Ethics.

Typical Role Definition

Sr Professional Staff. A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. Complete understanding and wide application of principles, theories, and concepts in the field. General knowledge of other related disciplines. Strong competence with the various tools, procedures, programming languages used to accomplish the job. Usually works with minimal supervision, conferring with a supervisor on unusual matters. May be assisted by (and at times direct) less senior level employees. Requires daily decision-making capabilities and actions that may not be reviewed by superiors. Assignments are broad in nature and need ingenuity and originality to solve. Contributes to moderately complex aspects of a project. May assist more junior staff members with aspects of their job. Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. May play a role in high-level projects that have an impact on the company’s future direction.

Job-Specific Authority and Scope

  • Generally works without consulting their manager.
  • Independent decisions are made daily.
  • Examples of typical decisions without manager consultation:
  • Development of solution strategies and selection of technical components.
  • Resolution of daily issues as the arise and escalation of larger issues
  • Advice and counsel to account teams and sales management regarding solution approaches.
  • Typically has no direct reports.
  • Typically has no total staff.
  • Typically has a geographic focus of Area (multi-country or multi-state).
  • Typically does not manage a budget.

Business Travel and Physical Demands

Business travel of approximately 50 or more percent yearly is expected for this position.

Physical demands:Office environment. No special physical demands required.

Preferred Education

Bachelor's degree or global equivalent in Computer Science or a related degree.

Work Experience

Typically 10 or more years of detailed MAINFRAME technical industry related experience. Experience working with customers, sales personnel and/or customer services. Experience in the related industry disciplines and technologies and related application experience

Experience resolving more complex technical issues and integration of multiple products to create solutions.

Languages

English (Native) and proficiency of Major European Languages

The candidate must be eligible to permanently reside and work unrestricted in UK

We will consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability status, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. 💼 The Scoop on the Role:

This role involves closely collaborating with stakeholders to design, deploy, maintain, and monitor live services and the underlying network infrastructure. As a Principal Network Architect, you'll focus on architecting, deploying, and operating cloud-based GRC and HRIS services and SaaS products ensuring the security and connectivity of critical operations processes.

The role's areas of focus:

  • Architectural Leadership: Lead the creation of advanced network architectures and designs within a team of technical leads.
  • Technology Evaluation: Proactively evaluate and assess new networking technologies to enhance infrastructure capabilities.
  • Technical Standards: Develop technical solutions and establish standards, policies, and procedures for network infrastructure.
  • Infrastructure Management: Manage cloud network resources, application flows, and security elements as code, integrated into the CI/CD pipeline.
  • Automation: Automate workloads using a variety of tools and services, including native command line tools like Microsoft Azure and AWS.
  • Security Compliance: Apply a risk-based approach to implementing security policies to ensure GDPR and InfoSec compliance.
  • Security Collaboration: Collaborate with the security team to implement best practices for cloud network security.
  • Agile Participation: Engage in Agile Scrum standups with platform and development teams, supporting software deployment to secure cloud networks.
  • Monitoring Solutions: Implement monitoring solutions for network infrastructure and services across multiple clouds, utilising open-source dashboarding technologies like Graphana.
  • Vendor Management: Act as the primary interface to third-party network and security vendors on behalf of Grouper.

📈What We're Looking For: Network Architect Ninja! Are you ready to dive into a role that demands technical mastery and strategic flair? We're seeking someone with:

  • Experience or Certification: Possess experience or certification in one of the following: Azure Web Application Firewall, Checkpoint Next Generation Firewall, NGINX/F5 API Management & NGINX App Protect Web Application Firewall.
  • IT Governance and Compliance: Experience with IT governance standards and compliance frameworks such as ITIL, PCI, and SOC.
  • Network Architecture: Extensive experience in architecting networks to enable a flexible and secure environment for operating and maintaining a fleet of Microservice APIs.
  • Scripting Skills: Proficiency in scripting languages like Python, Ansible, Azure DevOps, or Terraform for automating routine tasks.
  • Tool Proficiency: Experience with Atlassian JIRA, Bitbucket, and Confluence for project management, version control, and documentation.
  • Linux Shell Scripting: Proficiency in Linux shell scripting for automation and system administration tasks.
  • Git Repository Management: Experience in working with git repositories for version control and collaborative development.
  • Communication Skills: Strong documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills are essential for effective collaboration.
  • Load Balancer Design: Extensive experience with standard load balancer design, SSL termination, and overall application/solution design.
  • Certifications: Desired certifications or equivalent experience in disciplines such as CCNA, CCNP, CCDP, CCIE, CISSP, or other relevant security certifications.
  • Advanced Traffic Management: Demonstrated knowledge of advanced layer 4 to 7 traffic management, including authentication and authorization flows, JWT/OIDC, and integration with 3rd party identity providers.

🎲 The Perfect Match: If you possess some of these skills, Grouper is excited to hear from you!

  • Certified MCSE: Cloud Platform and Infrastructure is like finding gold at the end of the rainbow!
  • Someone who gets things done, but puts security first.
  • University degree:. Advanced degree preferred for that extra sparkle!
  • Experience working in an agile environment following scrum - because who doesn't love a good sprint?
  • Certification on Microsoft Azure, AWS and other Public Cloud technology is music to our ears!

🚀Meet Grouper:

We are our customers' trusted partner in the exciting world of safeguarding data, strengthening cybersecurity, and strategic consulting. We lead the way in ensuring data integrity, securing information, and navigating regulatory compliance with confidence. With a blend of technical expertise and clever thinking, we redefine GRC and IT strategies, empowering organisations to shine. From wielding cyber-superpowers to mastering security frameworks like ISO 27001:2013 and NIST, we're certified wizards ready to chart a course to success, strengthen defenses, and turn challenges into opportunities to excel.

So whether our customers are battling cyber dragons or navigating the tumultuous seas of change, Gruper is their trusted ally on the journey to greatness.

🎉💬 Join Grouper:

Are you ready to embark on an epic journey where your technical prowess meets strategic brilliance? Join Grouper's Platform Operations Team as a Principal Network Architect.🥇

raw.description:
Overview

The Commercial Counsel, Contracts will report to the VP, Deputy General Counsel, supporting the Chief Legal Officer, and serve as a legal point of contact for business stakeholders across MRO Corporation (MRO) and its subsidiaries. Sitting at the intersection of commercial contracting and healthcare compliance, this role requires a strong foundation in contract law, experience with technology and SaaS agreements, the ability to build trusted relationships with internal partners, and the judgment to navigate complex, regulated business environments. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced in-house setting and can manage a high-volume, varied workload with minimal supervision.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate regularly with members of the legal team to help streamline work and implement effective risk management
  • Draft and review complex contract language and contract negotiations particularly those related to contracts with various types of health care clients, providers and employer groups or government contracts, including Master Services Agreements, Business Associate Agreements, Indemnity, Limitations of Liability, and State Medicaid Contracts
  • Draft, review, and negotiate technology, SaaS, and software agreements, including vendor agreements, data processing addenda, licensing agreements, and API/integration contracts
  • Manage and administer Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) across the client and vendor portfolio, ensuring alignment with HIPAA requirements and MRO’s contractual obligations
  • Negotiate contract terms with internal business partners, clients, vendors, and other parties
  • Support the administration and ongoing development of MRO’s contract lifecycle management (CLM) system, including playbook maintenance, template management, and workflow improvements
  • Provide legal advice on contract interpretation and obligations
  • Interact with management and all levels of corporate personnel to obtain information and provide counsel regarding sensitive and complex legal issues
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations
  • Identify and mitigate potential legal risks within contractual agreements
  • Maintain organized records of executed contracts and related documents
  • Collaborate with other departments to gather necessary information for contract review
  • Resolve any contract-related disputes or issues
  • Update contractual policies and procedures as needed to align with current laws, regulations, and client policies
  • Conduct legal research to support contract review negotiations

Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor Degree (JD) from accredited law school
  • Licensed to practice law by the bar of at least one state
  • 3+ years of experience in a multi-client law firm, health insurer, hospital, or similar organization
  • 3+ years of health care related legal experience
  • Demonstrated experience in a law firm and/or in-house corporate law department required
  • Strong knowledge of corporate transaction practices
  • Experience drafting and negotiating technology, SaaS, software licensing, or vendor agreements strongly preferred
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA, state privacy laws, and healthcare regulatory frameworks applicable to health information management
  • Experience with a contract lifecycle management (CLM) system preferred; familiarity with LinkSquares or similar platforms a plus
  • Strong interpersonal, writing, and verbal communications skills
  • Ability to interact with all levels of management
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines, and able to work independently and as a part of a team to prioritize responsibilities, take initiative and self-motivate/self-manage work and time

Total CompensationBase pay is one element of the total compensation package. Eligible employees may also receive an annual cash bonus and have access to a comprehensive benefits offering, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and a 401(k) plan.

Salary Range It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range. Individual pay may be influenced by factors such as skills, qualifications, experience, licensure, certifications, geographic location, and internal equity.

Applicant Privacy Notice

Pay Range

USD $121,000.00 - USD $163,000.00 /Yr.

Bayswater Education is a vibrant network of global educational centres dedicated for over 75 years to educating and inspiring people through a life-changing educational experience. We’re passionate about growing communities of global thinkers and explorers, at home and abroad – whatever their story. We set up Bayswater Education because we want young people from every walk of life to get a buzz from discovering new cultures, exploring new flavours, and learning what’s out there. We think of them as global spirits, like ourselves.

We’re looking for a proactive and detail-focused Admissions Officer to join our central services department. This role works closely with Sales, Partner Support, Accounts Receivable and our schools to ensure applications are processed accurately, payments are tracked, and students and agents receive clear, timely communication.

You will play a key role in managing bookings from enquiry through to arrival, while helping to protect revenue and maintain strong agent relationships across the region.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Process individual student and group applications accurately and within agreed timelines.
  • Handle group enquiries, prepare quotations and coordinate with Sales and schools to confirm availability, pricing and booking requirements.
  • Manage group bookings, including student lists, course details, accommodation, transfers and other arrangements.
  • Liaise with agents, group organisers and schools to ensure group requirements are communicated clearly and arrangements are confirmed ahead of arrival.
  • Prepare and issue invoices, visa letters, accommodation confirmations and pre-arrival documentation for individual students and groups.
  • Monitor payment deadlines and follow up with agents and group organisers to ensure timely settlement of invoices.
  • Support with receipt allocation, tracking outstanding balances and escalating unpaid cases where required.
  • Coordinate on refunds, commission queries and overpayments, ensuring records remain accurate.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date individual and group booking information in the student management system.
  • Monitor shared inboxes and manage individual and group booking queries professionally and efficiently.
  • Work closely with Sales, Partner Support, Accounts Receivable and schools to resolve booking, operational or payment issues.
  • Coordinate changes to group bookings, ensuring relevant teams are informed and documentation is updated accordingly.
  • Provide booking and payment updates to support regional forecasting, group planning and operational reporting.
  • Support continuous improvements to admissions and group booking processes to ensure efficiency, accuracy and a positive customer experience.

Requirements:

  • Experience in admissions, education administration, group bookings or international student recruitment.
  • Experience coordinating group travel, educational programmes or accommodation arrangements would be an advantage.
  • Confidence handling invoices, payments and basic credit control processes.
  • Strong communication skills in English.

raw.description:
Senior Product Manager - Platform

Bitwarden empowers enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely store and share sensitive data. With a transparent, open-source approach to password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations, Bitwarden makes it easy for users to extend robust security practices across all online activities. Founded in 2016 with headquarters in Santa Barbara, California, Bitwarden is supported by a passionate global community of security experts and enthusiasts.

As Senior Product Manager, Platform at Bitwarden, you will own the foundational capabilities that every user and admin depends on: how people create accounts and sign in, how developers and other systems reach Bitwarden programmatically, and how customer data stays protected. Your scope covers account creation, authentication (SSO, role-based access), the Bitwarden CLI, our public APIs and MCP server, integrations with the business platforms our customers already use, and the security foundations underneath them, such as key management, vulnerability response, and post-quantum readiness. You will partner with Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Design to turn these into clear, shippable outcomes, and you will work with Sales and Solutions Engineering to understand how identity and integration capabilities help win and keep enterprise customers. You will use customer feedback, usage data, and competitive benchmarking to inform roadmap decisions, thinking about the end user, the IT admin, and the developer.

This is an all-remote team and we're looking for someone located in the U.S. with no preference for time zone. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the roadmap for account creation and authentication, including SSO, role-based access control, and how users and admins first set up and sign in to Bitwarden
  • Own the Bitwarden CLI, public APIs, and MCP server as products, making it easy for developers, admins, and AI agents to work with Bitwarden data securely
  • Define and prioritize integrations with identity providers and other business platforms our customers rely on
  • Partner with Security and Architecture on platform-wide data protection, including key management, vulnerability response, and post-quantum cryptography readiness, and translate that work into clear requirements and customer-facing value
  • Write clear specs and user stories, and work closely with engineering to scope, sequence, and ship features
  • Analyze how competitive password and identity vendors approach authentication, developer tooling, and integrations, and identify where Bitwarden can stand out
  • Define and monitor adoption metrics, such as, SSO adoption, API and CLI usage, and integration usage
  • Support Sales and Solutions Engineering with product knowledge on authentication, integrations, and security architecture, including RFP and security questionnaire input
  • Share progress, roadmap updates, and wins with leadership and cross-functional partners
  • Use AI tools to accelerate spec writing, competitive analysis, data analysis, and rapid prototyping

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

  • 4+ years experience in product management
  • Experience with platform, developer-facing, or identity features of B2B SaaS products
  • Strong technical aptitude, with familiarity with authentication standards (SAML, OIDC, SCIM) and APIs
  • Comfort working with developer tools such as CLIs, REST APIs, and SDKs
  • Ability to translate complex security concepts into intuitive user and admin experiences
  • Ability to have technical discussions with engineering about architecture and technology tradeoffs
  • Extremely organized and able to make well-informed prioritization and trade-off decisions with engineering
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A growth mindset and a desire to learn from others
  • Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

Selected candidates will be invited to schedule an introduction call and potentially progress through the following stages:

  • Interview with Director, Product Management
  • Interview with Chief Product Officer
  • Interview with Chief Technology Officer
  • Reference calls

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations. Become an expert. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.

In the United States, the starting base compensation range for this role is $150,000 - $160,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, relevant experience, and skill set as assessed in the interview process, as well as market data by location. See our careers page for a list of benefits. Please note that compensation outside the U.S. will differ based on the market.

raw.description:
We are a healthcare technology company that provides platforms and solutions to improve the management and access of cost-effective pharmacy benefits. Our technology helps enterprise and partnership clients simplify their businesses and helps consumers save on prescriptions.

As a leader in SaaS technology for healthcare, we offer innovative solutions with integrated intelligence on a single enterprise platform that connects the pharmacy ecosystem. With our expertise and modern, modular platform, our partners use real-time data to transform their business performance and optimize their innovative models in the marketplace.

Position Summary

The Senior Data Engineer owns the data platform end to end — designing, building, and maintaining the infrastructure, pipelines, and governed data layers that power analytics and downstream consumers across the organization. This is a hands-on engineering role centered on cloud data platform development, pipeline orchestration, and data modeling at scale.

The guiding principle is to build once, consume everywhere — define transformations and metrics a single time, governed and version-controlled in the warehouse, then serve them consistently to every downstream consumer: BI tools, client-facing reporting, and AI systems.

The ideal candidate is comfortable building data platforms and systems from scratch, thrive in a platform development and maintenance environment, and brings strong hands-on experience with Snowflake and workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow and dbt (or equivalent platforms). This role does not own BI visualization — your work spans raw ingestion through the governed gold layer.

Key Responsibilities

Data Platform Development & Maintenance

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and platform infrastructure on Snowflake.
  • Architect and implement end-to-end data flows from source ingestion through the silver and gold layers.
  • Own platform reliability, performance tuning, and ongoing maintenance — treating the data platform as a product.
  • Build systems from the ground up where needed; evaluate existing systems and refactor for scale, cost efficiency, and maintainability.
  • Establish engineering standards: version control, CI/CD, testing frameworks, and documentation for all platform components.

Pipeline Orchestration & Workflow Management

  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows using Apache Airflow (or equivalent) to schedule, monitor, and manage data pipelines.
  • Ensure pipeline reliability, observability, and failure recovery through alerting, logging, and automated retries.
  • Coordinate dependencies across upstream sources and downstream consumers with well-defined SLAs.

Gold-Layer Modeling & Metrics

  • Design, build, and maintain gold-layer data models and a governed metrics layer in Snowflake using dbt — clean, tested, documented, and version-controlled.
  • Establish metric definitions as the single source of truth: calculated once, reused everywhere, with clear ownership and change management.
  • Push transformation and calculation logic upstream into the warehouse so the consumption layer stays simple, consistent, and high-trust.
  • Partner with analytics and BI stakeholders on the boundary between pipelines (data engineering) and consumption (analytics/reporting).
  • Structure and document data models so they meet the governance and consistency requirements of AI agents and autonomous analytical systems.

AI-Native Development

  • Build with coding agents and AI-assisted tooling as a primary part of the workflow — accelerating pipeline development, data modeling, documentation, and testing.
  • Independently set up and manage development environments, repositories, and the tooling needed to work effectively with agentic systems.
  • Help establish team practices and standards for building data infrastructure in the AI era.

Quality, Governance & Platform Judgment

  • Champion data quality, consistency, and trust across all platform layers — ensuring data holds up under scrutiny from any downstream consumer.
  • Contribute to platform architecture decisions; identify opportunities for automation, templating, and process improvement.
  • Apply sound engineering judgment to evaluate build vs. buy decisions and tooling trade-offs.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering — building pipelines, data models, and platform infrastructure in a data-driven organization.
  • Snowflake:Proven, hands-on production experience building data models and transformations in Snowflake. Deep familiarity with Snowflake architecture, performance optimization, and cost management.
  • Workflow Orchestration (must have):Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow or an equivalent DAG-based orchestration platform (e.g., Prefect, Dagster, Mage). Ability to design, deploy, and operate complex pipeline workflows.
  • dbt:Demonstrated experience using dbt for transformation modeling, testing, and documentation in a production warehouse environment. Equivalent semantic layer tooling experience considered.
  • Strong SQL proficiency — able to write, optimize, and review complex queries across large datasets.
  • Experience building data platforms or systems from scratch — not just extending existing infrastructure but designing and standing up new ones.
  • Comfort with platform development and maintenance as a long-term ownership model — not just project delivery.
  • Fluency working in the AI era: building with coding agents, setting up development environments, and using AI tooling as a core productivity multiplier.
  • Familiarity with software engineering practices: version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and code review.
  • Strong communication skills — able to translate business requirements into technical data platform decisions.

Preferred

  • Experience in pharmacy benefits management, healthcare technology, or a related regulated industry.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and data platform tooling (AWS, Azure, or GCP) alongside the data stack.
  • Familiarity with data governance frameworks, data contracts, or data mesh principles.
  • Experience with streaming or near-real-time data pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, Spark Streaming).
  • Exposure to semantic/metrics layer tooling (e.g., MetricFlow, Cube, LookML).
  • Experience building demo environments or client-facing data products.

Salary Range: 145,000 - 165,000

DATA ANALYST INTERNSHIP

WHO WE ARE:

Passion for Life is a non-profit organization that operates with the power of dedicated interns like you. We help under-resourced youth transform their passions into rewarding careers. Our mission is to provide forward-thinking career coaching and immersion opportunities driven by the students’ passions and talents in a fun, structured, and high-energy environment. Passion for Life was created to be a high-energy and engaging process that helps students identify their passions and gain clarity on how to utilize their core strengths and talents to select a career.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Data Analyst Intern plays a critical role in advancing the organization's mission by transforming raw program and operational data into clear, actionable insights. Working collaboratively across program, development, and leadership teams, this position supports data-driven decision-making by designing and maintaining evaluation frameworks, producing compelling reports and dashboards, and ensuring data integrity throughout the organization. The ideal candidate is both analytically rigorous and mission-passionate, with the ability to communicate complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

While this is an unpaid internship position, there are many exciting internal and external rewards to consider.

What you gain

  • Gain valuable hands on experience in nonprofit educational sector
  • Make a meaningful impact on the lives of underserved communities
  • Increase your networking opportunities and collaborate with knowledgeable teams
  • Boost your untapped potential and master new skills
  • Flexible scheduling and potential for recommendation letters

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Data Analysis & Program Evaluation: Conduct regular impact assessments, needs analyses, and program evaluations using both quantitative and qualitative methodologies to measure effectiveness and inform continuous improvement.
  • Data Management & Governance: Oversee data collection, cleaning, storage, and management in compliance with organizational standards, confidentiality policies, and applicable data governance requirements.
  • Reporting & Data Visualization: Create user-friendly, visually engaging reports and dashboards for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including program teams, leadership, and funders.
  • Evaluation Framework & Strategy: Design and maintain robust evaluation frameworks that measure program outcomes, align with organizational goals, and inform strategic decision-making.
  • Collaboration & Capacity Building: Partner with program, development, and leadership teams to deliver data insights that support program enhancement and assist staff in building data literacy for day-to-day use.

Technical Skills:

  • Leadership and Delegation: Ability to lead research initiatives and delegate tasks effectively to team members or collaborators.
  • Research Platforms: Proficiency in research platforms and tools, including Python, Qualtrics, Microsoft Office Suite, and Java.
  • Analytics: Skilled in statistical and data analytics software (e.g., SPSS, SAS, R), with a strong foundation in analyzing complex datasets.
  • Data Collection and Cleaning: Experienced in data collection methods and techniques, ensuring clean, accurate, and reliable data for analysis.
  • Qualitative and Quantitative Data: Competent in both qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, applying each effectively to capture comprehensive insights.
  • Evaluation Design: Ability to design robust evaluation frameworks that measure outcomes and inform strategic decisions.
  • Creating Reports and Sharing Data: Skilled in creating clear, compelling reports and dashboards to communicate findings effectively to stakeholders, including program teams and funders.
  • Editing and Proofreading: Strong attention to detail in reviewing reports, ensuring clarity, coherence, and accuracy in documentation.
  • Research and Evaluation Planning: Skilled in planning and executing research projects aligned with organizational goals.
  • Instructional Design Principles and Learning Theory: Knowledgeable in instructional design (ID) principles, learning theory, and educational frameworks to support effective program evaluation.
  • Graphic Design and Multimedia: Familiar with tools such as Articulate, Captivate, and other eLearning and multimedia platforms, capable of creating engaging visuals and interactive reports.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Social Sciences, Public Policy, Human Services, or a related field required.
  • Master's degree or certifications in research methods, program evaluation, or data analytics (e.g., SAS, SPSS, Google Data Analytics, or equivalent) preferred.
  • Students with relevant majors and coursework aligned to the above are encouraged to apply for the intern role.

Experience

  • 1–5 years of experience in data analysis, program evaluation, or research, ideally within a nonprofit or mission-driven organization.
  • Proven experience conducting impact assessments, needs analyses, and program evaluations; community-based program familiarity strongly preferred.
  • Experience working across cross-functional teams and communicating findings to non-technical audiences.

Additional Information

Estimated time commitment: 9-10 hours/ week depending on needs, in addition to weekly meetings and occasional conference calls.

Term limit: 4-month unpaid intern position (Can be extendable on mutual agreement).

raw.title: Sound Designer & Editor
raw.excerpt: ABOUT CHANGING LIVES PRODUCTIONS:Changing Lives Productions is the video production company of Dhar Mann Studios, aimed at creating positive content for the social media generation.
raw.description:
ABOUT CHANGING LIVES PRODUCTIONS:

Changing Lives Productions is the video production company of Dhar Mann Studios, aimed at creating positive content for the social media generation. Our short, motivational videos focused on life, business, and relationships receive over 1 Billion views monthly and have garnered over 60 Billion views on Facebook, YouTube, Instagram and TikTok. The team is led by Dhar Mann, a mission-driven entrepreneur with a global audience of over 170 Million social media followers and one of the highest viewed content creators in the world today. Our stories depict real life situations shown by actors that teach important life lessons, inspired by Dhar Mann's personal experience of success and failure. The company is driven by one founding principle: We’re not just telling stories, we’re changing lives.

BIG PICTURE:

Dhar Mann Studios is seeking a highly skilled and creative Sound Designer/Editor to join our dynamic Post-production team. This role is crucial for elevating our narrative content through expert sound design, Foley, and final audio mixing. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of audio post-production workflows, a meticulous ear for detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, contributing significantly to our high-volume output of scripted dramas and content.

Sound Design & Creation:

  • Design and implement a wide range of sound effects to enhance the emotional impact and realism of our narrative content, including ambiences, hard effects, and creative sound design elements
  • Record and edit Foley to sync with on-screen action, ensuring subtle, realistic sounds are captured and integrated seamlessly
  • Clean up and edit dialogue tracks to remove background noise, improve clarity, and ensure consistency across all scenes
  • Collaborate with the editorial team, directors, and composers to understand the creative vision and translate it into a compelling auditory experience

Mixing & Mastering:

  • Perform final audio mixes for all projects, balancing dialogue, music, sound effects, and Foley to create a cohesive and professional final product
  • Ensure all mixes meet broadcast loudness standards and technical specifications for various distribution platforms when needed
  • Conduct quality control checks on all delivered audio, confirming all tracks are properly synced, free of errors, and consistent in quality

Workflow & Management:

  • Manage audio assets and project files, ensuring all sessions are organized, archived, and easy to access for future use or revisions
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to audio software, hardware, and file formats
  • Report on department metrics such as mix volume and common technical challenges to help the post-production team make informed operational decisions
  • Stay updated on industry trends, tools, and best practices in audio post-production.

WHAT YOU HAVE:

  • Experience in a high-volume content creation environment, preferably with scripted narrative content.
  • Bachelor's degree in Audio Engineering, Music Production, Film, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as a Sound Designer, Audio Mixer, or similar role in a fast-paced production setting.
  • Expert-level proficiency with a Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) such as Pro Tools, Logic Pro X, or Adobe Audition.
  • Strong understanding of audio signal flow, acoustics, and mixing techniques.
  • Proficiency with industry-standard audio plugins for EQ, compression, noise reduction, and reverb.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate creative and technical concepts.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines.
  • A proactive problem-solver with a strong work ethic.
  • A passion for storytelling through sound.
  • Experience with advanced noise reduction software (e.g., iZotope RX).

Bonus

  • Experience with spatial audio formats like Dolby Atmos.
  • A portfolio or reel showcasing your work on past projects.

WHO OVERSEES YOU:

The Sound Designer/Mixer will report directly to the Head of Post-production

WHO YOU OVERSEE:

This is an Individual Contributor Position with no direct reports. You are expected to work collaboratively with our post-production and creative teams.

WHERE IT ALL GOES DOWN:

Remote / Global / LATAM / EMEA / APAC

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US:

Work alongside industry leaders on thrilling, fast-paced projects as our content rapidly expands. Get to know us:

Note: This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position. It may be subject to change at the discretion of the company. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions, including hiring, promotion, compensation, and termination, are based on individual qualifications, merit, and business needs. We encourage candidates of all races, colors, religions, sexes, sexual orientations, gender identities, national origins, ages, disabilities, and veteran statuses to apply. We believe in transparency and fairness when it comes to compensation. The freelance rate for this position is based on experience and qualifications. In addition to your salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, which includes health insurance and paid time off.

Salary: 15-25/hr Americas / 10-17/hr Asia

raw.excerpt: We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential.
raw.description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.

The Benefits Realization Manager is responsible for ensuring Digital, AI, business transformation, and process improvement investments deliver the value they were expected to achieve.

This role leads the firm's benefits realization capability, working with business leaders, product teams, portfolio teams, and transformation leaders to define value before work begins, establish success measures and benefit ownership, and validate that expected outcomes are achieved after implementation.

Rather than focusing solely on project delivery, the Benefits Realization Manager focuses on business outcomes. The role creates the frameworks, governance, reporting, and accountability needed to connect investments to measurable operational, financial, workforce, client, and strategic benefits.

The Manager serves as a trusted advisor to business and technology leaders on value realization, adoption, transformation outcomes, and investment effectiveness while leading a team responsible for value measurement and benefits governance across the portfolio. This role is aligned and collaborates with the finance, digital effectiveness, digital portfolio and business strategy teams to ensure their goals and capabilities align with the benefits realization frameworks.

Essential Duties

Benefits Strategy, Value Definition & Measurement (30%)

  • Establish enterprise standards, methodologies, and governance for benefits realization and value management.
  • Partner with business stakeholders during intake, discovery, and business case development to define expected outcomes and value targets.
  • Develop measurable benefit metrics, baselines, benefit dependency maps, and realization plans.
  • Ensure business ownership and accountability are established for all significant benefits.
  • Define how value will be measured before investments are approved.

Business Case & Value Assessment (15%)

  • Partner with sponsors and portfolio leaders to evaluate business cases and value assumptions.
  • Validate forecasted benefits, financial impacts, productivity opportunities, and strategic outcomes.
  • Support governance and investment review processes with value-driven analyses and recommendations.
  • Improve organizational rigor around value assessment, prioritization, and investment decisions.

Benefits Realization & Outcome Tracking (20%)

  • Maintain portfolio-level benefit tracking and realization reporting.
  • Monitor actual performance against approved business cases and expected outcomes.
  • Identify value realization risks, adoption challenges, and areas of value leakage.
  • Recommend corrective actions that improve realization performance.

Adoption & Transformation Outcomes (15%)

  • Partner with Change Management and Process Transformation teams to ensure adoption efforts translate into measurable business outcomes.
  • Evaluate adoption, utilization, behavioral change, process improvement, and stakeholder experience metrics.
  • Help business leaders understand the difference between successful deployment and successful realization of value.
  • Promote outcome-focused accountability across transformation initiatives.

Executive Reporting & Governance (10%)

  • Deliver executive dashboards, scorecards, portfolio reporting, and value realization insights.
  • Present findings and recommendations to leadership, governance committees, and investment review forums.
  • Communicate realized value, emerging risks, and opportunities to improve portfolio outcomes.

Team Leadership & Capability Development (10%)

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of value realization professionals.
  • Establish repeatable tools, templates, and operating practices.
  • Drive maturity of the firm's benefits realization discipline and promote a culture of value accountability.

Success Measures

  • Benefits and value metrics defined before investment approval.
  • Clear accountability for benefit ownership across business initiatives.
  • Increased realization of forecasted business benefits.
  • Reduction of value leakage across Digital and AI investments.
  • Improved transparency into portfolio outcomes and investment effectiveness.
  • Increased adoption of value-based decision making across business and technology leadership.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Analytics, MIS, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience considered.
  • 5-7 years of experience in benefits realization, business transformation, portfolio management, value management, business analytics, technology strategy, consulting, transformation, data analytics, or related disciplines.
  • Experience developing business cases, investment analyses, and value realization plans, including ROI, TCO, NPV, payback period, productivity, and operational performance measures.
  • Demonstrated ability to define KPIs/OKR’s, establish baselines, measure outcomes, and validate realization of expected business benefits.
  • Strong analytical, financial, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and executive recommendations.
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders, drive accountability, and lead cross-functional initiatives in complex organizations.
  • Strong communication and executive presentation skills with experience presenting findings and recommendations to senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Digital, AI, Business Transformation, Process Improvement, Enterprise PMO, Technology Financial Management (TBM), or Management Consulting functions.
  • Experience establishing benefits realization frameworks, governance processes, dashboards, scorecards, and executive reporting.
  • Experience measuring adoption, utilization, behavioral change, and business outcomes associated with transformation initiatives.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Excel, Python, or similar analytics and reporting platforms.
  • ACMP, PMP, TBM, Lean Six Sigma, Prosci, or related professional certification.

Key Success Profile

  • Combines strong business acumen, financial discipline, analytical thinking, and executive influence.
  • Able to challenge assumptions, identify value leakage, and validate whether investments are delivering expected outcomes.
  • Focuses on accountability, outcomes, and realization of business value rather than project delivery alone.

Reporting to the Manager of Implementation, we’re seeking an experienced, passionate Implementation Consultant, Materials Management to join our team. This role is an excellent opportunity to contribute to the creation and maintenance of strong client relations throughout the assigned project, leading to the successful software implementation of Multiview Financial Software with a focus on Materials Management.

As an Implementation Consultant, Materials Management, you will play a critical role in helping our clients with their software implementation. You will work directly with clients and internal departments to ensure a successful implementation deliverable within the project scope and budget, providing product recommendations, configurations, and technical guidance for integrations and effective technical solutions.

The responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

  • Being the “go-to” specialist for all things Materials Management.
  • Collaborating with our internal teams for Materials Management implementations.
  • Improving existing implementation practices around Materials Management.
  • Continually improving how our product integrates with third parties.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

At Multiview, being creative with great communication and problem-solving skills is important, but equally so are having a passion for driving client success and the desire to be a contributing member of our culture, where the genuine care of people is our compass.

The successful candidate will be a highly motivated team player, who effectively engages with clients and has prior experience working as a Material Management Specialist within the healthcare industry championing operational tasks using different Materials Management Information Systems (MMIS) or ERP Software.

The Implementation Consultant is an excellent problem solver, communicator and someone who can meet our clients requirements in a fast-paced, growing technology company while maintaining a positive attitude in a technical client-facing function.

The expected salary range for this role is $90,000 to $110,000.00 CAD annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

If this sounds like you, read on!

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Work with new clients to assist them with transitioning from a legacy financial system to Multiview Financial Software.
  • Collaborate with Multiview’s Implementation team, processes, and methodologies in the development, management, and execution of client project plans.
  • Perform detailed analysis, proactively identifying complex business process workflows and requirements to propose appropriate system solutions.
  • Prepare project plans and work with new clients to identify, interpret, validate, and document project requirements and milestones.
  • Map client business requirements, processes, and objectives.
  • Act as liaison with clients for troubleshooting: investigate, analyze, and solve software problems.
  • Continuously strive to improve product integration with third parties.
  • Interact closely with Client Support team to resolve client issues relating to Materials Management.
  • Provide coaching and training to new staff around the utilization of Materials Management.
  • Work with internal departments as a subject matter expert to develop implementation best practices for Materials Management.
  • Support new clients in their go-live process, facilitate technical discussions, whiteboarding for project integrations and technical solutions.
  • Document and manage project deliverables, risks, and actions.
  • Provide regular Implementation status reports to key stakeholders, highlighting critical issues and the overall status of assigned projects; investigating and making recommendations on issues that challenge scope boundaries.
  • Maintain a highly detail-oriented view of client project plans, while exercising good interpersonal and organizational skills to develop strong client relationships.

Role Summary

The Senior Microsoft Dynamics GP Consultant serves as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for clients utilizing Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains) across a variety of industries. This role is responsible for providing functional consulting, application support, troubleshooting, solution design, and business process optimization for Dynamics GP and related third-party applications.

Working directly with clients, the consultant will help resolve complex business and system challenges, recommend best practices, support upgrades and enhancements, and ensure clients maximize the value of their Dynamics GP investment. This is a highly client-facing role requiring strong consulting skills, deep Dynamics GP expertise, and the ability to build trusted relationships with stakeholders across finance, operations, sales, customer service, and leadership teams. In partnership with Deel’s recruitment platform, we are seeking a Senior Microsoft Dynamics GP Consultant based in LATAM for a remote Contractor of Record (COR) or Employer of Record (EOR) engagement. Candidates must be available to work during EST or CST business hours.

Position Responsibilities

Dynamics GP Consulting & Client Advisory

  • Serve as a functional expert for Microsoft Dynamics GP, providing guidance and recommendations to clients across multiple industries.
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective Dynamics GP solutions.
  • Lead solution design sessions, business process reviews, and system optimization initiatives.
  • Assist clients with system enhancements, upgrades, module implementations, and process improvements.
  • Recommend best practices that improve operational efficiency, reporting accuracy, and data integrity.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships by providing exceptional service and trusted advice.

Application Support & Issue Resolution

Business Process Optimization

Third-Party Applications & Integrations

raw.excerpt: About CloudtraceFounded in 2018, Cloudtrace specialises in providing offensive and defensive cyber security services for public cloud environments.
raw.description:
About Cloudtrace

Founded in 2018, Cloudtrace specialises in providing offensive and defensive cyber security services for public cloud environments. Our service offerings include penetration testing, red/purple teaming, 24/7 managed security services, PCI DSS QSA assessments and incident response.

Cloudtrace is a PCI Security Standards Council (SSC) Qualified Security Assessor Company (QSAC), a CREST accredited penetration testing provider and ISO 27001 certified by the British Standards Institution (BSI). Amazon Web Services (AWS) has designated Cloudtrace as an Advanced Tier Services partner with the Level 1 Managed Security Services Provider Competency and recognised us as the 2024 AWS Rising Star Consulting Partner of the Year for Australia and New Zealand.

Our Values

Customers are our compass:Our customers drive our decision-making processes. We are dedicated to our mission of protecting them and work backwards from that.

We get things done:When we work on something we own it. We love solving difficult challenges and we never make excuses. We know time is valuable and we don’t waste it.

We are constantly learning:Our team is passionate about what we do and are hungry for knowledge. It excites us that the work we do lets us learn more every day.

We are creators:There is always a better way and we are obsessed with continually improving how we do things. Invention is in our DNA and we are all about rewriting the rules.

We take pride in our work:If a job’s worth doing its worth doing well. We pay attention to detail, deliver quality and encourage each other to be the best at what we do.

Why Join Us

Here's why passionate cyber professionals choose to work with us:

We make a real difference:The work we do directly protects the global community from cybercriminals, making the digital world a safer place.

We are at the forefront of innovation: Our customers are some of the brightest stars in technology and we work closely with them to secure their cloud-native platforms.

We are shaping the future of threat detection:We are crafting a cloud-native threat detection service that changes the way modern application environments are protected.

We unlock potential with continuous learning: We invest in career growth with training programs, attendance at security conferences, and mentorship from cloud security experts.

We are a collaborative fast-paced team:Our team is made up of experts in the industry who share a passion for cyber security and building innovative technology.

The Role

We are looking for a technical lead to join our fast-growing Threat Detection and Response (TDR) team and help us forge a next-generation cloud native managed security service. This role would suit someone currently in a senior security operations or DevOps role that is looking to take the next step in their career and become an expert in cloud security.

Our philosophy is that solid defense requires intimate knowledge of offensive tactics. Our managed security service leverages our penetration testing and red team expertise to ensure our TDR team is across current cyber-attack techniques. This, combined with our cloud-native tooling and deep understanding of AWS services, allows us to deliver best-in-class protection for AWS customer environments.

The successful candidate will work closely with our experienced offensive security and incident response teams to understand the latest TTPs used in real world breaches. That knowledge will be used to continually improve our next generation threat detection service and protect our customers from cyber-attacks. Cloudtrace customers include start-ups, scale-ups, enterprises and state/federal government agencies, giving this role exposure to a range of technologies and industry sectors.

Your Responsibilities

Our in-house SIEM platform, built on Amazon Security Lake, ingests telemetry from AWS services, endpoint security products and third-party SaaS vendors. You be working with our team to continuously improve the detection and investigation capabilities of the platform. You will use findings from our offensive team engagements and MITRE ATT&CK® Matrices to detect the latest threat IOCs and TTPs used by highly skilled adversaries.

You will be responding to alerts generated by our SIEM platform and investigating complex attack chains to ensure breaches are rapidly discovered and contained. Using penetration testing techniques, you will also validate any security exposures detected by our Attack Surface Management (ASM) platform and review the security of new customer assets identified by the platform discovery engine.

Your Typical Day

This is not a typical SOC role where you wait for SIEM alerts to come through, you will be constantly applying your current skillset across different areas and learning new skills every day. A typical day will include enhancing the capabilities of our TDR service, using exploit POCs to validate real cyber threats, and giving security advice to customers in shared slack channels.

Your daily activities will include the following:

Investigating and responding to potential cyber threats

  • Ownership through to resolution of alerts generated by our SIEM and ASM platforms
  • Liaising with customers to provide updates on alert investigation status
  • Escalating to our offensive security team for validation of complex exposures
  • Closing alerts with investigation outcomes once appropriate action has been taken
  • Review of new assets discovered by our ASM platform and assessing exposure risk

Developing high signal threat detection rules

  • Tuning existing rules to reduce false positive rates
  • Developing new rules to search and alert on threat activity
  • Engaging our offensive security team for rule testing

Managing a best-in-class cloud TDR solution

  • Updating event ingestion pipelines to enrich data for threat detection rules
  • Monitoring CloudWatch metrics and modifying AWS service configurations as required
  • Reviewing OpenSearch metrics and modifying index configurations as required
  • Developing and maintaining runbooks that improve our threat detection processes
  • Automation of routine tasks such as filtering low-priority alerts and sending notifications

You will also be using your client facing and engineering skills to work collaboratively with the broader team on projects and periodic reporting. These activities will include:

  • Assistance with onboarding of new clients to our TDR and ASM platforms
  • Integration of new log sources for existing TDR clients
  • Generation of reports for our managed service clients
  • Presentation of report content to our managed service clients

Your Experience

You will need 5+ years’ experience in the following areas:

  • Cyber security operations covering endpoints and cloud services
  • Tuning SIEM rules for accurate threat detection

Your Skills

The following base technical skills are required for this role:

Endpoint Security

Understanding of endpoint cyber threats and attack vectors including:

  • Malware (e.g. Ransomware)
  • Adversary in the Middle Attacks

Network Protocols

Understanding of common internet protocols, including:

  • TCP/IP
  • HTTP
  • DNS
  • TLS

AWS

Configuration of basic AWS services via console and CLI, including:

  • EC2 Instances
  • Security Groups
  • IAM Permissions

Data Analysis

  • Ability to write data queries using syntax such as SQL, DSL, KQL or ES|QL
  • Ability to extract relevant data in spreadsheets using formulas and functions

Linux

  • Command line navigation and file operations
  • Scripting for automation using Bash and Python

The following non-technical skills are required for this role:

  • Clear communication of technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Problem solving and critical thinking to approach problems from different angles and identify potential solutions
  • Ability to independently find information from internet resources and use that to solve complex problems
  • Strong organisational skills with the proven ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to make quick decisions under pressure, weighing risks and benefits to choose the best course of action
  • Ability to interpret data, identify patterns, and draw conclusions from complex information

raw.description:
Remote (Pakistan preferred) · Full-time

🧭 About the role

iClosed.io is a SaaS platform for sales and marketing teams, scaling to millions of users. This role sits in our Performance Team and owns the performance and scalability of our Node.js/TypeScript backend services and data layer.

We believe the biggest gains come from design, not just tuning: matching each store to its access pattern, moving work off the critical path, and drawing service boundaries that scale cleanly. You'll solve the problem in front of you, then shape the architecture so whole classes of problems never come up.

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, high autonomy and significant technical influence.

🔀 How the work splits

You'll own performance across three connected areas, with genuine depth expected in both system design and data-layer internals:

  • Design: how a request flows, what runs synchronously, where state lives, and what happens when a dependency is slow.
  • Diagnosis: reading traces, execution plans and metrics to find the real cause rather than the obvious one.
  • Prevention: instrumentation, review standards and regression gates, so issues are caught long before they reach customers.

🎯 What you'll do

  • Lead the design of high-traffic flows end to end, keeping them fast under load and resilient when dependencies fail.
  • Diagnose latency across the full request path using traces, execution plans and metrics.
  • Match each workload to the right data store, and document the reasoning.
  • Scale reads and writes through caching, replicas, partitioning, sharding and queue-buffered writes.
  • Build reliable background processing on SQS and EventBridge with idempotency, retries, dead letters and backpressure.
  • Eliminate N+1 queries and chatty data access, including inefficient queries generated by ORMs such as Prisma and Mongoose.
  • Own data-layer capacity planning and cost per request alongside latency.
  • Set engineering standards: design and query review for hot paths, migration standards, CI regression gates, and load testing at production-realistic volumes.
  • Review architecture proposals from feature teams, and write the design docs others build from.

🧑‍💻 Who we're looking for

Required

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with 3+ where performance and scale were a named part of your job.
  • Performance ownership of a multi-tenant SaaS product under real load.
  • Systems you designed yourself, including the alternatives you rejected and the tradeoffs you accepted.
  • A concrete track record: a problem you diagnosed, its root cause, your fix, and the before-and-after numbers.
  • Strong system design judgement across caching, sharding, CQRS, queues, real-time delivery (WebSockets/SSE), autoscaling, high availability and resilience patterns. Knowing when not to use one matters more to us than listing its benefits.
  • Real depth in at least two of PostgreSQL/MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB and Redis, with working competence in the rest.
  • Production ownership of Node.js/TypeScript services, and a solid understanding of how ORMs and ODMs such as Prisma and Mongoose generate queries.
  • Hands-on Datadog APM and tracing experience (or equivalent), plus production experience on AWS (ECS/EKS), including the cost behaviour of managed data services.
  • Clear writing: design docs a team can build from and an executive can follow.

🗄️ Data layer depth

Nobody is deep in all four engines, and we'd rather you tell us where you are. Across your areas of depth, we expect you to reason about:

  • Relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL): execution plans as routine, composite and partial indexes and their write cost, locking, isolation levels, connection pooling and replica lag.
  • Document (MongoDB): embedding vs referencing, shard key selection, aggregation performance and working set sizing.
  • Key-value: access-pattern-first modelling, partition keys, hot partition avoidance, secondary indexes and capacity cost.
  • In-memory cache (Redis/Memcached): caching patterns, key design, eviction and TTL, and system behaviour when the cache is cold or unavailable.
  • Across engines: consistency boundaries, dual-write problems, and recognising when a query problem is really an application design problem.

🌟 What success looks like

  • Diagnosis: latency is attributed to real causes with evidence, and per-tenant investigations end with clear answers.
  • Design: critical paths have documented designs others can reason about, store selection is deliberate and written down, and queues behave predictably under load.
  • Measurable improvement: meaningful latency reduction on the highest-cost paths, with before-and-after numbers, and cost per request trending down.
  • Prevention: design and query review is standard practice for hot paths, regressions are caught before merge, and migration standards are followed across teams.
  • Partnership: feature teams bring you proposals early because you make them better, not slower.

➕ Nice to have

APM, error tracking and database performance tooling using tools like Datadog and Sentry · event streaming or messaging at scale · real-time delivery and fan-out at scale (Socket.IO) · third-party integrations where latency is outside your control · noisy-neighbour and tenant isolation · load testing tools and building that capability · SLOs and error budgets · infrastructure as code

🚫 What this role is not

  • Not a DBA role. Backups, patching and routine operations sit with DevOps. You set the performance requirements.
  • Not feature work. Your output is latency removed and regressions prevented.
  • Not a management role today. Leading the function as it grows is an open conversation.

💎 Why join

  • Shape the performance function and its priorities from day one.
  • Have direct influence on architecture across every engineering team.
  • Work on a polyglot stack at real scale.

📋 Practicalities

  • Location: Remote (Pakistan preferred)
  • Type: Full-time, permanent
  • Level: Senior individual contributor, no direct reports
  • Compensation: Market competitive
  • On-call: Part of the escalation rota
Salary: Market Competitive

Today, BHG Financial has firmly established  its legacy as a leader in the financial services space. Founded on the philosophy of a better way to borrow, we are dedicated to helping accomplished professionals, small businesses, and institutions build upon their success through innovative financial solutions, a hassle-free process, and personalized concierge service.
Our relentless commitment to the success of our customers is part of what has made BHG Financial thrive. We take a 360-degree view of our customers to tailor the best solutions for their financial aspirations. Today's professionals have multiple sources of income, not just their paycheck. Therefore, it is essential to factor those in when making responsible lending decisions. Our continued focus on data, analytics, and proprietary modeling has enabled faster funding for our customers.

Key Responsibilities

Medical Biller & Coder 3 (Team B)
