Remote LATAM role. Compensation listed in USD with local currency equivalent. This particular role is a Peru-based independent contractor engagement.

ABOUT FREEDOM HEALTH SYSTEMS, INC:

Freedom Health Systems, Inc. is a mission-driven healthcare advisory and management consulting firm that partners with behavioral health and human services organizations to improve access, equity, and operational excellence. We specialize in guiding providers through program development, accreditation, compliance, and clinical best practices.

While Freedom Health Systems does not provide direct clinical services, the organization delivers critical operational support through revenue cycle management, prior authorization, medical billing and coding, compliance consulting, and administrative services to outpatient behavioral health providers.

DISCLOSURES:

This document defines the scope of work and service expectations for an independent contractor engagement and does not create an employment relationship. Scope, deliverables, tools, priorities, and assignments may be modified through written amendment based on client needs, regulatory requirements, or contractual obligations.

COMPANY INFORMATION

COMPANY WEBSITE:

COMPANY PHONE NUMBER: 667-239-9572

HUMAN RESOURCES PHONE: 667-239-9572 EXT 10

HUMAN RESOURCES EMAIL:

SERVICE TITLE:

Medical Biller & Coder 3 (Team B)

ALTERNATE SERVICE TITLES:

Medical Billing Specialist (Contractor)

Medical Coding Specialist (Contractor)

CONTRACTING ENTITY:

Freedom Health Systems, Inc.

(In support of outpatient mental health center clients under contract)

DIVISION: Accounting & Finance

DEPARTMENT: Accounts Receivables

UNIT: Medical Billing & Coding (Revenue Cycle Management Services)

BENEFITS PACKAGE: Not applicable (Independent Contractor)

SERVICE HOURS:

Monday – Friday, aligned with U.S. Eastern Time business hours
(8:00 AM EST – 5:00 PM EST or as otherwise contractually agreed)

REPORTING & COORDINATION:

The contractor will coordinate daily service delivery with the Medical Billing & Coding Analyst 2 (Team Lead – Team B). Escalations, risks, or unresolved issues will be routed through the Team Lead to the Accounts Receivables Department Manager as required.

CONTRACT CLASSIFICATION: W8BEN – Independent Contractor

COMPENSATION RANGE

USD $5.00–$6.50 (≈ PEN 18.5–24/hr)

ANTICIPATED TRAVEL: None

SCOPE OF ASSIGNMENT

This scope of work applies to Team, supporting one or more outpatient mental health center clients. The Medical Biller & Coder is responsible for executing accurate, compliant, and timely billing and coding services to support end-to-end revenue cycle operations.

SUMMARY OF CONTRACT SCOPE

The Medical Biller & Coder provides medical billing and coding services for outpatient mental health center clients. This includes translating clinical documentation into accurate diagnosis and procedure codes, entering charges, submitting claims, correcting errors, and supporting accounts receivable workflows.

All services are performed under the functional oversight and quality review of the Medical Billing & Coding Analyst 2 (Team Lead – Team B) and are a critical component of the Revenue Cycle Management process.

CORE SCOPE OF WORK & DELIVERABLES

  • Review clinical documentation to confirm required elements are present prior to billing (signed notes, treatment plans, service dates, units, provider credentials)
  • Assign accurate CPT, ICD-10-CM, and applicable HCPCS codes based on documentation
  • Enter charges accurately into the EHR or billing system
  • Submit claims timely and in compliance with payer-specific requirements
  • Verify patient demographics, insurance information, and payer details prior to claim submission
  • Identify and correct claim rejections, coding errors, and data entry issues
  • Support denial resolution activities by correcting coding or documentation issues as directed
  • Ensure all services rendered are captured and billed; escalate suspected missed charges
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready billing records and supporting documentation
  • Adhere to workflows, quality standards, and productivity expectations established by the Team Lead
  • Communicate documentation gaps, authorization issues, or system barriers promptly to the Team Lead

UNSCHEDULED / SUPPORT DUTIES

  • Assist with billing backlogs or high-volume periods
  • Support internal quality assurance reviews and audits
  • Participate in training, coaching, and cross-training activities
  • Provide coverage for essential billing tasks during team member absences
  • Support process improvement initiatives related to billing accuracy and turnaround time

TECHNOLOGY, DATA SECURITY & MONITORING REQUIREMENTS

  • All work must be performed exclusively on the assigned Amazon Workstation (AWS virtual workstation) authorized by Freedom Health Systems.
  • Use of personal devices, local storage, screenshots, external email forwarding, or unauthorized systems is strictly prohibited.
  • The Amazon Workstation environment is monitored by the Company for security, compliance, productivity, and quality assurance purposes.
  • System access logs, activity monitoring, and usage metrics may be reviewed to ensure compliance with HIPAA, client contracts, and Company policies.
  • Failure to comply with technology, security, or monitoring requirements may result in immediate termination of the contract.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Service quality and contract effectiveness will be evaluated using, but not limited to, the following KPIs:

  • Coding accuracy rate
  • Charge entry accuracy and completeness
  • Clean claim submission rate
  • Claim rejection rate
  • Timeliness of claim submission
  • Error correction and resubmission turnaround time
  • Audit findings and error trends
  • Adherence to established workflows and instructions
  • Responsiveness to Team Lead requests and escalations

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Continuous use of EHR and billing platforms
  • Frequent virtual communication via chat, phone, or video

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Fully remote (Peru-based) via assigned Amazon Workstation
  • Production-driven, deadline-oriented revenue cycle environment
  • Collaboration across time zones with U.S.-based leadership and client operations

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERTISE

  • Minimum 2–4 years of U.S. medical billing and coding experience
  • Outpatient mental health or behavioral health billing experience preferred
  • Working knowledge of CPT, ICD-10-CM, and basic HCPCS coding
  • Familiarity with U.S. insurance, Medicaid, and managed care billing processes
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to follow defined workflows and quality standards
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Experience working in secure virtual workstation environments preferred
  • Professional coding certifications (CPC or equivalent) preferred
Salary: USD $5.00–$6.50 (≈ PEN 18.5–24/hr)

Solon entreprend de bâtir un système de développement des joueurs de football à travers l'Afrique de l'Ouest - en éliminant les barrières structurelles pour permettre aux talents émergents du continent de s'épanouir. Lancé au Ghana en avril 2024, nous poursuivons la mise en en œuvre de la première phase de ce projet : un programme gratuit de formation de base au football pour les garçons et les filles à partir de l'âge de 6 ans, réparti dans les écoles primaires de chaque marché cible en Afrique de l'Ouest. La Sénégal est notre prochain marché cible.

Nous recherchons un responsable de programme expérimenté et proactif pour soutenir l'intention de Solon de mettre en œuvre cette phase initiale de notre programme de développement des joueurs de football en Sénégal. Le rôle consistera à travailler avec une équipe soudée pour évaluer et développer les opportunités de mise en œuvre du programme. Vous rejoindrez une équipe collégiale, collaborative et curieuse.

Responsabilités :

Le candidat idéal adoptera une approche pratique pour gérer avec succès divers groupes de travail afin d'évaluer la Sénégal en tant que nouveau marché pour la mise en place de notre programme de développement des joueurs de football. Il devra travailler en étroite collaboration avec les communautés, le gouvernement et d'autres partenaires pour résoudre les problèmes et faire avancer les différentes initiatives et étapes du projet. Il s'agira également d'être capable de répondre avec enthousiasme à un ensemble de demandes et de défis rapides et variés.

Quelques exemples de responsabilités :

  • Évaluation des opportunités. Identifier et évaluer les possibilités de partenariat avec les établissements scolaires en Sénégal afin de mettre en place la première phase de notre programme de développement des joueurs de football - un programme de formation de base au football pour les garçons et les filles à partir de l'âge de 6 ans, réparti dans les écoles primaires existantes.
  • Mise en œuvre du programme. En coordination avec l'équipe de Solon, mettre en œuvre et développer le programme de formation de base au football avec les propriétaires et réseaux d'écoles primaires identifiés en Sénégal y compris l’éducation nationale ; assurer une supervision efficace pour veiller à ce que le programme réponde aux normes et aux objectifs de Solon.
  • Engagement des parties prenantes. Établir et entretenir des relations avec les principales parties prenantes, notamment les prestataires de services, les représentants du gouvernement, les partenaires donateurs, les consultants et les membres des communautés. Collaborez avec les potentiels partenaires locaux, les experts du secteur et d’autres parties prenantes pour recueillir des informations et promouvoir les intérêts de Solon.
  • Rapports et évaluation. Préparer des rapports détaillés et des présentations pour l’équipe d’encadrement de Solon afin de faciliter les processus de prise de décision.
  • Gestion de projets. Gérer les délais, les ressources et les délivrables pour les projets désignés. Veiller à ce que toutes les activités du projet respectent les normes et les objectifs de Solon, en produisant des résultats dans les délais et le respect des budgets établis.

Qualifications :

Les qualifications de base pour cette mission sont les suivantes

  • Diplôme bac +4 en administration des affaires ; Sciences économiques ; Relations internationales ; école de commerce ou domaines connexes.
  • Expérience avérée en développement commercial ou dans un rôle similaire, de préférence en Sénégal ou sur des marchés similaires.
  • Solides compétences en communication écrite et orale, y compris la préparation de rapports de projet détaillés et la présentation à un public diversifié.
  • Superbe attention aux détails et application au travail
  • Capacité à travailler efficacement dans un environnement d'équipe multiculturelle et en rapide évolution.
  • Solides compétences interpersonnelles et aptitudes à la résolution de problèmes.
  • Connaissance approfondie de la culture, des coutumes et des pratiques commerciales de la Sénégal.
  • Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (à l'oral et à l'écrit).
  • Intégrité, bonne capacité de jugement et sens des affaires.
  • Bonne présence et comportement professionnel.
  • Capacité à résider et travailler légalement en Sénégal.
  • Passion ou intérêt pour le football

Une expérience et/ou des connaissances dans les domaines du football, de l'éducation, ainsi que des initiatives de développement de projets dans ces domaines sont souhaitables.

Nature de l'engagement : un engagement contractuel de 6 mois dont la durée peut être prolongée et évoluer plus tard vers un rôle à temps plein au sein de la société.

Horaires de travail : Prendre en compte des possibilités de devoir assister en virtuel à des réunions à des heures de bureau standard de plusieurs fuseaux horaires, en particulier l’Amérique du Nord et le Pakistan.

Lieu de travail : Ce rôle exige que le candidat réside en Sénégal. Il s’agit d’un rôle à distance dans la mesure où la plupart des supérieurs hiérarchiques et collaborateurs seront basés hors de Sénégal. Des déplacements dans toute l'Afrique de l'Ouest peuvent être nécessaires, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels dans le monde entier.

Rémunération : Solon est une organisation de choix qui propose des rémunérations compétitives ainsi que des bonus basés sur les performances et l’atteinte des objectifs.

Job Description Summary:

The Systems Analyst Epic supports the design, build, testing, training, deployment, and ongoing support of Epic applications to optimize clinical and operational workflows. This position develops knowledge of healthcare workflows, system integration, and project delivery practices while partnering with operational leaders and end users to translate business requirements into reliable Epic configuration, integrations, and reporting—supporting safe patient care, efficient revenue cycle operations, and regulatory compliance while meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for supported applications. Works under guidance of senior analysts, architects, and technical leads to follow standards that safeguard the integrity and security of the application environment and contribute to continuous improvement activities related to application management for Epic and related third-party applications. The System Analyst Epic encompasses two closely related role focus areas: Application Build and Application Training. While responsibilities are similar, emphasis may vary based on team assignments.

Responsibilities And Duties:

Both Roles

System Analysis and Design:

Engage stakeholders to gather and refine requirements, map current-state workflows, and design Epic build that aligns with operational goals and policy.
Create and maintain specifications, decision logs, and design documents for clear traceability and change control.
Conduct gap analyses to identify configuration or workflow changes needed for upgrades, regulatory changes, or new initiatives.

Project Management:
Support small projects and enhancements related to system implementations and upgrades under the guidance of senior team members.
Working knowledge of common project approaches (e.g., waterfall, agile) and ability to follow the established methodology.
Participate on project teams and apply agreed project methodology to deliver assigned tasks on time.

Training and Documentation:
Create and maintain documentation for system configurations, workflows, and support procedures, following team standards.

Application Build Role
Application Build, Configuration, and Deployment:
Configure records, master files, and tools (e.g., profiles, rules, security classes, workflows) aligned to approved design.
Maintain environment parity and adhere to change management and build naming conventions.
Develop and execute unit, integrated, and UAT test plans; log and resolve defects; document test evidence.
Validate interfaces, printing, reporting, and downstream workflows; confirm regression coverage in upgrades.
Coordinate release management, environment moves, and downtime procedures for upgrades and patches.
Provide go-live and post-live hypercare, including rounding, office hours, tip sheets, and at-the-elbow support.
Manage service requests and incidents in a timely manner; meet SLAs through effective triage, documentation, and root-cause analysis with guidance as needed.
Provide support for Epic and other enterprise applications as assigned. Collaborate with IT and operational teams to understand cross-application impacts and support integrated workflows (e.g., Epic and third-party applications).

Integration and Data Management:
Collaborate with interface teams on HL7, FHIR, PDFs, CCD/CCDA, and other exchange workflows.
Partner with analytics teams on Clarity/Caboodle extracts, registries, and operational reporting needs.
Ensure data integrity and metric definitions are consistent across modules and stakeholders. Compliance & Risk:
Support regulatory readiness (e.g., CMS, Joint Commission), audit needs, and policy alignment.
Embed privacy/security controls, including sensitive record handling and audit trails.
Contribute to ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change, and configuration management processes.

Application Training Role
Curriculum Management:
Support the design and delivery of role-based training aligned with operational workflows and organizational standards
Support maintenance and updates to the CareConnect curriculum in partnership with training leadership
Help ensure curriculum accuracy and consistency by following established build and validation processes
Incorporate learner and stakeholder feedback into curriculum updates and continuous improvement efforts
Support build, maintenance, and readiness activities for training environments under established standards
Communicate system releases and upgrade impacts to training stakeholders using approved channels and templates

Request/Incident Management
Manage end‑user training‑related requests and incidents with professionalism and efficiency
Support triage and resolution of requests within established service expectations, escalating as appropriate
Document incidents and resolutions to support a comprehensive knowledge base
Collaborate with IT and operational partners to identify trends and recommend preventative improvements
Contribute to support process improvements to enhance service quality and user experience

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree

Additional Job Description:

  • degree in computer science, Information Technology, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 1-3 years of experience in system/application analysis, support, or related IT experience (healthcare environment preferred).
  • In lieu of degree, 5+ years of experience in system/application analysis, support, or related IT experience (healthcare environment preferred).

SPECIALIZED KNOWLEDGE

Required for Both Roles:

• Experience with Epic application(s) and healthcare workflows (clinical, revenue cycle or IT experience).

• Strong requirements gathering, workflow design, and testing skills.

• Familiarity with ITIL, change control, SDLC practices, system governance, and waterfall/agile project methodologies.

  • Ability to communicate with clinical, operational stakeholders, and managed service providers and produce clear documentation.

• Demonstrated ability to support small to medium initiatives and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Requirements for Application Training role:

  • Epic Training Environment Build certification/proficiency (or ability to obtain within required timeframe) and 1+ year of training environment build or application support experience.
  • Epic Principal Trainer certification(s) preferred (or ability to obtain within the required timeframe).

Preferred for Application Build role:

Current Epic Certification or Proficiency in one or more relevant module(s) (e.g., HB, PB, Cadence, Referrals, Orders, ClinDoc, Clarity).

• 1+ year of Epic build/configuration experience preferred (or demonstrated ability to learn and apply build standards quickly).

• Exposure to system integration concepts (e.g., HL7, FHIR) and interface testing is preferred.

• Exposure to reporting and data concepts (e.g., Clarity/Caboodle, SlicerDicer, Reporting Workbench, Radar) is preferred.

• Prior work in patient access, billing, coding, finance, or clinical operations (for respective modules).

DESIRED ATTRIBUTES

  • ITIL Foundation certification desired not required.
  • Certifications in one or more Epic applications
  • Experience in a large healthcare system or hospital setting.
  • Experience with other healthcare applications and systems.
  • Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards.
  • Familiarity with cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure).
  • Experience with business intelligence and analytics tools.

Job Description:

As a QA Engineer, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to develop and execute test plans, identify defects, and ensure that our applications meet the highest standards of quality before they are released to customers.

Responsibilities:

  1. Collaborate with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to understand product requirements and user stories.
  2. Develop comprehensive test plans and test cases based on functional and non-functional requirements.
  3. Execute manual and automated tests to validate the functionality, usability, and performance of software applications.
  4. Identify and document defects with detailed steps to reproduce, and track them through resolution using bug tracking systems.
  5. Participate in design and code reviews to provide feedback on testability and potential quality issues.
  6. Maintain and expand automated test suites using appropriate tools and frameworks.
  7. Perform regression testing to ensure that software changes do not introduce new defects.
  8. Set up and manage test environments and test data to support testing activities.
  9. Monitor and analyze test results, identify trends, and communicate findings to stakeholders.
  10. Continuously learn and stay current with industry trends, tools, and best practices in software quality assurance.

Qualifications:

  1. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  2. Proven experience in software quality assurance, including manual and automated testing.
  3. Strong understanding of QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
  4. Experience with test automation tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, JUnit, TestNG).
  5. Proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language such as Java, Python, JavaScript, or Ruby.
  6. Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
  7. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
  8. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  9. Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies is a plus.
  10. ISTQB or other relevant certifications are desirable but not required.

raw.description:
Contexte de l'entreprise :

Solon Capital Partners (« Solon ») crée, s'associe et investit pour générer des rendements financiers et un impact significatif. Fort de plus de 13 années d'expérience, Solon s’appuie sur un modèle différencié basé sur la création d'entreprise, le partenariat et la patience pour maximiser l'ampleur de l'impact et les rendements financiers tout en atténuant les risques. Solon poursuit sa double mission envers le climat et les communautés à travers un portefeuille d'entreprises innovantes opérant désormais dans trois secteurs verticaux d'impact et neuf pays en Afrique et au-delà.

Terra Nova Solutions (« TNS ») est une société du groupe Solon qui agit en tant que fournisseur de services pour Solon. TNS est une société de services professionnels qui renforce les capacités de ses clients au sein des marchés Africains, y compris ceux avec des défis importants. TNS fournit une gamme de services de finance, de conformité, de consultant et de conseil dans plusieurs secteurs et zones géographiques en Afrique subsaharienne.

L'opportunité :

Solon entreprend de bâtir un système de développement des joueurs de football à travers l'Afrique de l'Ouest - en éliminant les barrières structurelles pour permettre aux talents émergents du continent de s'épanouir. Lancé au Ghana en avril 2024, nous poursuivons la mise en en œuvre de la première phase de ce projet : un programme gratuit de formation de base au football pour les garçons et les filles à partir de l'âge de 6 ans, réparti dans les écoles primaires de chaque marché cible en Afrique de l'Ouest. La Sénégal est notre prochain marché cible.

Nous recherchons un responsable de programme expérimenté et proactif pour soutenir l'intention de Solon de mettre en œuvre cette phase initiale de notre programme de développement des joueurs de football en Sénégal. Le rôle consistera à travailler avec une équipe soudée pour évaluer et développer les opportunités de mise en œuvre du programme. Vous rejoindrez une équipe collégiale, collaborative et curieuse.

Responsabilités :

Le candidat idéal adoptera une approche pratique pour gérer avec succès divers groupes de travail afin d'évaluer la Sénégal en tant que nouveau marché pour la mise en place de notre programme de développement des joueurs de football. Il devra travailler en étroite collaboration avec les communautés, le gouvernement et d'autres partenaires pour résoudre les problèmes et faire avancer les différentes initiatives et étapes du projet. Il s'agira également d'être capable de répondre avec enthousiasme à un ensemble de demandes et de défis rapides et variés.

Quelques exemples de responsabilités :

  • Évaluation des opportunités. Identifier et évaluer les possibilités de partenariat avec les établissements scolaires en Sénégal afin de mettre en place la première phase de notre programme de développement des joueurs de football - un programme de formation de base au football pour les garçons et les filles à partir de l'âge de 6 ans, réparti dans les écoles primaires existantes.
  • Mise en œuvre du programme. En coordination avec l'équipe de Solon, mettre en œuvre et développer le programme de formation de base au football avec les propriétaires et réseaux d'écoles primaires identifiés en Sénégal y compris l’éducation nationale ; assurer une supervision efficace pour veiller à ce que le programme réponde aux normes et aux objectifs de Solon.
  • Engagement des parties prenantes. Établir et entretenir des relations avec les principales parties prenantes, notamment les prestataires de services, les représentants du gouvernement, les partenaires donateurs, les consultants et les membres des communautés. Collaborez avec les potentiels partenaires locaux, les experts du secteur et d’autres parties prenantes pour recueillir des informations et promouvoir les intérêts de Solon.
  • Rapports et évaluation. Préparer des rapports détaillés et des présentations pour l’équipe d’encadrement de Solon afin de faciliter les processus de prise de décision.
  • Gestion de projets. Gérer les délais, les ressources et les délivrables pour les projets désignés. Veiller à ce que toutes les activités du projet respectent les normes et les objectifs de Solon, en produisant des résultats dans les délais et le respect des budgets établis.

Qualifications :

Les qualifications de base pour cette mission sont les suivantes

  • Diplôme bac +4 en administration des affaires ; Sciences économiques ; Relations internationales ; école de commerce ou domaines connexes.
  • Expérience avérée en développement commercial ou dans un rôle similaire, de préférence en Sénégal ou sur des marchés similaires.
  • Solides compétences en communication écrite et orale, y compris la préparation de rapports de projet détaillés et la présentation à un public diversifié.
  • Superbe attention aux détails et application au travail
  • Capacité à travailler efficacement dans un environnement d'équipe multiculturelle et en rapide évolution.
  • Solides compétences interpersonnelles et aptitudes à la résolution de problèmes.
  • Connaissance approfondie de la culture, des coutumes et des pratiques commerciales de la Sénégal.
  • Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (à l'oral et à l'écrit).
  • Intégrité, bonne capacité de jugement et sens des affaires.
  • Bonne présence et comportement professionnel.
  • Capacité à résider et travailler légalement en Sénégal.
  • Passion ou intérêt pour le football

Une expérience et/ou des connaissances dans les domaines du football, de l'éducation, ainsi que des initiatives de développement de projets dans ces domaines sont souhaitables.

Nature de l'engagement : un engagement contractuel de 6 mois dont la durée peut être prolongée et évoluer plus tard vers un rôle à temps plein au sein de la société.

Horaires de travail : Prendre en compte des possibilités de devoir assister en virtuel à des réunions à des heures de bureau standard de plusieurs fuseaux horaires, en particulier l’Amérique du Nord et le Pakistan.

Lieu de travail : Ce rôle exige que le candidat réside en Sénégal. Il s’agit d’un rôle à distance dans la mesure où la plupart des supérieurs hiérarchiques et collaborateurs seront basés hors de Sénégal. Des déplacements dans toute l'Afrique de l'Ouest peuvent être nécessaires, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels dans le monde entier.

Rémunération : Solon est une organisation de choix qui propose des rémunérations compétitives ainsi que des bonus basés sur les performances et l’atteinte des objectifs.

Salary: Compétitives

We are more than a health system. We are a belief system. We believe wellness and sickness are both part of a lifelong partnership, and that everyone could use an expert guide. We work hard, care deeply and reach further to help people uncover their own power to be healthy. We inspire hope. We learn, grow, and achieve more – in our careers and in our communities.

Job Description Summary:

The Systems Analyst Epic supports the design, build, testing, training, deployment, and ongoing support of Epic applications to optimize clinical and operational workflows. This position develops knowledge of healthcare workflows, system integration, and project delivery practices while partnering with operational leaders and end users to translate business requirements into reliable Epic configuration, integrations, and reporting—supporting safe patient care, efficient revenue cycle operations, and regulatory compliance while meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for supported applications. Works under guidance of senior analysts, architects, and technical leads to follow standards that safeguard the integrity and security of the application environment and contribute to continuous improvement activities related to application management for Epic and related third-party applications. The System Analyst Epic encompasses two closely related role focus areas: Application Build and Application Training. While responsibilities are similar, emphasis may vary based on team assignments.

Responsibilities And Duties:

Both Roles

System Analysis and Design:

Engage stakeholders to gather and refine requirements, map current-state workflows, and design Epic build that aligns with operational goals and policy.
Create and maintain specifications, decision logs, and design documents for clear traceability and change control.
Conduct gap analyses to identify configuration or workflow changes needed for upgrades, regulatory changes, or new initiatives.

Project Management:
Support small projects and enhancements related to system implementations and upgrades under the guidance of senior team members.
Working knowledge of common project approaches (e.g., waterfall, agile) and ability to follow the established methodology.
Participate on project teams and apply agreed project methodology to deliver assigned tasks on time.

Training and Documentation:
Create and maintain documentation for system configurations, workflows, and support procedures, following team standards.

Application Build Role
Application Build, Configuration, and Deployment:
Configure records, master files, and tools (e.g., profiles, rules, security classes, workflows) aligned to approved design.
Maintain environment parity and adhere to change management and build naming conventions.
Develop and execute unit, integrated, and UAT test plans; log and resolve defects; document test evidence.
Validate interfaces, printing, reporting, and downstream workflows; confirm regression coverage in upgrades.
Coordinate release management, environment moves, and downtime procedures for upgrades and patches.
Provide go-live and post-live hypercare, including rounding, office hours, tip sheets, and at-the-elbow support.
Manage service requests and incidents in a timely manner; meet SLAs through effective triage, documentation, and root-cause analysis with guidance as needed.
Provide support for Epic and other enterprise applications as assigned. Collaborate with IT and operational teams to understand cross-application impacts and support integrated workflows (e.g., Epic and third-party applications).

Integration and Data Management:
Collaborate with interface teams on HL7, FHIR, PDFs, CCD/CCDA, and other exchange workflows.
Partner with analytics teams on Clarity/Caboodle extracts, registries, and operational reporting needs.
Ensure data integrity and metric definitions are consistent across modules and stakeholders. Compliance & Risk:
Support regulatory readiness (e.g., CMS, Joint Commission), audit needs, and policy alignment.
Embed privacy/security controls, including sensitive record handling and audit trails.
Contribute to ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change, and configuration management processes.

Application Training Role
Curriculum Management:
Support the design and delivery of role-based training aligned with operational workflows and organizational standards
Support maintenance and updates to the CareConnect curriculum in partnership with training leadership
Help ensure curriculum accuracy and consistency by following established build and validation processes
Incorporate learner and stakeholder feedback into curriculum updates and continuous improvement efforts
Support build, maintenance, and readiness activities for training environments under established standards
Communicate system releases and upgrade impacts to training stakeholders using approved channels and templates

Request/Incident Management
Manage end‑user training‑related requests and incidents with professionalism and efficiency
Support triage and resolution of requests within established service expectations, escalating as appropriate
Document incidents and resolutions to support a comprehensive knowledge base
Collaborate with IT and operational partners to identify trends and recommend preventative improvements
Contribute to support process improvements to enhance service quality and user experience

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree

Additional Job Description:

  • degree in computer science, Information Technology, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 1-3 years of experience in system/application analysis, support, or related IT experience (healthcare environment preferred).
  • In lieu of degree, 5+ years of experience in system/application analysis, support, or related IT experience (healthcare environment preferred).

SPECIALIZED KNOWLEDGE

Required for Both Roles:

• Experience with Epic application(s) and healthcare workflows (clinical, revenue cycle or IT experience).

• Strong requirements gathering, workflow design, and testing skills.

• Familiarity with ITIL, change control, SDLC practices, system governance, and waterfall/agile project methodologies.

  • Ability to communicate with clinical, operational stakeholders, and managed service providers and produce clear documentation.

• Demonstrated ability to support small to medium initiatives and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Requirements for Application Training role:

  • Epic Training Environment Build certification/proficiency (or ability to obtain within required timeframe) and 1+ year of training environment build or application support experience.
  • Epic Principal Trainer certification(s) preferred (or ability to obtain within the required timeframe).

Preferred for Application Build role:

Current Epic Certification or Proficiency in one or more relevant module(s) (e.g., HB, PB, Cadence, Referrals, Orders, ClinDoc, Clarity).

• 1+ year of Epic build/configuration experience preferred (or demonstrated ability to learn and apply build standards quickly).

• Exposure to system integration concepts (e.g., HL7, FHIR) and interface testing is preferred.

• Exposure to reporting and data concepts (e.g., Clarity/Caboodle, SlicerDicer, Reporting Workbench, Radar) is preferred.

• Prior work in patient access, billing, coding, finance, or clinical operations (for respective modules).

DESIRED ATTRIBUTES

  • ITIL Foundation certification desired not required.
  • Certifications in one or more Epic applications
  • Experience in a large healthcare system or hospital setting.
  • Experience with other healthcare applications and systems.
  • Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards.
  • Familiarity with cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure).
  • Experience with business intelligence and analytics tools.

  • Proficiency with MS Office applications

Valued but not required skills and experience:

As a QA Engineer, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to develop and execute test plans, identify defects, and ensure that our applications meet the highest standards of quality before they are released to customers.

Responsibilities:

  6. Maintain and expand automated test suites using appropriate tools and frameworks.

  3. Strong understanding of QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
  4. Experience with test automation tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, JUnit, TestNG).
  5. Proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language such as Java, Python, JavaScript, or Ruby.
  6. Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
  7. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
  8. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  9. Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies is a plus.
  10. ISTQB or other relevant certifications are desirable but not required.

job description

Unleash your potential and join the team redefining the future of administration!

Who We Are

At SmartPA, we don’t just provide support – we transform it.

Our mission is simple yet bold: to redefine administrative and PA services through innovative thinking, cutting-edge technology and an unrelenting pursuit of excellence. Trusted by global leaders in industries like tech, automotive and retail, we’re the engine behind smarter, more efficient operations.

With a vibrant, client-focused culture and a team driven by creativity, no two days at SmartPA are ever the same! As we continue to grow rapidly, this is your opportunity to join us on the journey to becoming the most optimised administrative organisation in the world.

If you’re ready to challenge the status quo and create meaningful impact, we want to hear from you!

key responsibilities and skills

What You’ll Do

The Centre of Excellence (COE) is the driving force behind SmartPA, where strategy comes to life. As part of this dynamic, client-facing department, you’ll be the heartbeat of our business – delivering high-impact, tailored support to clients daily.

In the role of Executive Assistant, you’ll play a pivotal role in providing bespoke solutions for a key client account. You’ll tackle real challenges, establish meaningful relationships and make a tangible difference to client success.

Here's what your day-to-day will look like:
Executive Support

  • Providing dedicated EA support to senior stakeholders, including complex diary management across multiple stakeholders and time zones, with conflicts prioritised and resolved.
  • Planning and booking international travel, including flights, accommodation and ground transport through corporate travel platforms.
  • Coordinating internal and external meetings, booking meeting rooms and preparing meeting materials.
  • Processing expenses and invoices accurately and on time, working with the finance team.
  • Handling ad hoc personal tasks for stakeholders with discretion, judgement and sound prioritisation.
Stakeholder Management and Communication
  • Acting as a key point of contact for stakeholders, with extensive email and video call contact with external parties, including entrepreneurs, CEOs, board members and professional advisors.
  • Maintaining accurate client and contact records in the client's systems.
  • Maintaining strict confidentiality of highly sensitive business, investment and legal information.
Team Support
  • Working as part of a wider team of EAs, providing cover and support during peak workloads and absences.
  • Coordinating team events, client events, webinars, and year-end functions.
  • Supporting with general operational administration such as document formatting, task trackers, file management and other functional support as the role evolves.
Specialist Support (varies by team)
  • Supporting investment teams through fast-moving diaries and frequent contact with portfolio company founders and CEOs.
  • Compliance process administration, including tracking, reporting and coordinating with internal teams and external providers.
  • Legal team administration, including document management, meeting support and maintaining accurate, confidential records.
  • Value Add support, including client in-person events and webinars, senior advisor support and CRM contact updates.
Team Development
  • As the first member of the SmartPA team on this new client account, helping shape ways of working, documenting processes and onboarding new team members as the team grows.
Continuous Improvement & Innovation
  • Identifying opportunities to improve processes and reduce non–value-added activity.
  • Contributing ideas on automation and digital tools to work more efficiently.

skills

We're looking for someone who:

  • Is a meticulous organiser with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Stays calm under pressure and juggles constantly changing, complex and interlinked diaries.
  • Adapts quickly to shifting priorities and unexpected situations with limited guidance.
  • Handles every matter with absolute discretion and confidentiality.
  • Anticipates challenges and solves problems before they land on their stakeholder's desk.
  • Is highly articulate in writing and speech, with a considerate manner as the voice of their stakeholders.
  • Is highly responsive and proactive, works autonomously, and collaborates closely with a wider EA team.
  • Wants to build a long-term, trusted partnership and is willing to go the extra mile.

experience

Your experience is key, but your attitude is what sets you apart.

Essential:

  • Minimum 2 years' proven experience as an Executive Assistant or PA supporting senior executives and multiple stakeholders (Director, Partner or C-suite level).
  • Proven complex diary management across multiple time zones, and end-to-end international travel planning and booking.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Teams.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Demonstrated discretion and sound judgement handling highly confidential information.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with competing priorities.
Desirable:
  • EA experience in private equity, investment, finance, consulting, legal or professional services.
  • Experience leading, mentoring or onboarding other EAs or administrators, or ambition to grow into a Team Lead role.
  • Experience supporting legal or compliance teams.
  • Experience with expense and travel platforms (e.g. Expensify, Amex GBT), CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce) and e-signature tools (e.g. DocuSign).
  • Experience providing remote or virtual executive support.
  • Experience coordinating corporate events, webinars or board and committee meetings.
  • Practical use of AI tools to streamline drafting, scheduling or admin tasks.

work remotely

Yes

salary

R200,000 - 400,000 (depending on experience)

schedule

Full time, 37.5 hours per week

Monday - Friday

Your working hours will be 9:00am–6.:00pm UK time. As this role is based in South Africa, your local working hours will change in line with UK daylight saving:
  • 10:00am–7:00pm SAST during UK British Summer Time
  • 11:00am–8:00pm SAST during UK winter time (GMT)

job type

Permanent, full-time

what's in it for you?

At SmartPA, we believe in rewarding talent and supporting your growth:

  • Competitive salaries
  • Yearly bonuses: based on company, department and individual performance
  • Flexitime initiative: work when you're most productive (core hours 10am - 4.30pm)
  • 33 day annual leave
  • Department incentives
  • Employee Assistance Programme

how to apply

Our Recruitment Process

Please submit your CV along with a cover letter outlining how your skills, experience and achievements align with the essential requirements of the role.

Throughout the recruitment process, we will assess candidates against the key competencies and responsibilities outlined in the job profile.

The selection process consists of two interview stages and skills testing.

Please note: we receive a high volume of applications so sometimes it can take us a little longer to get in touch. We welcome enquiries to our inbox.

Job Description

The National Coordinator serves as a subject matter expert within Cox Fleet's dispatch operations, responsible for managing the full lifecycle of fleet repairs and maintenance. This national role operates within multiple markets across the country and requires a high degree of professional judgment, industry knowledge, and the ability to coordinate effectively across internal partners, customers, and third-party vendors. The National Coordinator is expected to model best practices, support less experienced team members, and uphold Cox Fleet's standards for service quality and customer experience.


This is an overnight position with shifts scheduled between 4:00 PM and 10:00 AM. Specific shift assignments will be discussed and determined during the interview process.


Overtime opportunities may be available based on business needs and operational demand. While overtime is not a regular requirement of the role, employees may occasionally be asked to work additional hours.

Essential Responsibilities


Service Coordination and Dispatch

  • Manage the complete event lifecycle for preventative maintenance, towing, and unscheduled/emergency service events, from initial client request to repair-completion
  • Ensure that technicians receive all service events quickly, and request additional work when needed
  • Re-assign previous events that were not completed during the first assignment
  • Assess each service event and dispatch to achieve the best results for the client
  • Assign work with an eye toward time-based KPIs
  • Identify gaps in KPI performance, and work with local leaders to address those gaps
  • Audit open work requests across multiple markets for compliance with daily-update requirements
  • Monitor open events, track estimated arrival times, and communicate proactively with customers and leadership regarding delays or service concerns

Customer and Stakeholder Communication

  • Communicate with all parties to ensure work is prioritized and completed, and that all parties remain fully informed on status along the way. Clients should always be able to self-serve complete and up-to-date information on service events.
  • Obtain estimates and estimate approvals
  • Serve as a point of contact for escalated service issues from customers, team members, and internal stakeholders, addressing concerns with professionalism and urgency

  • Monitor vendor performance and document issues; escalate systemic concerns through established channels

Documentation and Compliance

  • Maintain timely and accurate documentation and notations in all applicable systems for each customer interaction and service event
  • Follow established escalation procedures for complex or high-risk service situations
  • Adhere to all applicable company policies, internal controls, and compliance requirements

Team Contribution and Development

  • Provide process guidance and on-the-job coaching for less experienced dispatch team members
  • Keep open-event backlogs clean with proper process adherence
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of dispatching practices, workflows, and service quality standards

  • Perform additional duties as assigned by the Dispatch Supervisor or leadership

The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as any level degree/certification beyond a HS diploma/GED and 3 years’ experience.
  • Working knowledge of fleet maintenance operations, trucking industry standards, and transportation logistics

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proficient oral and written communication skills with the ability to interact professionally across all levels of the organization
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent service events and shifting priorities in a remote, fast-paced environment
  • Strong interpersonal and diplomacy skills; able to build productive relationships and influence outcomes across varied stakeholder groups without direct authority
  • Ability to remain composed and solution-oriented when managing frustrated customers or complex service scenarios
  • Proficiency with MS Office applications, email platforms, and dispatch or fleet management systems

About MATSYS

MATSYS, based in Sterling, Virginia, develops advanced technology for government and commercial customers across R&D, prototyping, and manufacturing. Our technology and technical data are core to what we do, and this role makes sure we protect them.

About the Role

You will own how MATSYS manages its agreements and protects its intellectual property and data rights. You will take government and commercial agreements from intake through closeout, keep the IP register and data rights records audit-ready, and help program, engineering, and business development teams understand what they can sign, share, and mark. You will run the process and escalate decisions that carry legal, financial, or strategic risk. Signature authority stays with designated company officers.

You will report to the Director of Business Agreements, Improvements & Plans.

What You'll Do

  • Triage, review, and route prime contracts, subcontracts, OT agreements, SBIR/STTR awards, CRADAs, NDAs, teaming agreements, licenses, and supplier and consulting agreements.
  • Summarize risks in scope, flowdowns, payment, liability, termination, and IP and data rights terms, and recommend positions to decision-makers.
  • Maintain templates, a clause library, and the central agreements tracker, including key dates, obligations, and closeout requirements.
  • Keep the company IP register current, run the invention disclosure process, and track government-funded subject invention deadlines.
  • Track the funding source of technical data and software, maintain data rights assertion lists, and make sure deliverables carry correct restrictive markings.
  • Respond to government questions and challenges about markings and assertions.
  • Coordinate with Trade Compliance on export-controlled items and technology.
  • Train program, engineering, and business development staff on agreement routing, NDAs, and protecting IP.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in business, contracts management, law, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years in contracts administration, agreements management, or IP and data rights administration, including agreement drafting, with at least 5 years with the government or a defense contractor.

raw.description:
About us

Founded in 2015 in Athens, Greece, Welcome redefines the way people travel by going above and beyond the commoditized transfer service and being the first company to deliver a complete, personalised, in-destination travel experience. From the moment a traveler arrives at a new destination, until their return journey home, Welcome accommodates all their travel needs, including transfers, sightseeing trips, and local information, in the easiest, friendliest, and most personalised way possible. Welcome's drivers are experts in the area and share their local know-how to make travellers feel at home wherever they are. The company has also introduced contactless rides, thorough cleaning protocols, and protective equipment to make every journey safe.

Being a travel tech startup, Welcome continues to grow and scale its operations and is quickly becoming a global category leader for in-destination travel services.

  • One of the highest-rated global transportation companies with a rating of 4.9/5 stars.
  • Expanded from 200 destinations last year to 350, achieving our ambitious 2024 growth target.
  • Over 4,000 travel partners including 2,500 hotels, numerous vacation rentals, and travel agents, adding 50+ new ones every month.
  • Over 2.5 million happy travellers every year.

⭐️ If you want to dive deeper into the awesomeness of Welcome's culture, click on this link to check our TikTok account.⭐️


The Team

We are a group of vibrant, diverse people who love travelling and never settle on quality. Each one of us didn’t join Welcome by chance and believes deeply in what Welcome is trying to achieve, so we work relentlessly to make that happen. We challenge common logic, focus on design, put simplicity and usability first, and create memorable experiences. We keep learning and exploring better ways to serve our community and grow personally and professionally in our respective fields. We stay humble along the way, with a “pay it forward” mentality, but with big and bold goals.

As a Senior Platform Engineer at Welcome Pickups, you will keep the platform behind our product reliable, fast, scalable and secure, so travellers, drivers and partners can count on our services every day. Much of what we do runs in the background: matching rides to drivers, pricing, notifications, partner syncs and payouts. If the platform slows down or stops, rides don't get assigned and travellers end up waiting at arrivals. This is a hands-on role that works across all our product teams. You will make key architecture and infrastructure decisions, set the standards everyone builds to, and own the technical roadmap together with the Product Manager of the Core team. The role is about helping product teams move fast without breaking things, not slowing them down.

What you'll work with

  • A large Ruby on Rails application, with Sidekiq and RabbitMQ
  • A large, fast-growing PostgreSQL/PostGIS database, plus Elasticsearch and Redis
  • Azure as our main cloud, with AWS S3 and Google Cloud
  • Cloud66, Cloudflare, CircleCI and Docker
  • New Relic and Rollbar for monitoring, and Mixpanel for product analytics
  • 30+ external services, including Checkout.com, Twilio, Braze and hotel booking systems

Responsibilities

Reliability & Uptime

  • Define and track reliability targets (SLAs/SLOs) for our core flows: bookings, ride matching and payments.
  • Set up and run the incident process and on-call, and reduce recovery times.
  • Improve monitoring and alerting across the platform (New Relic, Rollbar).

Performance, Scalability & Data

  • Lead architecture decisions for scaling our backend systems and services.
  • Find and fix performance bottlenecks across the application, background jobs and database.
  • Improve the performance of our large, fast-growing PostgreSQL database:
    • tune slow queries and indexes
    • plan data growth and archiving
    • manage replication, backups and restore drills
    • change large tables without downtime
  • Make sure the platform handles peak season and partner growth smoothly.

Infrastructure, Security & Compliance

  • Define and evolve our infrastructure strategy on Azure, and balance performance, reliability and cost.
  • Define and enforce security best practices: access control, secrets management, and the security of our build and release pipeline.
  • Prepare the platform for compliance: payment-data rules (PCI), GDPR, and over time SOC 2 / ISO 27001.

Developer Experience

  • Improve internal tooling, CI/CD and deployment workflows so engineers can ship faster and safer.

Technical Roadmap & Collaboration

  • Keep the backlog of technical work (upgrades, technical debt, performance, security) organised and ranked in Jira, and prioritise it together with the Product Manager.
  • Write technical docs, runbooks and development plans, and break them into Jira tickets with clear requirements.
  • Participate in team ceremonies (grooming, planning, kick-off meetings, retrospectives & demos).

Requirements

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with strong backend and systems experience.
  • BS/MS degree in Computer Science or a related subject.
  • Proven experience operating and scaling production systems.

Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of system design, distributed systems and performance trade-offs.
  • Strong PostgreSQL skills on large databases: query and index tuning, replication, large-table migrations, backups.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure preferred), Docker and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Redis, Elasticsearch and a message broker (RabbitMQ or similar) at production scale.
  • Experience with observability, monitoring and incident management.
  • Strong security fundamentals: access control, networking, secrets.
  • CI/CD experience, including zero-downtime deploys.
  • Organised and a clear writer, comfortable working in Jira.
  • A hands-on mindset: able to go from strategy to implementation.

Additional experience considered a plus

  • Experience with Ruby on Rails, Sidekiq, Puma and PostGIS, or similar.
  • Exposure to compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001).
  • Experience with AWS or Google Cloud alongside Azure.
  • Experience moving a long-running application to containers or Kubernetes.
  • A travel, mobility or marketplace background with real-time operations.

Benefits

  • Vibrant and fresh work environment
  • Flexible work-from-home policy
  • The tools you need to perform your daily tasks successfully
  • L&D personal budget
  • +4 extra PTO days annually
  • The unique opportunity to join “the next big thing” at ground level

About the Role

We are seeking a The Senior Lead – Billing and Disputes is responsible for managing customer billing disputes from identification through resolution globally. This role serves as a key liaison between Accounts Receivable, Billing, Sales, Finance, Tax, Customer Service, and other internal teams to investigate discrepancies, determine appropriate resolutions, and ensure accurate financial records.

The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of accounting, is an excellent individual contributor with analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to research complex billing issues while maintaining a strong customer-service focus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Investigate and resolve customer disputes related to invoices, pricing, contracts, credits, payments, and billing terms.
  • Review customer contracts, purchase orders, invoices, billing schedules, and supporting documentation to determine the validity of disputes.
  • Research discrepancies between contractual terms, customer expectations, and amounts billed.
  • Partner with Billing, Revenue Accounting, Sales, Operations, and other departments to resolve disputes efficiently.
  • Determine appropriate adjustments, credits, rebills, or other resolutions in accordance with company policies and contractual requirements.
  • Prepare and process credit memos, debit memos, billing adjustments, and other accounting transactions as necessary.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and supporting evidence for all dispute resolutions.
  • Track outstanding disputes and proactively follow up to ensure timely resolution.
  • Identify recurring dispute trends and recommend process improvements to reduce future billing issues.
  • Ensure dispute resolutions are properly reflected in the company's accounting and billing systems.
  • Support month-end and year-end close activities related to accounts receivable and billing.
  • Provide documentation and explanations to internal and external auditors when requested.
  • Develop and maintain reports and metrics related to dispute volume, aging, resolution time, and financial impact.
  • Assist with improving billing processes, controls, and procedures.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field.
  • 6 + years of accounting, accounts receivable, billing, or related finance experience.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles.
  • Experience analyzing invoices, contracts, purchase orders, and account balances.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple disputes and priorities simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and accounting/ERP systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with complex B2B or enterprise billing.
  • Experience working with contractual billing arrangements.
  • Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle, SAP, or similar platforms.
  • Experience working with SaaS, software, technology, professional services, or other subscription-based businesses.
  • Experience developing dispute-aging and accounts-receivable reporting.
  • Experience identifying root causes of recurring billing disputes

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position will be measured by the ability to:

  • Resolve customer disputes accurately and efficiently.
  • Reduce the aging and financial impact of outstanding disputes.
  • Ensure adjustments are supported by appropriate documentation and accounting analysis.
  • Identify and communicate systemic billing issues.
  • Improve the overall accuracy and efficiency of the order-to-cash process.
  • Build strong working relationships across Finance, Sales, Operations, and Customer Service

Why This Is A Once-In-A-Career Opportunity

  • Lead in a market undergoing significant disruption and growth from cloud migration to edge intelligence to AI-powered industrial automation.
  • Join a culture defined by ambition, authenticity, speed, teamwork, and the belief that manufacturing can meaningfully improve the world.
  • Competitive benefits, compensation and long-term impact on how the world’s industrial companies operate, automate, and innovate.

Why Join Velotic

Velotic is uniquely positioned at the intersection of industrial operations, advanced connectivity, and AI. Joining now means you can help shape:

Culture & Growth

  • Build foundational systems, processes, and culture from day one.
  • Work within a team defined by ambition, collaboration, authenticity, and speed.
  • Influence global operating models and employee experience at scale.

Work-Life Balance

  • Base Salary: MXN 424,000 - 530,000
  • Performance Bonus
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Discretionary Time Off (DTO)
  • Global paid parental leave
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Join Us

Learn more at:

WHO WE ARE

Velotic is a newly-formed independent software company with a pure-play focus on industrial operations. We unite two category-defining portfolios -- ThingWorx and Kepware (formerly part of PTC) and Proficy (formerly part of GE Vernova) -- to transform industrial manufacturing, at scale. With $350M in annual revenue, a global footprint across a range of industries, a legacy customer base, and our intelligent data connectivity systems and AI solutions, we are one of the world's largest independent software companies focused on industrial operations -- here to power the future of manufacturing.

OUR MISSION

Enabling the world's industrial producers to do the right things right—across every shift, every plant, every day. We help manufacturers prosper by equipping them with software-defined, data-driven production systems that elevate quality, accelerate cycle times, improve resilience, and enable sustainable profit growth.

OUR VALUES

How we work matters as much as what we build. We shine brighter, bringing curiosity and energy to ever problem. We build what matters, turning fresh thinking into real impact. We move with pace and purpose, favoring good decisions made quickly. And we win the right way — together, holding ourselves to the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and respect. These values shape how we hire, lead, and hold each other accountable, every day.

About the Role

The Talent Sourcer is a critical member of the Talent Acquisition team, responsible for proactively identifying, engaging, and developing qualified talent pipelines to support the organization’s hiring needs. This role partners closely with Recruiters to understand talent requirements, develop targeted sourcing strategies, identify passive candidates, and deliver high-quality talent into the recruiting process.

The ideal candidate is a highly resourceful researcher, relationship builder, and talent-market expert who can find strong candidates in competitive markets and create meaningful connections with prospective talent.

This is a hands-on sourcing role with a strong emphasis on candidate generation, passive sourcing, talent mapping, market intelligence, and recruiting partnership.

Responsibilities

  • Champions “The Layton Way” by delivering predictable outcomes for internal teams, external teams, and customers.

  • Ensures that “Constructing with Integrity” is delivered by working with honesty, unity, safety, and quality of work.

    Candidate Sourcing & Generation

    • Develop and execute proactive sourcing strategies for assigned positions and talent segments.

    • Identify qualified candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, professional associations, industry networks, referrals, databases, and other sourcing channels.

    • Research and identify passive candidates who may not be actively seeking new opportunities.

    • Build targeted candidate lists and talent pools for current and anticipated hiring needs.

    • Conduct initial outreach to prospective candidates and generate interest in career opportunities.

    • Screen sourced candidates against established qualifications and recruiting criteria before advancing them to the Recruiter.

    • Maintain a consistent pipeline of qualified candidates for high-priority and difficult-to-fill positions.

    Recruiter Partnership

    • Partner closely with Recruiters to understand open positions, candidate profiles, priorities, and sourcing challenges.

    • Develop sourcing plans for niche, high-volume, and difficult-to-fill positions.

    • Regularly communicate sourcing activity, candidate pipeline quality, market conditions, and challenges.

    • Provide Recruiters with qualified candidates and actionable market intelligence.

    • Participate in recruiting strategy meetings and contribute sourcing expertise to overall recruiting plans.

    • Adjust sourcing strategies based on Recruiter and Hiring Manager feedback.

    Talent Mapping & Market Intelligence

    • Research target companies, industries, markets, and talent pools to identify potential candidates.

    • Develop and maintain talent maps for critical positions and areas of strategic growth.

    • Identify competitor organizations and talent markets that may provide strong candidate pools.

    • Monitor talent availability, compensation trends, organizational changes, and other market factors that may impact recruiting.

    • Build and maintain hot lists of prospective candidates for future opportunities.

    Candidate Engagement

    • Develop compelling and personalized outreach strategies for passive candidates.

    • Establish relationships with prospective candidates even when there is not an immediate opening.

    • Represent the organization and employment opportunities professionally and compellingly.

    • Maintain ongoing communication with high-potential candidates and develop long-term talent relationships.

    • Ensure candidates receive a positive and professional experience throughout the sourcing process.

    Recruiting Technology & Data

    • Leverage applicant tracking systems, LinkedIn Recruiter, AI-enabled sourcing tools, talent intelligence platforms, and other recruiting technology to improve sourcing effectiveness.

    • Maintain accurate candidate records and disposition information within the ATS.

    • Utilize recruiting data and analytics to measure sourcing effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.

    • Continuously evaluate and adopt new sourcing techniques, technologies, and best practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred in Human Resources, Business, or a related field.
  • Preferred: Experience in the construction industry.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify and engage passive candidates.

  • Strong research, internet sourcing, and talent-market mapping skills.

  • Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and/or other candidate sourcing platforms.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple searches and priorities simultaneously.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

What We’re Looking For
The ideal candidate is a self-motivated professional who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced, and constantly evolving environment. You excel at running your own searches end-to-end, yet work seamlessly with peers to share strategies, support one another, and deliver results as a team.

Qualified candidates located anywhere in the United States are encouraged to apply.

Benefits - Layton Construction offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Health Savings Account, Healthcare Flexible Spending Account, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, Life & AD&D Insurance, Long-term Disability Insurance, Short-term Disability Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accident Insurance, Hospital Indemnity Insurance, Home & Auto Insurance, Family Support, Pre-tax Paid Parking/Public Transportation, Paid time off, Time Away Benefits, Paid Holidays, Group Legal, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Identity Theft Protection, Group Legal, Pet Insurance, Employee Assistance Program.

A Little Bit About Us:

Saphetor’s mission is to enable anyone to find, share and use the most comprehensive human genome data – and to collaborate to improve health and lives around the world. To do this we have built the VarSome suite of bioinformatic tools, the world’s leading resource for analysis and interpretation of human genome variant data, with more than 6 000 citations in scientific papers, and over 60 000 registered professional users. Our customers work around the globe across academic, clinical, and industry laboratories analysing NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) data for research and diagnostic purposes. Saphetor is a global precision medicine company with offices and distributed teams across Greece, Spain, the UK, Switzerland, France, the MENA region, South America, and other countries, employing a diverse global workforce.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an Application Scientist in Clinical Genomics to join our commercial organization.Standing at the intersection of clinical genomics and bioinformatics, you will support our customers through their journey with VarSome, from pre-sales discussions and platform onboarding to post-sales support and account management finding new opportunities for further growth. You will play a key role in shaping and delivering solutions to our direct and indirect customers.

We thrive in a high-pressure, high-performance environment where clinical precision and rapid growth meet. While our pace is fast, it is always directed by rigorous organization and clear processes, ensuring that our commitment to quality is never compromised by our drive for speed.

Role Responsibilities

  • Pre-sales Support: Act as the technical “closer” by delivering expert demonstrations that bridge clinical needs with VarSome Premium and Clinical; you will own the customer evaluation process, solve “pain points” around variant analysis, and advise on lab equipment/system integrations.
  • Post-sales Support: Lead onboarding sessions for geneticists and bioinformaticians to ensure rapid “time to value”; you will act as the primary lead for on-premises and private cloud deployments, coordinating infrastructure specifications (storage, network) between clients and our DevOps team.
  • Workflow Optimization & Support: Fine-tune filtering strategies and automation to maximize platform “stickiness” while acting as a high-level bridge between customer support and stakeholders to ensure seamless routine operations.
  • Scientific Advocacy: Systematically gather power-user feedback to influence the product roadmap and cultivate strategic relationships for conference presentations (ESHG, MedTech) and the development of technical white papers.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Marketing, and Operations to ensure product-market fit and growth. Work with growth marketers to translate features into benefits for prospects, while influencing the product roadmap through prioritization.

The Ideal Candidate (Profile)

The ideal candidate combines strong clinical genomics expertise and a passion for data analysis with a commercial mindset. You should be able to translate complex technical/IT specifications into clear benefits, while possessing the communication skills necessary to engage both laboratory professionals and clinicians.

What you will bring:

  • Education: A Master’s or PhD in Human Genetics, Laboratory Medicine, Molecular Biology/Pathology, Life Sciences, or related field.
  • Expertise: Hands-on experience in clinical genomics workflows, including NGS library preparation, sequencing, and secondary and/or tertiary analysis in a clinical setting.
  • Technical Knowledge: A solid grasp of variant classification frameworks and a deep understanding of NGS workflows.
  • Communication: The ability to simplify complex clinical genomics and bioinformatics concepts for clinicians, laboratory technicians, researchers, and IT professionals.
  • Languages: Native in Polish. Proficiency in English is a must.

Strongly Valued

  • Clinical Experience: Previous background in a hospital or private laboratory setting interpreting NGS patient cases.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with working in regulated environments, such as IVDR, CLIA/CAP, or similar standards.
  • Global Mindset: Proven experience in multicultural environments and/or supporting international customers in a scale-up setting.

Mindset & Key Skills

  • Scientific Rigor: A curious, detail-oriented professional who maintains high scientific standards while managing complex data analysis.
  • Commercial Mindset: The ability to balance scientific accuracy with pragmatic sales decisions and translate features into customer benefits.
  • Self-Organization: A structured thinker with strong prioritization and project management skills, comfortable in a fast-paced environment.
  • Global Mobility: Available and willing to undertake international business travel in Europe to support our global customer base.

While our foundation is in Athens, our talent pool is spread across Europe, with a strong culture of remote collaboration. Our team is highly experienced in distributed Agile workflows and communicates exclusively in fluent English.

Your career journey with us includes, among others:

  • A position in a fascinating healthcare growth domain, at the cutting edge of technology and research
  • A competitive compensation package tailored to your unique expertise and professional background.
  • A remote work environment that promotes a healthy work-life balance
  • Endless learning opportunities, while transferring new technologies from academics to clinical practice all over the world.

We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and our employees, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, medical condition or disability, sexual orientation, gender expression, or marital status.
