raw.description:
About Flexspring

Everything connects. That's not just our tagline - it's the whole job.

Flexspring is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) built for one of the thornier problems in enterprise software: getting HR systems to actually talk to each other. We link payroll, recruiting, benefits, and HRIS platforms API-to-API so data moves between them cleanly and in near real-time, with no manual re-entry anywhere. The results back it up - 3,000+ integrations delivered, 800+ clients including Fortune 500 companies, ADP Marketplace Platinum Partner, and named HR Data Integration Experts of the Year 2025. And we do it all as a remote-first team spread across Canada and beyond.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a QA Developer Co-op to join our R&D team - and we'll be upfront about what that means.

This is real experience, in the fullest sense. No throwaway side project, no busywork to fill the term - from your first weeks you'll be testing our actual product, as a real part of the team, protecting data that real customers depend on. Many of our co-ops go on to join us full-time after graduation.

You'll work mainly in Java, writing automated tests around the ways real integrations break - API timeouts, mismatched data, systems drifting out of sync. Good QA here is half code, half detective work - every test exists because a real company is counting on its HR data to arrive intact. If you like asking "what could go wrong here?", and you get a little satisfaction from catching the bug everyone else missed, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Writing and maintaining automated test suites in Java - and understanding the customer problem behind what you're testing
  • Designing tests around the ways real integrations break - API timeouts, corrupted or mismatched data, systems falling out of sync
  • Tracking failures back to their root cause, not just the symptom
  • Using modern tooling, AI included, to work efficiently - and reviewing what it produces with a careful eye before you trust it
  • Working closely with developers through code reviews and team discussions to keep quality high

What We're Looking For

  • Strong analytical thinking. This is the heart of good QA - you can look at a feature and reason about where it might break and why that would matter, connecting each test back to the real customer on the other end.
  • A thoughtful approach to new tools. You enjoy picking up unfamiliar technology, including AI tools, and using it to work faster and smarter. You also know that generating output is only the start - the real value is in reviewing it, catching what's off, and being able to stand behind the result.
  • You've already completed a co-op term or have some professional work experience - this won't be your first time in a real work environment
  • You're currently studying Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • A solid foundation in Java
  • You've written automated tests before, even for a class project (JUnit or something similar)
  • You've worked with or learned about APIs
  • You're curious, motivated, and get real satisfaction from finding what others miss

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with testing frameworks or tools (JUnit, Selenium, Postman, REST-assured, or similar)
  • Familiarity with REST APIs and how data moves between systems
  • Interest in integration platforms (iPaaS) and how systems connect
  • Curiosity about how large systems talk to each other - and what happens when they don't

What You'll Walk Away With

  • Real, hands-on experience protecting the quality of a production platform real customers rely on
  • Mentorship from senior developers who'll invest in how you think, not just the tests you write
  • A working understanding of how HR data moves between enterprise systems - and where it tends to break
  • Real practice using AI and modern tooling the way strong engineers do - fast, but with judgment

raw.description:
L'Instructeur en droit du sol (h/f) assure l'instruction des demandes d'autorisation d'urbanisme pour le compte de collectivités territoriales, en garantissant leur conformité aux règles d'urbanisme en vigueur. Il analyse les dossiers de permis de construire, déclarations préalables et certificats d'urbanisme, tout en conseillant les pétitionnaires et les services instructeurs.

Cette mission s'inscrit dans l'accompagnement des collectivités pour la gestion de leur développement territorial.

L'Instructeur en droit du sol (h/f) intervient en support des communes et intercommunalités pour l'instruction de leurs demandes d'autorisation d'urbanisme :

1. Instruction des demandes d'autorisation d'urbanisme

  • Analyser et instruire les demandes de permis de construire (PC), déclarations préalables (DP), permis d'aménager (PA) et certificats d'urbanisme (CU)
  • Vérifier la complétude des dossiers déposés et demander les pièces complémentaires si nécessaire
  • Examiner la conformité des projets aux règles d'urbanisme applicables (PLU/PLUi, carte communale, RNU)
  • Rédiger les projets d'arrêtés (accords, refus, sursis à statuer) et les notifications aux pétitionnaires
  • Respecter les délais d'instruction réglementaires et assurer le suivi administratif des dossiers

2. Vérification de la conformité réglementaire

  • Appliquer les dispositions du Code de l'urbanisme et analyser les règlements de PLU/PLUi (zonage, règles de constructibilité, servitudes)
  • Consulter les services instructeurs concernés (ABF, SDIS, gestionnaires de voirie, services d'assainissement, etc.)
  • Intégrer les contraintes spécifiques : zones protégées (monuments historiques, sites classés), risques naturels et technologiques (PPR), règles environnementales
  • Vérifier la conformité architecturale, paysagère et d'implantation des projets

3. Reporting et collaboration interne

  • Établir des rapports d'activité réguliers pour les collectivités clientes (statistiques d'instruction, délais, typologies de dossiers)
  • Alimenter les outils de gestion et de suivi des dossiers d'instruction
  • Contribuer au développement de l'offre de services en urbanisme et à la satisfaction client

Conditions d’éligibilité à l'inscription et la prise de missions sur la plateforme

  1. Être autoentrepreneur ou avoir une société individuelle : SASU, EURL, SARL, EI …
  2. Expérience de 2 à 5 ans minimum en instruction de dossiers d'urbanisme
        • Formation Bac+3 à Bac+5 en droit de l'urbanisme, aménagement du territoire, droit public ou géographie-urbanisme
        • Maîtrise approfondie du Code de l'urbanisme et des procédures d'autorisation

Compétences :

  • Excellente connaissance du Code de l'urbanisme (L. 421-1 et suivants, R. 431-1 et suivants)
  • Maîtrise de l'analyse réglementaire des PLU/PLUi, cartes communales et règlement national d'urbanisme (RNU)
  • Capacité à instruire tous types de dossiers : PC, PA, DP, CU (opérationnel et informatif)
  • Connaissance des servitudes d'utilité publique, des périmètres de protection (ABF, sites classés) et des règles de constructibilité
  • Compétence en lecture de plans, coupes et documents graphiques de projets d'architecture
  • Connaissance des outils SIG (systèmes d'information géographique) : QGIS, ArcGIS
  • Connaissance des procédures de recours contentieux et de la jurisprudence administrative en urbanisme

Savoir-être :

  • Rigueur et sens de l'organisation
  • Capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse pour la rédaction d'arrêtés et de notes juridiques
  • Qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques pour l'accompagnement des pétitionnaires et des services instructeurs
  • Esprit d'analyse et capacité de discernement face à des situations complexes ou ambiguës
  • Autonomie dans le traitement des dossiers et capacité à solliciter les expertises complémentaires si nécessaire
  • Capacité d'adaptation aux spécificités des territoires et des collectivités clientes
  • Sens du service client et orientation résultat

Processus de recrutement en tant qu’Indépendant / Freelance

La démarche à suivre pour nous rejoindre :

  • Nous faire parvenir à l'adresse : , les éléments suivants : CV détaillé, KBIS ou justificatif d'immatriculation
  • Participer à un entretien de qualification visant à évaluer vos compétences
    • Échange approfondi sur votre parcours professionnel, vos compétences techniques en droit de l'urbanisme (instruction de dossiers, connaissance des PLU, maîtrise du Code de l'urbanisme) et votre motivation.
    • Examen de sélection concernant vos compétences techniques en droit de l’urbanisme

Pourquoi rejoindre SOCOTEC ?

  • Nous vous accompagnons dans votre carrière en encourageant la promotion interne : chez SOCOTEC, 75% des postes d’encadrement sont pourvus par des promotions internes.
  • Parce que vous nous apportez votre expertise, nous vous aidons à la faire grandir et contribuons activement à votre développement professionnel grâce à des dispositifs de formation enrichis.
  • Avec ses 150 agences en France, SOCOTEC offre des opportunités de mobilité géographique.
  • Notre processus de recrutement et d’intégration a été optimisé pour offrir une expérience simple, digitale et complète à chaque candidat.

Let’s SOCOTEC !

SOCOTEC est dans le Top 10 des Best Workplaces® 2025 (catégorie >2500 salariés) !

Rejoindre SOCOTEC, c’est rejoindre une communauté d’experts soudés, une entreprise en croissance qui va de l’avant et qui valorise l’humain et le développement de ses équipes, c’est aussi rejoindre une dynamique collective qui fait la différence sur ses marchés : construction, immobilier, infrastructures, industrie, environnement.

Leader de la durabilité du bâti et des infrastructures depuis plus de 70 ans, nous attachons de l’importance au service clients pour les aider dans la gestion des risques de la conformité jusqu’à la performance en passant par la sécurité des constructions et équipements.

Cette année, SOCOTEC recrute 1500 nouveaux collaborateurs.

Rejoignez-nous et partager un métier au service d’une vision positive : inventer ensemble la ville de demain, plus sûre, durable et inclusive.

raw.excerpt: Geear is on the hunt for a talented and driven individual with a passion for project management and digital marketing.
raw.description:
Geear is on the hunt for a talented and driven individual with a passion for project management and digital marketing.

About the Job

Geear, a HubSpot Diamond Partner and voted one of the Best Places to Work in Virginia, is growing, and we want you to be a part of it! We’re currently seeking a Digital Project Manager to support our growth by acting as the central hub that connects clients, creatives, and technical teams, so we can deliver quality work to our clients on time and on budget. If you’re passionate about project management, excited about how AI and agents are changing the way teams work, and seeking an environment that values work-life balance (100% remote and a 4-day workweek!), we’d love to hear from you!

***Note: Geear is currently operating 100% virtually and will continue to do so for the foreseeable future***

What You'll Do

  • Own the health of our Kanban board across your assigned client accounts, keeping a daily eye out for stalled, misrouted, or aging work before it impacts delivery

  • Spot repetitive operational work that AI tools or agents could handle or speed up, then help prototype, test, and roll out those workflows across the team

  • Facilitate weekly prioritization meetings and other team agile ceremonies that help the team commit to a clear, realistic plan for the week

  • Communicate priority changes quickly and clearly to Client Success Managers and production teams

  • Hold the team accountable to committed work and surface patterns that get in the way of getting it done

  • Make sure production receives clean, actionable work by upholding our intake standards

  • Serve as an early warning system for delivery and client risk, flagging at-risk situations and helping fix root causes, not just symptoms

  • Work with stakeholders to ideate, define, and document internal processes

  • Grow into full ownership of project delivery, including building project plans, managing client communication on revisions and approvals, and escalating delivery risks

Who You Are

  • You’re a problem solver. You’re not ruffled by change, and you enjoy solving challenges and learning new things

  • You’re a friction detective. You notice where work gets stuck, and you can’t leave a broken process alone

  • You’re excited about AI. You already use AI tools in your own work, and you get energized by figuring out where they can take busywork off a team’s plate

  • You’re a pragmatic experimenter. You’d rather pilot something small, see how it works, and improve it than wait for a perfect solution, and you’re honest when a tool isn’t worth it

  • You’re a good communicator. You’re able to simplify communications about complex work and provide clarity to internal stakeholders

  • You’re involved. You like to work collaboratively with several team members and play an integral role in making sure high-quality client work is getting done on time and on budget

  • You’re a helper. You get satisfaction from helping others and facilitating work being done to help them reach their goals

  • You’re cool under pressure, highly organized, responsive, dynamic, and diplomatic

  • You’re able to zoom in and out with ease. You pay attention to the details while also keeping the big picture in mind. Who You'll Work With

Who You'll Work With

  • A dynamic and dedicated team of digital marketing professionals

  • A culture steeped in our core values of Growth, Empathy, Essentialism, Accountability, and (doing what’s) Right: GEEAR

  • A company voted as one of the Best Places to Work in Virginia 5 years in a row

Setting You Up for Success

As an employee-first organization, we want to make sure our team members are set up for success. When you win, everyone wins. Therefore, we are proud to offer the following benefits:

  • 4-day workweek. We follow the 100/80/100 four-day workweek model, meaning employees are not expected to be at their desk all day Friday if their work is completed for the week

  • Fully remote office.We don't think you need to be in an office every day to do great work. If you prefer an occasional change of scenery outside the office, we will cover some or all of the cost of a co-working membership

  • Group health, dental, vision and life insurance plans at a competitive cost

  • 401k savings plan with employer match helps you save some for later

  • Student loan assistance plan that makes monthly contributions directly to your student loan principal (at no cost to you)

  • $2000 home office and computer allowance to make your home work setup perfect for you

  • $500 annual education stipend

  • Unlimited paid time off

  • A clear track for career growth, increased responsibilities, and increased compensation

  • Travel at least 2x annually for our in-person retreats (currently located in Richmond, VA)

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years experience with project management or task management in a fast-paced, high volume environment

  • Experience running Kanban or agile workflows and facilitating team meetings

  • Experience with project management and knowledge base platforms (Teamwork, HubSpot knowledge is a plus)

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini) to improve your own or your team’s workflows. Experience building automations or agent-based workflows is a plus

  • Proficient in Google Workspace tools, particularly Google Sheets

  • Experience juggling competing priorities with passionate stakeholders

  • Self-starter with an attention to detail and drive to produce consistent and quality work

  • Superior written and verbal communications skills, coupled with highly developed interpersonal skills

  • High emotional intelligence

  • Highly organized with excellent time management skills

What's The Geear Culture Like?

Our culture is steeped in our core values of GEEAR: Growth, Essentialism, Empathy, Accountability, and Right. Our people are focused on personal and professional growth, they focus on the essentials, they are empathetic towards others, they take accountability and ownership, and they do what's right and in the best interest of our clients.

Our culture is compassionate and team-oriented. We don't tolerate any "throat stomping" or other negative behavior that impacts someone's experience here.

That's why our employees rave about our culture (and we think you will, too).

Compensation

  • Base salary: $70,000 - $73,000/yr based on experience

  • Additional company bonus opportunities: $5,700 - $9,380/yr

  • Total earning potential: $75,700-$82,380/yr

A little more about us...

We believe strongly in personal accountability. We will invest in you, challenge you, and develop you. It is in our best interest to see you succeed and grow.

raw.description:
Background

당사의 고객사는 국내 대기업, 국책 연구기관과 컨소시엄을 구성해 정부 주관 대규모 R&D 국책과제에 선정된 몰입형 미디어 테크 기업입니다. 아시아 최초 수준의 8K급 초대형 LED 몰입형 콘텐츠 공간과, 기존 영화·영상을 이 공간 규격으로 확장 변환하는 자체 AI 영상 엔진을 함께 개발하고 있습니다. 이 엔진이 목표로 하는 것은 기존 CG/VFX 방식 대비 제작비 60% 이상 절감, 제작 기간 대폭 단축입니다. 몰입형 체험 시장이 연평균 20%대로 성장하는 가운데, 국내 첫 공간 구축을 시작으로 향후 10년 내 아시아 주요 도시와 글로벌 시장으로 확장하는 로드맵을 가지고 있습니다.

이 회사의 AI개발팀은 최신 논문과 모델을 빠르게 적용하는 것보다, 실제로 문제를 해결하는지 끝까지 검증하는 연구를 중시합니다. 왜 필요한지, 기존 방식보다 실제로 나은지, 어떻게 측정할지, 보유한 GPU 환경에서 실행 가능한지, 실제 서비스에 적용할 수 있는지까지 묻는 팀입니다.

이번에 모시는 Video / Vision AI Research Engineer는 이 AI 영상 처리 플랫폼의 핵심 연구를 이끄는 포지션입니다. Video Generation, Outpainting / Inpainting, 고해상도 영상 처리, Temporal Consistency 등 영화 길이의 장시간 영상을 AI로 처리하는 난제를 직접 정의하고 해결합니다. 연구 결과는 논문이나 Prototype에서 끝나지 않고, SOTA 탐색, 재현, Dataset 구축, 학습 및 Fine-tuning, Evaluation, 최적화, Checkpoint 관리를 거쳐 실제 Production까지 이어집니다. 연구가 곧바로 상용 서비스가 되는 경험, 그리고 사업 확장과 함께 연구 조직의 기술 방향을 만들어 갈 기회를 제공합니다.

Key Responsibilities

  • Video Generation / Video Processing 분야의 최신 논문, 모델, 오픈소스 조사 및 기술 검증
  • Video Outpainting / Inpainting 모델 연구 및 고도화
  • 장시간 영상에서의 Temporal Consistency 및 Scene Consistency 개선
  • 인물 및 객체의 Identity / Object Consistency 유지 기술 연구
  • 원본 영상의 분위기와 표현을 유지하기 위한 Style Consistency 연구
  • 돔 및 초광각 콘텐츠 생성을 위한 영상 확장·변환 기술 연구
  • 고해상도 영상 Processing 및 12K/16K급 처리 Pipeline 연구와 최적화
  • AI 모델의 논문 및 Open Source 구현 재현
  • Dataset 수집, 전처리, 정제 및 Training Data Pipeline 구축

raw.title: Senior Data Scientist — Energy (Oil & Gas)
raw.excerpt: About the roleA senior individual contributor owning the data science work end to end: deciding what to measure, getting the data, building the models, defending the conclusions.
raw.description:
About the role

A senior individual contributor owning the data science work end to end: deciding what to measure, getting the data, building the models, defending the conclusions. You work directly with traders, deal economists, finance and treasury, and the founders — no account manager in between.

We are hiring for a sector, not for one narrow problem. Assignments come from business stakeholders and they vary; what stays constant is the industry and the independence expected. The team can grow with one or two junior data scientists reporting to you.

There is a data engineer and an established data lake, but not every source is organised that way — a meaningful part of the work still starts in raw tables and unprocessed exports.

What the work looks like

The system we are building exists so that anyone involved in a deal can reconstruct the P&L between any two points of the chain, at any moment, on an agreed and versioned allocation basis. That is where the role sits: P&L, cost and financial transactions. Operational data is an input to margin, not a subject of its own.

This is operational deal P&L, reconciled to but not identical with the statutory accounts; the general ledger and month-close stay in the accounting system.

Scope

  • P&L reconstruction and margin attribution across the deal lifecycle — netback at entry, provisional P&L, final P&L after final pricing, actual costs, demurrage and claims — with a defensible account of every delta, and the ability to reproduce the P&L as of a past date
  • Forecasting where it pays on the financial side: provisional cost lines invoiced later, cost and margin per tonne, demurrage and claim exposure, FX and open pricing-period exposure, working capital and cashflow
  • Anomaly and fraud detection on financial data: invoice lines inconsistent with contract terms, cost booked to the wrong deal or period, duplicate invoices, off-market pricing between related parties, cost reallocation that improves one deal at another's expense
  • The reporting layer for finance and risk — margin, cost per tonne, exposure, receivables, cash position — with single agreed definitions where trading, economics and finance disagree
  • Turning vague business problems into a research plan, and results into a recommendation someone can act on
  • Incomplete and contradictory financial data as the normal case: provisional costs never trued up, invoices arriving months late, deals kept open for years by claims

Requirements

  • 7+ years in data science, with senior ownership of your own workstreams
  • Oil & gas industry experience — at least two years of delivered projects in trading, refining, logistics, storage or distribution. You can read a pricing clause, an invoice with its cost lines and a demurrage claim without a translator, and you know why provisional and final invoices for the same cargo legitimately differ. Which segment matters less. What matters is physical hydrocarbon volumes and index-linked pricing — power or utilities experience alone does not cover that
  • Working with coding agents, seriously. Agents write most of the code here. Bad agent output in analysis fails silently: a join fans out rows, a `dropna` removes half a population, a future-dated column leaks into features. We hire for verification habits, not speed — row-count and population checks, reconciliation against a number someone already trusts, held-out evaluation, a traceable path from raw data to any figure a decision-maker sees
  • Strong Python and SQL, and readiness to work in raw data yourself: unfamiliar schemas, undocumented tables, exports never meant for analysis
  • Forecasting and time-series modelling on real business data
  • Experience taking models into production and operating them; close to essential for us
  • Numbers that carry weight. Your output feeds invoices, hedges and shareholder reporting: reconciliation to the accounting system, a versioned and documented method, and an explanation the person signing the invoice can follow. Accuracy that cannot be explained loses to accuracy that can
  • English sufficient to present findings and defend methodology
  • Professional proficiency in Russian

What we offer

  • Ownership of the data science work, and room to shape how it is done
  • Direct access to founders and decision-makers; short feedback loops
  • Generous AI tooling budget — frontier models are a working expense, not a perk
  • Competitive compensation, discussed individually

How to apply

Share your CV an answer to any of the questions below, at your choice. Applications without answers are not reviewed.

1. A term contract drawn down over several lots was booked at a netback of about $14/t. The final P&L closes at $6/t and nobody can say where the rest went — pricing period, FX, provisional costs replaced by actuals, late demurrage and cost reallocation all have their advocates. How would you approach it, what would you need, and what would you deliver?

2. Give a real case where two systems or two departments reported different numbers for the same P&L, margin or quantity. What were the figures, why did they differ, which one did the business treat as truth, and what did you change?

3. Show a real prompt or task brief you gave an agent for an analysis or a model, and what it produced. Then one case where agent output looked right and was numerically wrong: what was wrong, how you caught it, what check you added.

4. Which systems have you personally pulled data from — CTRM/ETRM, ERP or accounting, invoice and settlement data, bank statements, terminal systems, price feeds? Pick one and tell us something about its data that only someone who has used it would know.

raw.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
raw.excerpt: At OneLocal, we know that marketing is no longer just about buying ads.
raw.description:
At OneLocal, we know that marketing is no longer just about buying ads. It's about mastering a technology landscape that keeps changing. We provide SaaS solutions to small and medium businesses (SMBs) worldwide through a suite of seven digital marketing products. We aim to be the best partner our clients can have by combining innovative technology with local marketing expertise.

As we keep growing globally, we are looking for a high-energy Talent Acquisition Specialist (Recruiter) to join our People team full-time. You'll own full-cycle recruiting for your roles from start to finish. You'll also help shape our employer brand, culture, and People operations. This is an early-career role with real ownership from day one. If you are a "people person" who loves the thrill of the hunt and wants to help build a great company, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing

Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Own Your Requisitions: Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for sales, tech, and operations roles, from the intake meeting to the signed offer.
  • Partner with Hiring Managers: Run intake meetings to define role requirements, write job descriptions, and agree on the interview process and hiring criteria.
  • Source & Engage: Build pipelines by finding and reaching out to strong passive candidates on LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, and other creative channels.
  • Screen & Assess: Review resumes and run phone screens to assess skills, motivation, and alignment with our values.
  • Manage the Process: Guide candidates through each interview stage, gather feedback from interviewers, and lead debriefs that end in a hiring decision.
  • Close Candidates: Extend offers, handle negotiations with guidance from senior team members, and close top talent.
  • Deliver a Great Candidate Experience: Communicate promptly and professionally with every candidate, whatever the outcome.
  • Track & Report: Keep our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) accurate and report on your pipeline health, time-to-fill, and other hiring metrics.

Employer Branding

  • Brand Storytelling: Create content for LinkedIn, our careers page, and other channels, such as employee spotlights, "day in the life" posts, and team wins, that shows what it's really like to work at OneLocal.
  • Careers Presence: Keep job postings, our careers page, and employer review profiles (e.g., Glassdoor) accurate, engaging, and on-brand.
  • Talent Community: Build long-term pipelines through university partnerships, virtual career fairs, and networking events.

Culture & Engagement

  • Team Events: Plan and run virtual and in-person events, celebrations, and team-building activities that keep our remote-first team connected.
  • Recognition & Milestones: Help manage recognition programs and celebrate work anniversaries, birthdays, and company wins.
  • Employee Feedback: Help run engagement surveys and pulse checks, summarize the results, and support follow-up initiatives.
  • Internal Communications: Draft announcements, newsletters, and updates that keep everyone informed and engaged.

People Operations

  • Onboarding & Offboarding: Hand off each hire into a welcoming onboarding experience, including paperwork, equipment, system access, and first-week schedules, and support smooth offboarding.
  • HR Administration: Keep employee records accurate in our HRIS and prepare offer letters, contracts, and employment verifications.
  • Process Improvement: Document and improve recruiting and People processes, templates, and policies so they scale as we grow.

What You Bring

  • Experience: Some experience in recruiting (agency or in-house), talent acquisition, or a closely related field. Strong internship experience in recruiting will also be considered.
  • Full-Cycle Mindset: You're comfortable owning a process from start to finish and holding yourself accountable for results.
  • The "Hustle" Factor: A proactive, results-driven approach. You aren't afraid to pick up the phone, push back with a hiring manager, or try new ways to find talent.
  • Exceptional Communication: Strong written and verbal skills, plus the confidence to build relationships with candidates and hiring managers alike.
  • Organization: You can manage multiple requisitions, pipelines, and projects at once without dropping details.
  • Creativity: An eye for engaging content and a genuine interest in employer branding and company culture.
  • Discretion: Sound judgment and the ability to handle confidential information professionally.
  • Tech Savviness: Experience with an ATS and LinkedIn Recruiter is strongly preferred. Familiarity with an HRIS, Canva, or Google Workspace is a plus.
  • Educational Background: A degree in HR, Communications, Business, Psychology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Real Ownership: Run your own requisitions and see your hires make an impact across the company.
  • Mentorship & Growth: Learn from experienced recruiters and HRBPs who care about your development, with a clear path to Recruiter and Senior Recruiter roles.
  • Broad Exposure: Get hands-on experience across recruiting, employer branding, culture, and People operations.
  • Remote-First: Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote work environment.
  • Fast-Paced Culture: We promote successful team members and celebrate wins together.

Diversity & Inclusion

At OneLocal, we are committed to building an environment where every employee feels included, valued, and heard. We encourage applications from all candidates regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, age, citizenship, disability, or national origin.

raw.description:
Join Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, as a Project Manager eCOA in the United Kingdom and play a key role in delivering electronic Clinical Outcome Assessment (eCOA) solutions that support clinical trials worldwide. In this role, you will coordinate the successful delivery of digital patient data collection solutions, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Your work will help sponsors collect accurate, real-time patient data, improve compliance, and accelerate the development of life-changing therapies.


What we offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Attractive benefits focused on security, flexibility, support, and well-being
  • Engaging employee programs and development opportunities
  • Remote working and home office allowance

What you'll be doing

  • Manage all phases of study delivery, including planning, setup, execution, monitoring, and closeout
  • Act as the primary point of contact for assigned studies, ensuring clear communication with clients and internal teams
  • Gather and document customer requirements and translate them into actionable project deliverables
  • Develop and maintain study documentation, monitor project milestones, and oversee study-related activities
  • Track project timelines, budgets, forecasts, invoicing, and scope changes to ensure successful delivery
  • Identify potential risks and issues, implement mitigation strategies, and escalate concerns when appropriate
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure collaboration and alignment throughout the project lifecycle
  • Present study services and project updates during client meetings and internal discussions
  • Support onboarding, knowledge sharing, and training of new team members
  • Maintain compliance with applicable processes, training requirements, quality standards, and documentation procedures

What we look for

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
  • 1–4 years of project management experience, preferably within pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, contract research, clinical research, or healthcare environments
  • Understanding of the drug development process and clinical trial lifecycle
  • Strong organizational, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
  • Customer-focused mindset with the ability to build effective working relationships
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications
  • Project Management certification or willingness to pursue professional development in project management
  • Valid passport and willingness to travel up to 20% as business needs require

At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

raw.description:
Sedona Digital is a leading provider of IT Consulting and Services, specialising in Cloud Solutions, Software Engineering, Security, and Data & AI. We partner with enterprises to optimise their technology estates, delivering flexible engagement models ranging from augmentation to outcome-based projects and managed teams.

As part of our continued growth, we are seeking a Business Operations Analyst to strengthen operational efficiency and support the smooth execution of core business processes. This role is focused on improving cross-functional workflows, maintaining high-quality data across key systems, and ensuring critical operational activities are delivered accurately and on time. You will play a central role in enabling scalable processes, supporting internal teams with business-as-usual operations, and driving continuous improvement across systems, reporting, and operational practices.

Who We Are 

At Sedona, we thrive on solving complex challenges. By blending design, engineering, and analytics, we help organisations harness the power of technology to create innovative digital experiences and shape their future.

Your Role at Sedona Digital

The Senior Business Operations Analyst plays a key role in improving operational performance, data quality, and cross-functional effectiveness across Sedona Digital. The role combines business analysis, process optimisation, operational governance, and systems improvement, using data and business insight to identify gaps, recommend solutions, and drive scalable improvements.

You will own and analyse key operational processes, translate business requirements into effective workflows and system enhancements, and partner with stakeholders across the organisation to improve efficiency, control, and decision-making.

Key Responsibilities 

  • Intake & Workflow Administration: Manage operational intake and workflows to ensure timely, accurate, and efficient execution. Manage requests end-to-end, ensuring correct setup and adherence to agreed turnaround times.
  • Business as Usual (BAU) Responsibilities: You will support internal teams with BAU activities, help monitor key operational metrics, escalate risks or inefficiencies, and contribute to reporting and dashboards that inform decision-making and performance improvement.
  • Operational Efficiency & Process Improvement: You will map, document, and optimise business processes, identify bottlenecks, and introduce scalable solutions. This includes defining and embedding SOPs and supporting change management initiatives as new tools, systems, and processes are introduced.
  • Data Management & Systems Support: You will ensure data accuracy and completeness across key systems, manage and validate data within Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, and support ongoing system enhancements, including participation in UAT for new features, dashboards, and supporting tools.
  • Cross Functional Coordination: Act as a central point of coordination across teams to support alignment and delivery. You will collaborate across business functions to align operational needs acting as a communication bridge for cross functional initiatives and providing training and support to teams using operational systems.
  • New Process & Operational Design: You will partner with teams to improve processes, address data or operational issues, and ensure the business can scale without disruption.

Requirements

To excel in this role, you should have: 

  • 5 years in business operations, business analysis or a project management role. 
  • Experience in a fast-paced or high-growth environment is a plus. 
  • Experience in an IT Services organisation is preferable
  • Experience working with operational processes that interact with finance functions (e.g. invoicing, purchasing, project accounting, budgeting, forecasting, or management reporting) would be advantageous.
  • Experience with Microsoft Business Central (or other ERP systems) 
  • Experience with CRM, workflow management and ITSM (HubSpot, Jira, ServiceNow). 
  • Familiarity with project management processes and tools 
  • Experience with Data visualisation platforms like Power BI. 
  • Proficiency in spreadsheets (Excel) 
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving abilities. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Ability to collaborate across departments and work with multiple stakeholders. 
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities. 
  • Skilled in process mapping and operational documentation. 

Benefits

  • Remote/home working
  • Opportunity to work in a rapidly growing scale-up organisation
  • Medical insurance given after probation period
  • Ongoing learning and development opportunities
  • Holiday allowance in line with local legislation
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Performance - based bonus
  • Fun budget for team events

raw.excerpt: Über die RolleDu möchtest einen neuen Markt entwickeln, ohne dabei bei null anzufangen?
raw.description:
Über die Rolle

Du möchtest einen neuen Markt entwickeln, ohne dabei bei null anzufangen? In dieser Rolle gestaltest du den weiteren Aufbau unseres Retail-Media-Geschäfts für die Schweiz. Dafür nutzt du bestehende Kundenbeziehungen aus Deutschland, Österreich, Belgien und weiteren Märkten und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den verantwortlichen Account Ownern konkrete Wachstums- und Monetarisierungspotenziale für die Schweiz.

Gleichzeitig analysierst du, welche zusätzlichen Unternehmen, Marken und Entscheider für Redcare relevant sind, und entwickelst daraus neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten. Damit verbindest du strategische Account-Entwicklung mit proaktivem Business Development und übernimmst die kommerzielle Verantwortung für den Ausbau des Schweizer Retail-Media-Marktes.

Über deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst eine strukturierte Markt- und Account-Strategie für die Schweiz und priorisierst relevante Kunden, Marken, Kategorien und Entscheidungsträger.
  • Du analysierst bestehende internationale Kundenbeziehungen und identifizierst gemeinsam mit den jeweiligen Account Ownern, welche Retail-Media- und Umsatzpotenziale sich für die Schweiz erschließen lassen.
  • Du entwickelst bestehende Kundenpartnerschaften gezielt weiter und sprichst proaktiv neue strategische Kunden und Entscheider an, wenn noch keine geeignete Beziehung besteht.
  • Du übernimmst die kommerzielle Verantwortung von der Potenzialanalyse und strategischen Beratung über Forecasts und Joint Business Plans bis zu Pricing, Rate Cards, Tier-Modellen und Vertragsabschlüssen.
  • Du entwickelst belastbare Business Cases und passende Retail-Media-Lösungen und sorgst gemeinsam mit Campaign Management, Data, Ad Tech, Procurement und internationalen Sales-Teams für eine erfolgreiche Umsetzung.

Über dich

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Betriebswirtschaft, Marketing oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung beziehungsweise eine vergleichbare berufliche Qualifikation und bringst mindestens fünf Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung mit.
  • Du verfügst über Erfahrung im Key Account Management, Sales, Business Development oder Digital Advertising – idealerweise in Retail Media, Commerce Media oder E-Commerce – und kennst Formate wie Sponsored Products, Display und Programmatic Advertising.
  • Du kannst nachweisen, dass du bestehende Kundenbeziehungen auf neue Märkte, Lösungen oder Budgets ausgeweitet und zusätzliche Geschäftspotenziale eigenständig entwickelt hast.
  • Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit kommerzieller Initiative und verfügst über Erfahrung in komplexen Jahres-, Budget-, Pricing- oder Vertragsverhandlungen sowie in der Entwicklung datenbasierter Business Cases.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf C1-Niveau sowie fließend Englisch, arbeitest eigenverantwortlich in einem internationalen Stakeholder-Umfeld und bist bereit, bis zu 25 % zu reisen. Französisch und Erfahrung mit dem Schweizer Markt sind ein Plus.

Über deine Benefits:

Um dich bestmöglich bei deinen individuellen Bedürfnissen zu unterstützen – sei es ein gesundes Leben zu führen, genügend Zeit für deine Familie zu haben oder deine Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln – bieten wir dir eine Vielzahl unterschiedlicher, standortspezifischer Vorteile:

  • Urlaub: Du profitierst von 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr – für ausreichend Erholung und Ausgleich.
  • Mobilität: Wir übernehmen die Kosten für dein Wiener Linien-Jahresticket, damit du bequem und einfach ins Büro kommst.
  • Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: Wir fördern und unterstützen deine individuelle Entwicklung durch verschiedene interne und externe Trainings.
  • Mental Health: Erhalte schnelle und professionelle Hilfe durch Psycholog*innen von nilo, wenn du dich im privaten oder beruflichen Leben überfordert fühlst – anonym und kostenlos.
  • Redcare Events: Wir stärken den Teamgeist durch kreative Teamevents und feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam bei regelmäßig stattfindenden Partys.

Über Redcare Pharmacy

Als Europas führende Online-Apotheke wird Redcare Pharmacy von unseren engagierten Teams und modernster Innovation angetrieben. Wir streben danach ein angenehmes und kooperatives Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen in dem sich jeder Mitarbeitende wohlfühlt und gerne zu unserer Vision “Until every human has their health” beiträgt. Wenn du eine Karriere mit Bedeutung suchst die mit deinen Werten übereinstimmt komm’ in unser Team und starte deine #Redcareer

raw.title: Head of US Marketing
raw.excerpt: We are Hiring! We have an exciting new opportunity at Scope Health Inc for a Head of US Marketing to join our US team!
raw.description:
We are Hiring!

We have an exciting new opportunity at Scope Health Inc for a Head of US Marketing to join our US team!

We are looking for people who can connect their own personal vision and values into some of what we do at Scope.

Our vision as a company is to become a leading force in Eyecare, with people at our core.

Please read below the full job description for the role and if this is something that you would be interested in, please click apply and a member of the Scope team will be in touch regarding your application.

Head of US Marketing

The Head of US Marketing leads marketing for Scope’s US business. Reporting to the Chief Commercial Officer, this role owns the US marketing strategy and leads integrated brand planning for our US portfolio, including OPTASE, Eyetamins and Optase Life, driving growth across the eyecare professional channel, OTC retail, and Amazon.

This is a market leadership role with real scope. The Head of US Marketing focus is on winning in the US: building the brands with consumers and eyecare professionals, supporting a rapidly expanding national retail footprint, and leading a remote US marketing team. You will work in close partnership with US Sales, Commercial and Medical, and contribute to the commercial strategy for the market alongside senior leadership.

It is a role for someone who wants the breadth and pace of a growing, privately owned business, and who is energised by building a brand and a team in a market with significant headroom.

This is a remote role based in the United States, with travel as required.

Key Responsibilities

US Marketing Strategy & Brand Planning

  • Own the US marketing strategy and lead integrated brand planning for the US portfolio.
  • Translate global brand and innovation direction into US positioning, campaigns and activation that reflect how the US market buys.
  • Set clear priorities across brands and channels, and hold the plan to measurable commercial outcomes.

Omnichannel Marketing Leadership

  • Lead marketing across the eyecare professional (HCP) channel, OTC retail, Amazon, and Optase.com supporting.
  • Own Amazon marketing — content, search and retail media — and the commercial understanding of how the channel performs.
  • Build consumer and professional demand through content, digital, social, print, events, CRM and customer-facing programmes.

Retail Growth Support

  • Support the growth of Scope’s national retail footprint with the marketing, content and in-store activation that major national accounts require.
  • Partner with Sales and Commercial on customer plans, sell-in stories and promotional activity.

Go-To-Market & Launch Execution

  • lead US new product launch campaigns through the GTM process
  • Deliver launch plans for internal sales teams, HCP, retail and consumer campaigns.
  • Partner with Medical on eyecare professional and KOL engagement.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, develop and grow a remote US marketing team, setting clear standards for planning, quality and delivery.
  • Build capability across the team and create the conditions for people to do their best work at distance.

Commercial Ownership & Performance

  • Own the US marketing budget and allocate investment against the biggest growth opportunities.
  • Measure, analyse and report marketing performance, and act on what the data shows.
  • Represent Scope credibly with customers, eyecare professionals, KOLs and partners.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences or a related field required.
  • A postgraduate qualification is desirable. Significant relevant industry experience may be considered as an equivalent.

Knowledge & Skills

Omnichannel Marketing Expertise

  • Proven experience leading marketing across OTC retail, the HCP or professional channel, and Amazon. Experience across all three is essential.
  • Lead Amazon marketing, including content, search and retail media, with a clear understanding of how the channel works commercially.
  • Experience owning a brand.com or D2C e-commerce channel is an advantage.

Remote Leadership & Team Building

  • Demonstrated success leading a geographically dispersed, fully remote team — setting standards, building performance and developing people at distance.
  • A strong track record of building teams and developing talent.

Category & Market Experience

  • Substantial experience marketing OTC or consumer health brands to both consumers and healthcare professionals is essential.
  • Eyecare, ophthalmology or optical experience is an advantage, but not required.
  • Experience with smaller, high-growth brands and with US national retail accounts is highly valued.

Leadership & Strategic Capability

  • 10+ years’ marketing experience, including significant time leading multi-disciplinary marketing teams.
  • Able to set direction and contribute a clear point of view to commercial strategy alongside senior leadership, not only to execute against it.
  • Strong planning discipline — anticipates, plans ahead and flags risk early rather than managing reactively.
  • A leadership style that fits Scope’s culture and leadership behaviours.

Commercial & Analytical Rigour

  • Proven ability to own and manage a marketing budget.
  • Strong analytical capability, translating performance data and market insight into decisions and action.
  • High attention to detail and a consistently high standard of output.

Regulated Category Experience

  • Comfortable operating in a regulated category, where claims are substantiated and campaigns are reviewed through Medical and Regulatory.

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and a confident presenter who tailors the message to the audience.
  • Highly effective at building relationships and influencing across functions and with external partners.

Flexibility & Travel

  • Willingness to travel regularly, primarily within the US for customer meetings, sales meetings and congresses, with some international travel as required.
  • Ideally based in a metro area with a major hub airport to facilitate efficient travel.
  • Applicants must be authorised to work in the United States.

The expected base salary range for this role is $180,000 to $220,000. Actual placement depends on relevant experience and qualifications.

raw.description:
Adjunct Faculty - Microsoft 365 Endpoint Administration

Department of Cybersecurity | University of Maryland Global Campus (UMGC)

This position is specifically to teach remotely, for stateside applicants. Local applicants only; UMGC does not sponsor logistical support for this role.


Microsoft 365 Endpoint Administration (CMIT 380):

A lab-based exploration preparing students to become proficient in Microsoft Endpoint Administration. The focus is on deploying, configuring, securing, and maintaining modern endpoint devices using Microsoft solutions, including Intune, Entra ID, and Windows client management. Topics include endpoint deployment, application management, identity and access management, security policies, and troubleshooting techniques. Through hands-on exercises and industry-aligned assessments, skills will be developed to implement modern endpoints that meet the business needs of an organization.

At UMGC, we don’t just teach; we empower. Founded in 1947, UMGC is an open-access, minority-serving institution serving over 90,000 nontraditional learners worldwide, including a proud, large military-affiliated population. Our students are mature, highly dedicated, and balancing careers, families, and service. As an Adjunct Faculty member, you are the essential partner helping them bridge the gap between classroom theory and real-world career success.

Why Teach with UMGC?

  • Focus on Students, Not Course Design: All courses follow a standardized, pre-designed, unified course model. Standardized rubrics, OER materials, library resources, and digital textbooks are fully provided at no cost to you. You get to focus 100% of your energy on mentoring, facilitating, and providing high-quality feedback—no unpaid course-building required.
  • True Asynchronous Flexibility: Teach with flexibility, on your own schedule. As long as you meet weekly grading, responsiveness, and engagement milestones, your daily hours are entirely up to you.
  • Ongoing Growth: We invest in you. All newly hired faculty receive comprehensive online orientation, alongside ongoing, cost-free professional development opportunities.

The Rhythm of Your Week (Key Responsibilities)

Adjunct faculty bring our pre-built curriculum to life through real-world expertise and active mentorship.

Classroom Engagement & Presence

  • Be Visible: Maintain an active classroom presence at least 5 days per week, introducing yourself with a welcome announcement and driving discussions.
  • Bridge Theory & Practice: Enrich the pre-built curriculum with your own professional expertise and real-world examples.
  • Build Belonging: Foster an inclusive, culturally responsive environment where adult learners feel supported and motivated.

Responsiveness & Feedback

  • Stay consistently engaged with learners throughout the course by responding to inquiries, returning feedback, and posting final grades within the expected timeframe.

Proactive Support & Collaboration

  • Monitor Progress: Use available data tools to track student engagement and conduct proactive outreach to at-risk students.
  • Team Up: Partner with success coaches, academic staff, and portfolio directors to refer struggling students to UMGC support resources.
  • Stay Connected: Participate in UMGC's vibrant faculty community, including the Program Hub and ongoing training.

Course Structure & Time Commitment

  • Format: 100% Online & Asynchronous
  • Term Length: 8-week sessions (3-credit courses)
  • Class Size: Typically, 25–35 students (smaller sections for select courses)
  • Time Commitment: The adjunct faculty role requires a substantial commitment throughout the term focusing not only on academic success but also the social, personal, and professional growth of students

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education:
    • Master's degree in Cyber Operations or related field from an accredited institution of higher learning.
    • Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102)
  • Experience: Professional experience in Cyber Operations or related field
  • Legal Status: Applicants must have and be able to maintain their own legal status in the country in which they apply to teach.
  • English Language Proficiency: Applicants must demonstrate proficiency in written and spoken English sufficient to effectively teach course content, communicate with students, and evaluate academic work in English.
  • The Mindset: A deeply student-centered approach rooted in empathy, flexibility, professional integrity, and cultural responsiveness.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certifications: CISSP, CISA, CISM, IPP, CRISC, CCISO
  • Experience teaching adult learners in an online, asynchronous environment.
  • Prior postsecondary teaching experience.
  • Active engagement in your discipline's professional community.

Materials needed for submission

  • Resume/ Curriculum Vitae
  • Cover letter highly preferred
  • Unofficial Transcripts
  • If selected, candidates with international degrees may be required to submit a translation/degree evaluation from a NACES approved vendor.

All submissions should include a cover letter and resume.

The University of Maryland Global Campus (UMGC) is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal and state laws regarding nondiscrimination. UMGC is committed to a policy of equal opportunity for all persons and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, age, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, disability, religion, ancestry, political affiliation or veteran status in employment, educational programs and activities, and admissions.

The University of Maryland Global Campus Global Campus (UMGC) is committed to creating and maintaining a welcoming and inclusive working environment for people of all abilities. NOTE: Adjuncts are not eligible for the State of Maryland subsidized rates. Adjuncts would be responsible for the total cost if enrolled.

raw.description:
A Little Bit About Us:

Saphetor’s mission is to enable anyone to find, share and use the most comprehensive human genome data – and to collaborate to improve health and lives around the world.To do this we have built the VarSome suite of bioinformatic tools, the world’s leading resource for analysis and interpretation of human genome variant data, with more than 6 000 citations in scientific papers, and over 60 000 registered professional users. Our customers work around the globe across academic, clinical, and industry laboratories analysing NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) data for research and diagnostic purposes. Saphetor is a global precision medicine company with offices and distributed teams across Greece, Spain, the UK, Switzerland, France, USA, the MENA region, South America, and other countries, employing a diverse global workforce.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an Application Scientist in Bioinformatics to join our commercial organization.Standing at the intersection of bioinformatics and system operations, you will support our customers through their journey with VarSome, from pre-sales discussions and platform onboarding to post-sales support with cloud and on-premises deployments and finding new opportunities for further growth. You will play a key role in shaping and delivering solutions to our direct and indirect customers.

We thrive in a high-pressure, high-performance environment where clinical precision and rapid growth meet. While our pace is fast, it is always directed by rigorous organization and clear processes, ensuring that our commitment to quality is never compromised by our drive for speed.

Role Responsibilities

  • Pre-sales Support: Act as the technical “closer” by delivering expert demonstrations that bridge clinical needs with VarSome Premium, Clinical, API; you will own the customer evaluation process, solve “pain points” around variant analysis, and advise on lab equipment/system integrations.
  • Post-sales Support: Lead onboarding sessions for geneticists and bioinformaticians to ensure rapid “time to value”; you will act as the primary lead for on-premises and private cloud deployments, coordinating infrastructure specifications (storage, network) between clients and our DevOps team.
  • Workflow Optimization & Support: Fine-tune filtering strategies and automation to maximize platform “stickiness” while acting as a high-level bridge between customer support and stakeholders to ensure seamless routine operations.
  • Scientific Advocacy: Systematically gather power-user feedback to influence the product roadmap and cultivate strategic relationships for conference presentations (e.g. APCHG) and the development of technical white papers.

raw.title: Organic Search Lead
raw.excerpt: Role OverviewHallam is a B2B-specialist digital marketing agency.
raw.description:
Role Overview

Hallam is a B2B-specialist digital marketing agency. Our proposition is being chosen before the search begins, and discoverable when it does.

As an Organic Search Lead, you’ll own the Organic & AI Search strategy for some of our highest-billing, multi-channel accounts. You’ll be confident and experienced across both traditional and AI search - you know how to report on it, how to communicate it with clarity to clients and peers, and how to position it within the wider search landscape.

Around 60% of Google searches now end without a click as AI Overviews reshape the SERP. That means we need to build brands that are trustworthy and authoritative enough to be cited in AI answers - the new frontier of modern search success. At the same time, human search behaviour has fundamentally shifted: 40% of Gen Z use TikTok as a search engine, and 45% use Instagram. Search is no longer limited to Google - we must capture our audiences’ attention wherever they search organically online.

We call this Total Search. This requires deep audience understanding - the core of Hallam’s effective marketing. Using tools such as SparkToro to understand where our clients’ audiences actually spend their time, we build highly efficient, platform-agnostic campaigns that drive commercial outcomes.

Our Organic Search proposition is three-fold:

  • Traditional Search: Nailing the fundamentals to capture as much available market share as possible in Google & Bing.
  • Unified Search: Combining paid media and organic efforts to identify cannibalisation, wasted spend and missed opportunities, improving blended ROI for our clients.
  • Total Search: Our core proposition: a platform-agnostic Organic Search strategy that grows high-intent visibility across the full funnel, regardless of platform.

You’ll maintain a coaching and mentoring relationship with the SEO consultants in the team, speaking with authority both internally and externally.

We live by a team philosophy of KELI - Knowledgeable Experts that Love Innovation - using our knowledge to deliver the best outcomes and pushing ourselves to innovate further.

Purpose

  • Lead the Organic & AI Search strategy for a portfolio of Hallam’s highest-billing, multi-channel accounts.
  • Grow high-intent organic visibility across the full funnel
  • Build client brands that are trustworthy and authoritative enough to be chosen before the search begins.
  • Coach and mentor the SEO consultants in the team, raising the bar on craft and innovation.
  • Contribute to Hallam’s growth as a market-leading B2B marketing agency.

Responsibilities

  • Own the Organic & AI Search strategy end-to-end for your portfolio, from audience research through to measurement and reporting.
  • Lead AI Search strategy - including AI citation research, query fan-out analysis, and building brand authority to earn citations in AI Overviews and LLM answers.
  • Deliver against all three Organic Search propositions: Traditional Search, Unified Search (in collaboration with Paid Media) and Total Search.
  • Conduct deep audience research using SparkToro and other behavioural tools to identify where client audiences spend their time online - and shape platform-agnostic strategies accordingly.
  • Lead technical SEO work across your accounts, including internal linking audits, page speed audits, and site migration support.
  • Own content strategy for existing and new content - both re-optimisation to recover lost ground and new content to drive market growth in emerging categories.
  • Contribute to authority-building work, collaborating with the Digital PR team.
  • Lead keyword research and meta optimisation across client accounts, using Ahrefs, SE Ranking, Keywordtool.io and SparkToro.
  • Develop Organic Social content strategies (especially across visual discovery platforms - Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube) to support wider Organic Search presence.
  • Collaborate with Paid Media on Unified Search strategies - identifying cannibalisation, wasted spend and opportunities to replace PPC with Organic.
  • Report on performance confidently across GA4, GSC, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, SE Ranking and Google Data Studio.
  • Coach and mentor the SEO consultants in the team, providing technical and strategic guidance.
  • Present to clients and prospects with confidence, building engaging, persuasive presentations.
  • Build and refine AI workflows for SEO using LLMs, contributing to the team’s internal toolkit.
  • Contribute to Hallam’s growth as a B2B marketing leader - through thought leadership, cross-team collaboration and Marketing team support.

KPIs

All KPIs are measured monthly and targeted quarterly.

Client Performance

  • Growth in organic visibility across your portfolio.
  • Growth in AI citations and Share of LLM.
  • Commercial outcomes - organic-driven revenue, leads and pipeline contribution.

Client Satisfaction & Retention

  • High client NPS and retention across the portfolio.
  • Quality of reporting and strategic communication.

Commercial Contribution

  • Organic account growth through upsell and expanded scope.
  • Contribution to Unified Search opportunities alongside Paid Media.

Team Development

  • Quality of coaching and mentoring provided to SEO consultants.
  • Contribution to team knowledge sharing, innovation and process improvement.

Requirements

  • Demonstrable senior experience in Organic Search, with the confidence and authority to lead strategy internally and externally.
  • Strong knowledge of both Traditional Search and AI Search - including how to report on, communicate and measure both.
  • Deep technical SEO expertise: internal linking audits, meta optimisation, page speed audits, site migrations.
  • Confident with keyword research, AI citation research and query fan-out analysis.
  • Strong content strategy skills - both re-optimisation of existing content and new content to drive growth in new categories.
  • Experience with authority building / Digital PR as part of a holistic SEO approach.
  • Familiarity with our core toolkit: GA4, GSC, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, SparkToro, Keywordtool.io, SE Ranking, Google Tag Manager and Google Data Studio.
  • Experience working with LLMs to create AI workflows for SEO is highly desirable.
  • Confident client-facing presenter - able to build engaging presentations and present to clients and prospects.
  • Comfortable coaching and mentoring more junior team members.
  • Data-led mindset - we’re data nerds at Hallam, not led by vibes. You should be led by evidence and commercial impact.
  • Based in the GMT time zone; this is a remote role with quarterly in-person away days.
  • A nice and friendly person - we value enjoying our jobs more than anything.
  • Desirable: experience in Organic Social content strategy, particularly across visual discovery platforms (Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube).

Marketing

In this role, you will be expected to contribute both independently and collaboratively at the department level to drive the overall success of our marketing efforts. You will play an active role in thought leadership initiatives that support lead generation and help maximise the department’s impact. This includes contributing to a range of activities such as blogging, content creation, event support, and other marketing tasks. Your proactive involvement in these areas will be key to ensuring we consistently deliver high-quality marketing outputs and fully leverage the capabilities of the department.

Workplace Culture

At Hallam, we believe that a positive and inclusive workplace culture is the foundation of our success. Every employee plays a crucial role in fostering this environment by embodying and promoting our company values in their daily work and interactions. Whether collaborating with colleagues, engaging with clients, or driving innovation, we expect our team members to champion integrity, respect, and creativity. Together, we are committed to building a workplace that encourages growth, inclusivity, and excellence, ensuring that our values are reflected in everything we do.

BCorp

You will play a pivotal role in promoting the overall success of the Company. As a key member of the agency, you are expected to act in good faith to advance the Company’s mission of benefiting its members, while also having a material positive impact on society and the environment. Your decisions will be made with careful consideration of long-term consequences, the well-being of employees, and the nurturing of strong relationships with clients, suppliers, and other stakeholders. Additionally, you will ensure that the Company maintains a reputation for high standards of business conduct and operates in a manner that positively impacts the community and the environment. You will also ensure fairness among all members of the Company while driving its strategic objectives forward.

Salary: £37,000 - £55,000 DOE

raw.description:
Global ChangeFacilitator - Supply Resilience

Help strengthen the global biopharmaceutical supply chain and make a lasting impact on the delivery of medicines to patients.

Make a difference to the future of medicine

What if your ability to bring people together could help solve some of the biggest challenges facing the global pharmaceutical supply chain?

At BioPhorum, we bring together experts from across the global biopharmaceutical industry to collaborate on shared challenges, exchange knowledge and turn collective expertise into meaningful change. Established in 2004, we are a business-to-business membership organisation working with more than 150 organisations, including 18 of the 20 largest global biopharmaceutical companies. Through our collaborative network, more than 7,000 subject matter experts contribute to over 90 initiatives designed to improve the industry.

We are looking for a Global Change Facilitator to join our Supply Resilience Phorum, helping biopharmaceutical manufacturers, suppliers and logistics providers work together to build a more resilient, agile and sustainable global supply chain.

This is an opportunity to combine your scientific understanding, project management expertise and stakeholder engagement skills to address complex industry challenges and support the reliable delivery of high-quality medicines to patients worldwide.

Be at the heart of global supply resilience

About BioPhorum Supply Resilience

BioPhorum Supply Resilience brings together 34 member organisations, including many of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies, to strengthen the inbound biopharmaceutical supply chain. By sharing knowledge, experience and best practice, our members work collectively to anticipate risks, improve supply chain performance and drive innovation across the industry.

Global events, geopolitical uncertainty, increasing demand for raw materials and consumables, and evolving regulatory requirements continue to place pressure on pharmaceutical supply networks. Our members collaborate to develop practical solutions that improve supply chain visibility, strengthen risk management, enhance demand forecasting and support business continuity.

Through dedicated workstreams, members explore opportunities to advance digital transformation, improve traceability, promote regional manufacturing capabilities, address emerging materials of concern and encourage regulatory alignment. The Phorum also develops industry guidance, practical tools and strategic frameworks that help organisations assess their capabilities and identify opportunities for improvement.

By bringing together expertise from across the supply chain, BioPhorum Supply Resilience helps turn shared challenges into coordinated industry action, supporting a safer, more adaptable and sustainable supply network that ultimately benefits patients.

As Global Change Facilitator, you will play a central role in this collaboration. You will guide industry experts through complex discussions, help translate challenges into structured projects and ensure that collective knowledge delivers meaningful, measurable outcomes.

What will you be doing?

  • Lead and facilitate workstreams: Guide a portfolio of collaborative initiatives, helping members define priorities, agree objectives and deliver outcomes aligned with BioPhorum's strategy and governance.
  • Bring industry experts together: Create engaging, inclusive meetings that encourage open discussion, draw out specialist knowledge and build strong working relationships across manufacturers, suppliers and logistics providers.
  • Drive projects forward: Apply your project management skills to establish clear deliverables, manage timelines, monitor progress and keep workstreams focused on achieving their objectives.
  • Turn complexity into clarity: Bring together complex scientific, technical, operational and regulatory information and translate it into clear, accessible outputs that support industry-wide understanding and change.
  • Deliver meaningful industry outputs: Work with members to develop publications, practical guidance, proof of concepts, business cases, benchmarking tools and conference presentations that address supply chain challenges and demonstrate tangible value.
  • Support resilience and innovation: Facilitate discussions on areas such as supply chain risk, demand planning, traceability, digital transformation, materials of concern and business continuity, helping members identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Create impactful events: Collaborate with Phorum colleagues and the events team to plan and facilitate engaging virtual and in-person meetings, workshops and industry events.
  • Build member engagement: Monitor participation, identify emerging challenges and work with colleagues to maintain momentum, strengthen relationships and support member satisfaction.
  • Champion collaboration and continuous improvement: Share member insights, identify opportunities to demonstrate the value of BioPhorum's work and contribute to the ongoing development of our collaborative approach.

Bring your scientific knowledge and people skills together

We are looking for someone who understands the life sciences environment and enjoys bringing people together to solve complex problems. You will be comfortable working with highly knowledgeable industry experts, navigating technical discussions and turning different perspectives into practical action.

A scientific education or background is essential for this role. You will need a solid understanding of scientific and technical concepts to engage credibly with subject matter experts and understand the challenges affecting pharmaceutical manufacturing and supply chains.

Experience working within the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry would be highly advantageous, particularly in supply chain resilience, raw materials, procurement, manufacturing, quality, logistics, regulatory affairs or related areas. Experience in a CDMO or within pharmaceutical supply chain consulting would also be valuable.

You do not need to be the technical expert in every discussion. However, you should have the scientific grounding, curiosity and confidence to understand complex topics, ask insightful questions and help experts move towards a shared outcome.

You will bring:

  • A degree in a relevant scientific discipline, or an equivalent scientific education and background that enables you to engage confidently with complex life sciences topics.
  • Experience working within life sciences, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, CDMOs or a related technical environment.
  • Experience managing projects, programmes or change initiatives, ideally within pharmaceutical manufacturing, supply chain, procurement, logistics or operational excellence.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, build trust, adapt your communication style and bring diverse groups of people on a journey.
  • A collaborative mindset and a genuine enjoyment of facilitating constructive discussions, drawing out information and helping groups reach decisions.
  • The ability to synthesise complex information and communicate it clearly to different audiences, using plain language to make technical topics accessible.
  • Excellent organisation and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, competing priorities and agreed deadlines.
  • Sound judgement, initiative and a bias towards action, combined with the flexibility to adapt as priorities and discussions evolve.
  • An interest in supply chain resilience, risk management, digital transformation, sustainability and the wider challenges affecting the global pharmaceutical industry.
  • A continuous improvement mindset and the ability to work effectively with colleagues and stakeholders in a remote, fast-paced and growing organisation.

Help shape a more resilient pharmaceutical industry

If you are scientifically minded, thrive on collaboration and enjoy turning complex challenges into practical solutions, this is an opportunity to use your expertise in a role with a wider industry impact.

At BioPhorum, you will work alongside leading experts and organisations across the global biopharmaceutical sector, helping to develop collaborative solutions that strengthen supply chains, improve operational performance and support the consistent delivery of medicines to patients.

Location: Home-based, with occasional travel required. You must be able to commit to at least two UK trips and two international trips each year to support our annual events programme.

Ready to help strengthen the future of pharmaceutical supply chains?

Apply today and bring your scientific knowledge, collaborative approach and project leadership skills to BioPhorum.
