raw.description:
Who We Are

Vial is a hyper-scalable biotech company advancing programs into the clinic by leveraging dramatically cheaper trials and computationally designed therapeutics.

Our mission is to reimagine drug development in order to cure all human diseases. We have assembled a talented team of clinical operators, scientists, and innovative thinkers to achieve this vision.

Vial is fully remote and was founded by Simon Burns in October 2020. Since our founding, we have grown rapidly to a team of 50+ employees with over $100 million in funding from leading investors including General Catalyst, Box Group, and Byers Capital.

Vial is rebuilding the infrastructure to advance research. By deploying technology at every step, we are creating a more efficient future for drug discovery.

What You'll do

As a PBPK Modeler at Vial, you will play a critical role in predicting human pharmacokinetics (PK) and optimizing dosing strategies for our novel drug candidates across multiple modalities, including antibodies, small molecules, and oligonucleotides. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate in vitro, preclinical, and clinical data into physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) models to support decision-making in drug development.

We are looking for individuals who are deeply experienced in PBPK modeling, thrive in fast-paced environments, and can independently develop and validate models to guide clinical translation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and refine PBPK models to predict human PK for novel drug candidates using available in vitro and preclinical data.

  • Compare and validate PBPK models using published clinical PK data from reference compounds to establish model credibility.

  • Propose clinical dosing regimens based on PBPK model outputs, leveraging reference drug data for benchmarking.

  • Analyze and interpret model predictions, identifying key parameters influencing drug exposure and clearance.

  • Collaborate with internal scientists and external partners to integrate experimental data into PBPK modeling workflows.

  • Address discrepancies between preclinical and human PK predictions, providing insights into factors driving variation.

  • Incorporate variability (e.g., age, weight, genetics) into PBPK models, ensuring robustness of clinical predictions.

  • Adapt modeling approaches for different drug modalities (antibodies, small molecules, oligonucleotides), considering key differences in ADME properties.

  • Stay up to date on advancements in PBPK modeling, applying best practices and emerging methodologies.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of experience in PBPK modeling, preferably within a biotech or pharmaceutical setting.

  • Expertise in modeling across multiple modalities, with a strong understanding of PK principles for antibodies, small molecules, and oligonucleotides.

  • Proficiency in PBPK modeling software (e.g., Simcyp, GastroPlus, PK-Sim, Phoenix WinNonLin) and familiarity with programming languages such as R, Python, or MATLAB.

  • Strong understanding of ADME properties and their impact on drug disposition.

  • Experience with parameter estimation and model validation using clinical reference data.

  • Ability to propose and justify clinical dosing regimens based on model outcomes.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex modeling results into actionable insights.

  • Experience in multi-specific antibodies or extended half-life biologics.

  • Understanding of small molecule PBPK modeling, including key input requirements and differences from mAb models.

  • Prior experience supporting clinical trial design or regulatory submissions using PBPK models.

Why You’ll Love Working At Vial

Innate curiosity. At our core, we embody an insatiable curiosity. Our journey into the realm of clinical trials was ignited by a firsthand understanding of the challenges involved. This innate curiosity drives us to constantly innovate, seek fresh ideas, and bring our vision of reimagining clinical trials to life.

Fostering autonomy. Autonomy is our guiding principle. We firmly believe that when team members are entrusted with autonomy, they unleash their true potential. Our culture fosters an environment where each individual takes ownership of their domain, empowering them to make a profound impact.

The pursuit of mastery. We are dedicated to cultivating mastery. We understand the value of honing expertise in a craft. The pursuit of mastery, coupled with a deep sense of pride in one's workmanship, fuels our unwavering commitment to tackle intricate challenges. At Vial, we foster a culture of highly autonomous professionals, each an expert in their field, collaborating on an immensely demanding endeavor together.

Move fast, stay humble. Our strength lies in agility and humility. We firmly believe that intellectual honesty and a nimble mindset are the pillars of success. By staying adaptable and open-minded to all solutions, we tackle obstacles head-on, remaining humble in the face of adversity. This enables us to surmount the hurdles that confront us at every twist and turn.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity compensation

  • Generous paid time off and holidays

  • Remote-first work environment with flexible schedules

  • Company-provided laptop and home office setup stipend

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from '@' or '@' addresses. Vial is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

  • Develop and leverage enterprise quality intelligence and performance analytics to identify trends, risks, root causes, leading and lagging indicators, and improvement opportunities; partner with business and technical leaders to create actionable dashboards, monitoring capabilities, and data-driven performance insights.
  • Lead process redesign and transformation efforts using Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, change management, and other improvement methodologies to simplify, standardize, automate, digitize, and optimize workflows, processes, and controls.
  • Manage Noridian’s CMS innovation submission framework, including innovation intake, evaluation, prioritization, governance, development, submission, tracking, and organizational learning for innovation concepts aligned with business and CMS priorities.
  • Partner with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and address quality issues, operational risks, performance gaps, corrective actions, and strategic improvement opportunities.
  • Champion a culture of quality, innovation, and operational excellence by embedding continuous improvement principles into leadership practices, daily management routines, enterprise planning, employee development, and decision-making processes.
  • Build organizational capability in quality and continuous improvement through training, communities of practice, coaching, communication, and tools that strengthen process thinking, root cause analysis, data-driven decision-making, change leadership, and automation readiness.
  • Lead, develop, and manage the Quality Management, Improvement and Innovation team, establishing priorities, accountability, performance expectations, and professional development plans.
  • Influence and communicate effectively with leaders and stakeholders by leading governance activities, facilitating decision-making, preparing executive communications, reporting enterprise performance outcomes, and representing the function with internal and external stakeholders, including CMS.

Non-Essential Duties and Functions

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3 years of leadership experience managing staff, cross-functional initiatives, or improvement programs
  • Demonstrated success implementing quality, process improvement, operational excellence, or transformation strategies
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional business process improvement initiatives from problem definition through implementation and sustainment
  • Strong understanding of quality management systems, performance management, data-driven decision-making, root cause analysis, corrective action, and continuous improvement methods
  • Experience operating in highly regulated environments with significant compliance, customer, contract, financial, or reputational impact
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including preparation of leadership materials focused on insight, risk, decisions, and outcomes
  • Ability to travel independently to all company sites

Preferred Qualifications

Above requirements and the following:

  • Master's in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Engineering, Organizational Leadership, Quality Management, or related field
  • Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence, PMP, Prosci, Theory of Constraints or comparable certification
  • Experience supporting Medicare, Medicaid, healthcare payer operations, government contracting, or similarly regulated environments
  • Experience implementing or maturing an enterprise Quality Management System
  • Experience managing innovation intake, concept development, governance, or submissions in a government healthcare or regulated environment
  • Experience building improvement communities of practice, practitioner development programs, or enterprise operational excellence capability

Environment and Cognitive/Physical Demands

  • Requires prolonged sitting and telephone use
  • Requires the use of office equipment such as computer terminals, telephones, copiers and printers

  • Infrequent stooping

Segregation of Duties

Every employee is responsible to perform their duties and responsibilities in accordance with Noridian values, policies and procedures, including but not limited to: Segregation of Duties Principles, HIPAA, Security and Privacy, CMS requirements, the Noridian Compliance Program and any other applicable laws, rules and regulations.

Statement of Other Duties

This document describes the essential functions, requirements, and responsibilities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Employees may be requested to perform job related tasks other than those specifically listed in this description and may be required to perform any task requested by the supervisor or management.

Total Rewards Package:

Health, Dental and Vision Insurance, Voluntary Insurance Plans, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, 401k and Company Match, Company-paid Life Insurance, Education Assistance Program, Paid Sick Leave, Paid Holidays, Increasing PTO Accrual Plan, Medical/Parental/Disability Leave, Workers Compensation, Retiree Benefits, Severance Package, Employee Assistance Program, Financial and Health Wellness Benefits, Casual Dress, Open Office Setting, and Online Learning System.

raw.description:
As a Mid-Market Account Executive at HubSpot you will be engaging directly with small to medium sized businesses, helping them to grow. You will use proactive and inbound selling strategies to find and close new business, and increase the customer's usage of the HubSpot platform over time. You will use your knowledge of digital transformation and change management to act as a trusted advisor and business consultant to the customer, running the sales process end to end with them.

We are looking for the successful candidate to join our team as a remote employee based in Germany. Please check out this article for more context: The Future of Work at HubSpot: How We're Building a Hybrid Company.

Responsibilities of an Account Executive:

  • Develop and be responsible for your own annual, quarterly and monthly territory business plan
  • Find new prospects from both inbound and self-sourced leads
  • Run qualification calls with C-level executives and department leaders
  • Close both new business and install base at or above quota on a monthly cadence
  • Sell through internal champions to multiple stakeholders, as well as directly to C -level
  • Work collaboratively with HubSpot's marketing and technology departments to evolve our sales strategy when new features and products are introduced
  • Run online and occasionally in person product demonstrations

Role requirements:

  • 3-5 years in a quota carrying role
  • Fluency in English and German
  • Experience in a complex selling environment
  • Have presented and pitched to C-level executives on a business change
  • Management of monthly and annual pipeline as well as proven accuracy in forecasting
  • Goal orientated with track record of overachieving on monthly & annual targets
  • Trained and/or certified in a standardised sales method (E.g. Sandler)

Who exceeds in this role? Top performers will demonstrate:

  • An understanding of how businesses grow, and confidence advising C-level executives on growth strategies
  • Genuine curiosity about business and technology
  • A growth mindset and a habit of seeking feedback for self development
  • High performance in areas outside of professional work (E.g hobbies, side business, sport, creative)
  • Having taken on additional responsibility in a team environment (E.g coaching, mentoring, team projects)

What are some of the benefits of working at HubSpot?

  • Generous remuneration and stock units
  • Interactive employee training and onboarding
  • An education allowance up to €4,250 per annum
  • Life Assurance
  • Long term illness cover
  • 25 days holidays and unlimited vacation
  • Fitness reimbursement
  • Amazing colleagues to learn from and enjoy company social outings, parties, and events

Pay & Benefits

In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Individual compensation packages are determined using objective, role-related criteria, which may include skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

Annual Cash Compensation Range:
€110.896—€129.724 EUR

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

Site Contracts Specialist (Polish Required)

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Administers all contract management processes, including coordination with relevant protocol, informed consent, institution, investigator, vendor, consultant, and customer agreement documents at a project level.
  • May May lead (with supervision) multi-country projects including negotiating and preparing contracts, budgets, and related documents for participation in industry-sponsored clinical trials. Provides support to SSUL to agree on country template contract and budget. Produces site-specific contracts from country template. Provide support in submissions for proposed contract and budget for site. Provides support in negotiating budget and contract with site via Site Contracts Service Centre and SSUL with Sponsor until resolution of issues. Performs quality control and arranges execution of CTAs as well as archival of documents into repositories and capture of metadata. Reviews contracts for completeness and accuracy, and ensures that corrections are appropriately made and documented. Provides supports to business development and represents site contracts/Site Start-Up (SSU) at internal or customer meetings.

    Collaborates with internal and external legal, finance, and clinical operations departments, including communicating and explaining legal and budgetary issues. Facilitates the execution of contracts by company signatories.
    Maintains contract templates and site specific files and databases. Trains and mentors less experienced staff members on departmental Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and ensures quality of team work products.Maintains and updates training material for site contract team. Acts as a communication liaison between site contracts staff and internal and external customers. Provides functional guidance and keeps internal and external teams aware of all contract statuses or pending issues. Prepares correspondence as necessary.
  • Monitors basic financial aspects of the project and the number of hours/tasks available per contract; escalates discrepancies in a timely fashion.
  • Reviews and complies with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WIs) in a timely manner, keeps training records updated accordingly and ensures timesheet compliance.

Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Public Health, related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Advanced degree preferred.
  • High level of contracts management experience.
  • Experience in a contract research organization or pharmaceutical industry essential.
  • Strong knowledge of the clinical development process and legal and contracting parameters.
  • Strong computer skills in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Customer focused and ability to manage challenging priorities and to remain flexible and adaptable in stressful situations.
  • Excellent understanding of clinical trial process across Phases II-IV and ICH GCP.
  • Good understanding clinical protocols and associated study specifications.
  • Excellent understanding of clinical trial start-up processes.
  • Project management experience in a fast-paced environment.
  • Good vendor management skills.
  • Excellent written/oral communication, presentation, documentation, interpersonal skills as well as strong team-orientation.
  • Strong organizational skills with proven ability to handle multiple projects excellent communication.
  • Quality-driven in all managed activities. Strong negotiating skills. Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to mentor, lead and motivate more junior staff.
  • Demonstrate an ability to provide quality feedback and guidance to peers Contribute to a training and Quality assurance plan within SSU and update SOPs/WI.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

raw.description:
Please note that we do not accept unsolicited candidate introductions, referrals, or resumes from external recruiters or staffing agencies.

Location: Remote (U.S. based). This role supports Frontline customers in every market we serve and requires availability for rotating shifts, including overnights, weekends, and holidays. Candidates located in PST or MST time zones are preferred.

Background Check Requirement

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7–10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.

About Frontline Wildfire Defense

Founded in 2017, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME’s Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for “Most Innovative Housing Concept” and the Best of IBS Award for “Best Home Technology.”

As wildfires grow hotter and more frequent, our vision is to give people the tools and strategies to live safely with fire. We’re building a mission-driven team creating real-world solutions in wildfire safety and climate tech.

About This Opportunity

As Customer Success Manager, you will build and lead the team that stands behind every Frontline customer, from the day their system is installed through every fire season after. You will own Frontline’s customer support function and lead our Wildfire Response Specialists, the team that helps homeowners and commercial customers make sure their systems are ready, running, and doing their job when a wildfire is approaching.

Every Frontline system is designed to protect a property even after its owners have evacuated. Our fire-tracking software alerts customers when a wildfire comes within ten miles and starts an automatic activation countdown. Each system has a connected controller with Wi-Fi, cellular, and satellite connectivity and a backup battery. When it activates, eave sprayers and roof rotors wet the home and up to 30 feet around it with water and Class A foam. When fire is close, customers need fast, calm, accurate help, and you will be responsible for making sure they get it at any hour.

This is a founding, hands-on leadership role. You will hire and coach the team, design the coverage model and on-call rotation, build the playbooks and escalation paths the team runs on, and lead the team through active fire events. You will work closely with Solutions Engineering, Installation Operations, Field Service, and Product so that customer issues get resolved quickly and turn into lasting product and process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

  • Hire, onboard, and lead Frontline’s Wildfire Response Specialists, and grow the team as our customer base and coverage hours expand.
  • Coach the team on system troubleshooting, crisis communication, de-escalation, and documentation, and run regular 1:1s, call reviews, and performance management.
  • Build a culture of calm, ownership, and genuine care for customers, and protect the team from burnout through fair scheduling, post-event debriefs, and access to support resources.
  • Serve as a hands-on leader: take escalated calls, step into coverage gaps, and share the after-hours on-call rotation with the team

24/7 Response Operations

  • Design and run the team’s coverage model, including shift schedules, an after-hours on-call rotation, and surge staffing plans for Red Flag Warnings and active fires.
  • Lead the team during active fire events: decide outreach priorities, assign customers to specialists, track system status across affected properties, and keep leadership informed in real time.
  • Own the escalation matrix that connects the team to on-call engineering, field service, and leadership, and make sure it works at 2am as well as it does at 2pm.
  • Train and maintain a bench of cross-trained employees who can support the team during large or multiple simultaneous fire events.
  • Manage schedules, timekeeping, overtime, and labor costs for an hourly team in compliance with federal and state wage and hour rules, including meal and rest breaks.

Customer Support & Customer Experience

  • Own the end-to-end customer support experience across phone, text, email, and app messages for homeowners and commercial customers.
  • Define and track SLAs and key metrics, including response time, resolution time, first-contact resolution, escalation rate, and customer satisfaction, and report them to leadership on a regular cadence.
  • Serve as the final escalation point for complex, sensitive, or unresolved customer issues.
  • Build proactive programs that keep customers ready: new-owner onboarding (app setup, contacts, and alerts), pre-fire-season readiness check-ins, and outreach during Red Flag Warnings.
  • Lead post-fire recovery: make sure every affected customer is contacted and that foam and water refills, inspections, and repairs are scheduled with Field Service.

Systems, Process & Documentation

  • Build and maintain the team’s infrastructure, including the ticketing system, phone routing for 24/7 coverage, response playbooks, call scripts, SOPs, and knowledge base.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to define the tools the team needs, such as visibility into which customers are near an active fire and each system’s live status.
  • Work with leadership and Legal to set clear protocols for sensitive actions, such as verifying a caller’s identity and getting customer consent before any remote action on their system.
  • Track system performance and property outcomes after fire events so the data can inform product improvements and Frontline’s performance reporting.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering, Installation Operations, and Field Service to make sure field issues are captured, documented, and resolved by the right team.
  • Bring recurring customer issues and feedback to Product so they shape roadmap decisions.
  • Work with Sales, Marketing, and our partners to keep messaging about system capabilities and Frontline’s response service accurate and consistent.

Qualifications

Must-Have:

  • 5+ years of experience in customer support, customer success, emergency communications, or monitoring center operations, including at least 2 years leading a team.
  • Experience leading a team that provides extended-hours or 24/7 coverage, including building shift schedules, on-call rotations, and escalation paths.
  • Proven ability to stay calm and lead others through high-pressure, time-sensitive situations.
  • Experience building or scaling a support team, function, or process in a growing company.
  • Experience owning support metrics and reporting (SLAs, CSAT, first-contact resolution, escalation rates).
  • Hands-on experience with ticketing and phone platforms (e.g., Zendesk, Intercom, HubSpot, or similar) and building the processes around them.
  • Experience managing hourly employees, including scheduling, timekeeping, and overtime.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to de-escalate difficult conversations with care.
  • Availability to take part in an after-hours on-call rotation and to work extended hours during active fire events.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and Slack.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Background in emergency dispatch, alarm or central station monitoring, a network operations center, or fire and life safety.
  • Experience supporting connected hardware, IoT, smart home, or security products.
  • Incident Command System familiarity (e.g., FEMA IS-100 and IS-700) or working knowledge of wildfire behavior, Red Flag Warnings, and evacuation zone tools such as Genasys Protect or Watch Duty.
  • Background in home services, construction, or field service, including experience with ServiceTitan or similar field service management software.
  • Experience building a customer-facing knowledge base or self-service support resources.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary Range: $90,000 - $115,000 annually, based on experience.
  • Company-provided cell phone and laptop
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Flexible time off + 14 paid holidays (yes, your birthday is one of them!)
  • Work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup
  • Remote-first work environment, fostering work-life balance and autonomy
  • Company-provided equipment
  • Join a high-performing, mission-driven team doing work that truly matters
  • And much more!

Join Our Mission!

If you're excited about building technology that protects homes and families from wildfire disasters, we want to hear from you! Apply today and become part of a fast-growing team with purpose and innovation at its core.

Diversity and inclusion are essential values at Frontline. We know we'll do our best and most impactful work when we feel represented, and we belong. We encourage talented people from a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

The Mission

At CovertSwarm, we're redefining offensive security through constant, relentless attack. As a Senior Hive Member, you'll lead sophisticated operations that push beyond traditional boundaries, mentoring fellow operators while discovering new attack vectors that others miss.

The Opportunity

This isn't just another testing role. You're an experienced operator who thrives on finding creative ways to breach sophisticated defences and can find previously unknown vulnerabilities. You'll lead complex operations, mentor rising talent, and help shape the future of offensive security.

The Arsenal (Core Responsibilities)

  • Perform specialized security assessments across multiple domains
  • Guide clients through complex security challenges, from technical teams to C-suite executives
  • Mentor and elevate fellow Hive members, sharing your expertise to strengthen the Swarm
  • Pioneer new attack methodologies and automated tooling that benefit the entire team
  • Own and evolve key aspects of our operation (tooling / methodology / repositories / process)
  • Shape our community through regular technical content creation and knowledge sharing
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders while maintaining our high standards of client communication

The Operator (What Makes You Great)

  • Proven experience in one or more cybersecurity testing domains

  • Expertise with both manual and automated security tools
  • Ability to think creatively and adapt attack methodologies

The Human Element

  • Sharp analytical mind with keen attention to detail
  • Natural problem solver who thrives on complex challenges
  • Clear communicator who can translate technical concepts for any audience
  • Self-driven learner committed to continuous professional development
  • Team player who contributes to the collective knowledge of the Swarm

The Credentials

  • CCT-INF (CREST Certified Tester – Infrastructure)
  • CCT-APP (CREST Certified Tester – Application)
  • CCRTS (CREST Certified Red Team Specialist)
  • CCRTM (CREST Certified Red Team Manager)

We’d also like to see you having a couple of the following - though this isn't mandatory:

  • CSTL (Cyber Scheme Team Leader)
  • CREST CRT (CREST Registered Penetration Tester)
  • CSTM (Cyber Scheme Team Member)
  • CRTO (Certified Red Team Operator)
  • GPEN (GIAC Penetration Tester)
  • LPT (Licensed Penetration Tester Master)

The Perks

  • True remote flexibility – work from anywhere
  • No report writing drudgery – we use our custom portal
  • Unlimited training to keep your skills sharp
  • Unlimited vacation – because burnout helps no one
  • Private medical insurance and pension scheme
  • Conference speaking bonuses
  • Hardware, software, and research materials you need to excel
  • A culture of radical candor and continuous improvement

The Culture

At CovertSwarm, we take pride in pushing the boundaries of offensive security. Our team consists of passionate and humble professionals who value creativity, technical excellence, and delivering results that matter. Join PatientPoint to be part of a dynamic team creating change in and around the doctor’s office. As a leading digital health company, we innovate to positively impact patient behaviors. Our purpose-driven approach offers an inspirational career opportunity where you can contribute to improving health outcomes for millions of patients nationwide.

Location: Remote

Travel Required: Less than 15%

Job Summary

As the Director, Technical Program Management, Ad Tech, you will lead delivery across PatientPoint’s Ad Tech portfolio, partnering with Product, Engineering, Data, Ad Operations, Yield, Sales and other business teams to translate strategy into coordinated, predictable execution.

You will own the delivery operating model across a complex portfolio including Precision Ad Tech, Programmatic, Ad Server, GAM, Yield, infrastructure and platform initiatives, vendor implementations, and cross-functional dependencies.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will lead and develop the TPMs supporting Ad Tech while remaining close enough to the work to step into complex delivery challenges when needed. You will create clear visibility into portfolio health, risks, dependencies, decisions and launch readiness while helping the team mature how it plans and delivers.

What You’ll Do

Portfolio & Delivery Leadership

  • Own integrated planning and delivery health across the Ad Tech portfolio.
  • Establish clear portfolio visibility across priorities, milestones, dependencies, risks and decisions.
  • Create effective operating cadences for planning, RAID, delivery health and launch readiness.
  • Lead complex cross-functional programs spanning Product, Engineering, Data, Operations and external partners.
  • Anticipate delivery risks and dependencies and drive resolution before they materially impact outcomes.
  • Step directly into high-priority delivery or operational challenges when additional leadership is needed.
  • Ensure major launches have clear ownership, readiness criteria, success measures and contingency plans.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the delivery counterpart to senior Product and Engineering leaders across Ad Tech.
  • Build strong relationships across Product, Engineering, Data, Ad Operations, Yield, Sales and Revenue.
  • Challenge assumptions, commitments and delivery plans constructively when risks or dependencies are not sufficiently understood.
  • Bring the right leaders together to resolve cross-functional issues and drive timely decisions.
  • Escalate material risks or unresolved decisions with clear context and a recommendation.
  • Connect technical delivery to operational and commercial outcomes.

People & TPM Leadership

  • Lead, coach and develop the TPMs supporting the Ad Tech portfolio.
  • Set clear expectations for program leadership, stakeholder management, technical depth and accountability.
  • Help TPMs move beyond coordination and reporting toward proactive program leadership.
  • Partner with the broader Tech PMO team to establish consistent program and portfolio practices.
  • Help drive adoption of common planning, delivery, portfolio visibility and AI-assisted delivery practices across the organization.

What We Need

  • 10+ years of technical program, portfolio or technology delivery leadership experience.
  • Ad Tech, digital media or programmatic advertising experience
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, multi-team technology portfolios or programs.
  • Experience leading and developing Technical Program Managers or similar delivery leaders.
  • Strong technical literacy and credibility with Product and Engineering leaders.
  • Deep experience in integrated planning, dependency management, risk management, delivery health and launch readiness.
  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to create structure and accountability in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Ability to operate at both portfolio level and hands-on delivery level.
  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to connect technology execution to business outcomes.

Desired Experience

  • Experience with complex platforms, vendor implementations, technology transformations or platform migrations.
  • Familiarity with ad serving, programmatic platforms, yield management, SSP/DSP ecosystems, measurement or advertising data.
  • Experience working across Product, Engineering, Data, Operations and commercial teams.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • You create clarity from ambiguity.
  • You anticipate issues rather than simply report them.
  • You drive accountability without unnecessary process.
  • You can operate with senior leaders and still step into the details when needed.
  • You challenge constructively and bring recommendations, not just problems.
  • You develop strong TPMs and raise the quality of program leadership around you.
  • You build trust across technical and business teams.

Base Salary Band: $162,900 - $228,500

Compensation: At PatientPoint, we are committed to providing competitive pay and benefits that are in line with industry standards. We analyze and carefully consider several factors when determining compensation, including skills, qualifications, geographic location, and professional experience, which can cause your compensation to vary. The base salary range listed is just one component of PatientPoint’s total compensation package for employees. For additional details on our total benefits package, please review the section “About PatientPoint” at the end of this job description.

About PatientPoint: PatientPoint® is the Point of Change company, transforming the healthcare experience through the strategic delivery of behavior-changing content at critical moments of care. As the nation’s largest and most impactful digital network in 30,000 physician offices, we connect patients, providers and health brands with relevant information that is proven to drive healthier decisions and better outcomes. Learn more at patientpoint.com.

raw.description:
For The Children intends to fill one Regional Growth Representative position. The position may be filled by an office-based employee in Orange County, California, or a remote employee residing in the Pacific (outside of Los Angeles area) or Mountain Time Zone. This posting is for the remote (Pacific or Mountain Time) work arrangement. Candidates should apply to only one version.

At For The Children, we believe the local Church can be a powerful source of belonging, connection, and hope for children who have experienced relational trauma.

Through Royal Family KIDS Camp and Mentoring, we mobilize churches and volunteers to serve children in foster care. Today more than 20,000 volunteers across 45 states and 9 countries reach over 7,500 children each year - and we want to equip even more churches to join this work.

We are looking for a gifted relationship builder who can make this possible.

The Opportunity

The Regional Growth Representative develops relationships with pastors, ministry leaders, churches, and community partners throughout an assigned region. You will introduce leaders to the mission of For The Children, help them imagine how their church could serve children in foster care, and guide interested churches toward launching a Royal Family KIDS Camp or Mentoring program.

This is a highly relational, externally facing role. You will often be the first person someone meets from For The Children—whether at a church, conference, community gathering, or introductory conversation. Your ability to listen well, communicate our mission, build trust, and inspire action will directly contribute to more children experiencing safe, positive, and life-changing relationships.

This position reports to the Senior Vice President, Church Engagement and serves as part of the Chapter Growth Department.

What You’ll Do

Build Meaningful Church and Community Partnerships

  • Cultivate new relationships with pastors, ministry leaders, and other church decision-makers.
  • Introduce churches to For The Children and the opportunities available through Royal Family KIDS Camp and Mentoring.
  • Guide interested churches through the journey from initial conversation to becoming an active chapter.
  • Maintain consistent follow-up and relationship management throughout the partnership-development process.
  • Represent For The Children at local, regional, and national conferences, gatherings, and ministry events.
  • Build relationships with foster care agencies, local government representatives, nonprofit organizations, and other community partners.
  • Identify opportunities to expand awareness of and participation in For The Children’s mission.

Support Healthy, Sustainable Chapters

  • Participate in chapter and program visits throughout the assigned region.
  • Facilitate local collaborative conversations that bring churches and community leaders together around the needs of children in foster care.
  • Listen for emerging needs, opportunities, and barriers—and connect chapters with the appropriate support.
  • Help cultivate long-term church engagement rather than one-time participation.

Communicate and Equip

  • Speak about For The Children’s mission in churches, conferences, and community settings.
  • Adapt presentations and conversations for pastors, volunteers, ministry teams, and community leaders.
  • Depending on experience and organizational needs, facilitate selected training events.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means:

  • New chapters move successfully from initial interest to launch.
  • More churches understand the needs of children who have experienced relational trauma.
  • Church leaders feel heard, supported, and confident as they explore becoming a chapter.
  • Chapters become healthy and sustainable through strong community partnerships.
  • Every interaction reflects the warmth, professionalism, faith, and relational care of For The Children.

You May Be a Great Fit If You Are

  • Energized by meeting new people and building authentic, long-term relationships.
  • Comfortable initiating conversations, following up consistently, and inviting others to take meaningful action.
  • A compelling communicator who can connect with both individuals and large groups.
  • Familiar with how churches operate and how ministry decisions are made.
  • Organized, dependable, and capable of managing multiple relationships and opportunities at once.
  • Comfortable working independently as part of a collaborative, remote team.
  • Deeply motivated by the opportunity to serve children who have experienced relational trauma.
  • A Christ follower with a passion for the local Church.

Experience and Qualifications

  • Experience in pastoral ministry, church engagement, partnership development, community outreach, nonprofit growth, or a related field is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree, M.Div., or equivalent relevant experience preferred.
  • Strong written, public-speaking, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize work, manage follow-up, and maintain accurate relationship records.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and comfort learning other digital collaboration and relationship-management tools.
  • Alignment with the Christian mission and values of For The Children.

Compensation and Work Location

  • This position will work remotely and must be located within the Pacific or Mountain Time Zones.
  • The compensation range is $75,000 – 90,000 annually. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications and demonstrated capabilities.

Schedule and Travel

  • Approximately 30% travel, including regional and occasional national travel.
  • Some evening and weekend availability is required for church meetings, conferences, program visits, and events.
  • Must be able to transport and handle event or presentation materials weighing up to 50 pounds, with reasonable accommodations available as required.

For The Children’s vision and mission are available here; our statement of faith is available here.

Position Overview:

Role-Bioinformatics Product Owner

Location-Remote (PST Hours)

Contract

Duration: 6+ months with a high possibility of extension

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Product Owner to drive the development of a cutting-edge test designed to identify clinically actionable mutations in patients with solid tumors.

This role is crucial in ensuring seamless coordination across software development, bioinformatics, clinical genomics, and regulatory teams to deliver high-quality, compliant, and innovative software solutions for precision oncology.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the product roadmap for NGS bioinformatics pipeline and supporting software.
  • Prioritize and manage the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business objectives and clinical needs.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders (Clinical Development, Laboratory Operations, Medical Affairs, Bioinformatics, Engineering) to optimize NGS pipeline performance and data analysis.
  • Define epics, user stories, and functional software requirements in JIRA & Confluence.
  • Work closely with bioinformaticians and engineers to ensure seamless NGS data analysis and downstream interpretation.
  • Lead Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and retrospectives).
  • Provide business and domain expertise to software developers and QA teams during SDLC.
  • Develop documentation for computer systems validation (CSV) and ensure adherence to FDA regulatory guidelines.
  • Apply in-depth bioinformatics knowledge to refine NGS pipeline, variant analysis, and clinical reporting.
  • Ensure that the pipeline meets cancer genomics guidelines (e.g., CAP, AMP, FDA, and CLIA standards).
  • Collaborate with data scientists and bioinformaticians to enhance whole genome, whole exome, and transcriptomics analysis.
  • Communicate effectively with scientific, technical, and business teams to align product development with clinical and regulatory requirements.
  • Work with regulatory teams to ensure compliance with oncology diagnostics guidelines and FDA standards.
  • Coordinate with Quality Assurance to develop verification and validation test plans for software supporting NGS workflows.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Domain Expertise

  • Strong background in Bioinformatics, Cancer Genomics, and NGS Data Analysis.
  • Experience with NGS pipelines, Whole Genome, Whole Exome, and Transcriptomics workflows.
  • Knowledge of clinical genomics guidelines (FDA, CLIA, CAP, AMP).

Technical & Software Development Knowledge

  • Understanding of NGS tools, workflows, and cloud-based orchestration (AWS HealthOmics, Nextflow, etc.).
  • Familiarity with Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and documentation best practices.
  • Experience using JIRA & Confluence for requirement tracking and task management.

Product Management & Leadership

  • Proven experience as a Product Owner in a bioinformatics, clinical genomics, or oncology-related software environment.
  • Strong requirement gathering, task prioritization, and delivery-focused mindset.
  • Excellent communication, teamwork, and stakeholder engagement skills.

Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge

  • Familiarity with FDA regulatory requirements for genomics software.
  • Experience with Computer System Validation (CSV) and compliance documentation.

Key Skills – Quick Reference

  • In-depth knowledge in Bioinformatics.
  • Cancer Genomics.
  • Whole Genome, Whole Exome Sequencing and Transcriptomics analysis.
  • Understanding of NGS Tools and applications.
  • NGS Pipeline and data analysis.
  • Downstream analysis of NGS data.
  • Requirement gathering and refinement expertise.
  • Knowledge of SDLC.
  • Documentation.
  • FDA Compliance knowledge.
  • Knowledge of guidelines to follow on cancer genomics.
  • Experience working as a Product Owner.
  • Task prioritization.
  • Delivery-oriented mindset.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Great attention to detail.
  • Organizational skills.
  • Analytical mindset.
  • JIRA & Confluence.

Other Job Details

  • Work Schedule: PST Hours
  • Interviews: Video interviews.
  • Docs required: ID proof will be required.
  • Availability: Candidates able to join immediately are preferred

raw.description:
BCM One is looking for a Partner Development Manager to expand our relationship with Bridgepointe, a strategic partner in the technology services distribution channel. This is an opportunity to step into a highly visible role where you will have real ownership, build relationships across the partner ecosystem, and directly influence growth.

You will be at the front of the sales cycle; building relationships with new sellers, strengthening existing partnerships, sharing knowledge around BCM One's solutions, and recognizing opportunities where we can win together. When an opportunity is ready to move forward, you will partner closely with our National Account Executives to bring the right resources into the conversation.

This is a great next step for someone who already knows the telecom channel and is ready for more ownership. You will have the freedom to build your partner strategy, establish your relationships, and make decisions. You will benefit from having an experienced team around you when you need support. In this role, you will gain exposure across BCM One's solutions and partner ecosystem while building the skills to take your channel career further.

Work Locations:

Preference will be given to candidates based in the greater NY, NJ, PA tri-state area. Candidates must reside in and be authorized to work in the United States. This role is not eligible for relocation assistance or visa sponsorship.

Hours:

Typically eastern business hours with flexibility

Travel:

20% Domestic annually

What You Will Do:

  • Serve as a trusted BCM One resource within the Bridgepointe ecosystem, building strategic relationships with sellers and key stakeholders while developing a clear plan for engagement and growth.
  • Build awareness with our strategic partners to keep BCM One top of mind through regular conversations, presentations, training, product updates, and in person meetings that help partners understand where our solutions can add value.
  • Engage sellers early, identify and qualify opportunities, and connect the right opportunities with our National Account Executives and internal experts to move them forward.
  • Leverage CRM and partner activity data to understand performance, prioritize relationships and opportunities, forecast effectively, and focus your time where you can have the greatest impact.
  • Help partners navigate channel conflicts, service concerns, and business challenges by bringing together the right resources across Sales, Sales Operations, Finance, Product, and other BCM One teams.
  • Take ownership of your partner strategy, continually refine your approach based on results, and turn stronger engagement into sustainable year over year revenue growth.

What You Will Need:

  • 2+ years of relevant experience in partner development, channel account management, business development, sales, account management, or a similar customer facing role.
  • Telecom channel experience and an understanding of how partners, sellers, and sales teams work together to create opportunities.
  • Experience working with Bridgepointe, including familiarity with their structure, seller ecosystem, or selling approach.
  • Experience with enterprise voice and telephony solutions, such as SIP, PSTN, unified communications, or related telecom services.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, whether you are connecting one on one with a seller or presenting information to a larger group.
  • Good judgment and critical thinking. You can assess an opportunity, make decisions, and know when it is time to bring other people into the conversation.

Compensation:

$80,000 to $110,000 base salary. Commissions and benefits will be in addition to the base salary. Compensation at BCM One varies depending on a wide variety of factors, including and not limited to: geographic location, role, skill set, degree/certifications, and level of experience.

Who We Are:

BCM One is a leading telecom provider of NextGen Communications and Managed Services that has been in business for 30 years with more than 18,000 business customers and 5,000 channel partners who rely on our products, services, and teams to support their critical underlying network infrastructure. BCM One is the parent company to our family of brands that includes SIP.US, SIPTRUNK, Flowroute, SkySwitch, and Pure IP.

Joining the BCM One team is a chance to be part of a financially strong company with an exciting growth story; over the past 4 years we’ve brought together leading companies in our space who have built products, services, and programs to innovate and disrupt our industry. Now, operating under one roof, we are taking BCM One to the next level and looking for talented individuals to help make that happen.

When you choose to work at BCM One, you get to work with a talented team and build experience with the leading technologies, suppliers, and partners in our industry. We don’t offer cookie-cutter solutions, so the opportunities are endless, and the work is always varied and interesting. We take our mission “to provide a world-class experience with every human interaction” seriously, which means everything you do makes a difference. And we’re committed to building and nurturing a diverse and inclusive workforce and environment that empowers you to do your best work, spread your wings and reach your full potential. At BCM One, we encourage our team to learn something new every day, so you don’t just become part of our growth story, we become part of yours.

Why BCM One:

We are committed to creating an environment that fosters accountability, innovation, and teamwork. Many BCM One employees have been with the company for 10+ years, which we think says a lot about our culture.

We Are a Team

  • We pride ourselves on our team-based approach to providing quality solutions for our clients. BCM One encourages a culture of collaboration, exposing employees to different areas of the business and fostering career growth.
  • We support employee involvement and provide opportunities to be responsible stewards via our BCM One Gives Back Program and our Emergency Fund to help our team members who are going through difficult times.

Hard Work is Recognized

  • We offer an Employee of the Quarter program with a monetary award and Employee of the Year that includes a 7-day vacation package to the Caribbean. In addition, we host various regional team-building gatherings throughout the year.
  • We believe in developing our team members and offer many opportunities for training, professional development and career growth.

Your Voice is Heard

  • We empower our team members to speak up and look for opportunities in challenges.
  • We have an Employee Council and a Diversity Equity and Inclusion Committee made up of volunteers from across the company who share a passion for making BCM One a great place to work and find ways to positively impact our communities.

How we take care of you:

  • Competitive industry salaries
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Company-provided life and disability insurance
  • Matching 401 (k) plan
  • Employee Emergency Assistance Fund
  • Paid holidays and vacation time
  • FMLA

BCM One is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Position Title

Relationship Manager - Fiduciary Banking/Specialty Deposits

Location

Nationwide, MI 48098

Job Summary

The Relationship Manager-Fiduciary Banking manages commercial depository relationships. Generates new business and relationships that will produce revenue from title companies, residential and commercial property managers, developers and businesses. Generates deposits and payments deal flow directly from these clients/prospects and orchestrating a team approach to the relationship.

The position is supported by treasury management specialists, product specialists, portfolio managers (credit, underwriting, transaction approvals/processing) and operational support specialists but remains accountable for all aspects of the relationship. Responsible for the origination, negotiation, structuring, pricing, underwriting, and closing of deposits and treasury management solutions. Manages a complex commercial depository portfolio ensuring the highest quality for the organization with minimal risk. Manages the on-going monitoring of portfolio quality and ensures compliance with applicable laws, regulations and guidelines.

Job Responsibilities:

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

New Business Origination:

  • Develop and maintain relationships to generate direct deal flow. Position will be focused on generating new business that focuses on the entire banking relationship; Coordinates the team approach to approving and closing new deals to grow deposits and revenues while optimizing profitability (ROE).

Relationship Management:

  • Works with assigned treasury management personnel and portfolio managers, engage with clients on idea generation and relevant opportunities to expand our relationship.

Industry Outreach:

  • Stays abreast of industry trends and market conditions in specialty deposits that could impact the assigned portfolio of relationships. Attend conferences and participate in speaking opportunities as a subject matter expect related to the intersection of specific specialty industry and banking.

Credit Quality and Onboarding:

  • When client/prospect lending needs arise, work with assigned portfolio managers to ensure pro-active monitoring of the credit quality of the portfolio through timely financial statement gathering, monitoring client’s compliance with ongoing required reporting, properly analyzing financial information and taking or recommending appropriate corrective actions based on acceptable levels. Ultimately responsible for managing the banks risk exposure to acceptable levels. Collaborating with Credit team and outside counsel as needed to prepare credit approval documents and managing onboarding process to ensure transactions are booked appropriately.

Maintaining Knowledge:

  • Stays abreast of industry trends and market conditions that could impact the assigned portfolio of relationships and borrowers.
  • Uses independent judgement and discretion to make decisions.
  • Analyzes and resolves problems.

ADDITIONAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Performs special projects, and additional duties and responsibilities as required.
  • Consistently adheres to regulatory and compliance policies and standards linked to the job as listed and complete required compliance trainings. Accountable to maintain compliance with applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Required Qualifications:

  • Education level preferred: High School / High School Equivalency (GED, HiSET, TASC) / Foreign Equivalent .
  • Minimum experience required: 6+ Years as a Commercial Relationship Manager and/or commercial depository and treasury management sales. Some experience in commercial treasury management support may substitute for production experience.
  • Experience specific to specialty deposits industries; including treasury management, Investment Banking, or Capital Markets experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Education level preferred: Undergraduate Degree (4 years or equivalent) or equivalent experience. In business, finance or related field.

Job Competencies:

  • Certified Treasury Professional (CTP) designation.
  • Knowledge of commercial deposits, treasury management services, account analysis, and depository pricing skills.
  • Industry knowledge: Some understanding of specialty deposits industries including title companies, residential and commercial property managers, etc.
  • Demonstrated analytical skills to understand financial and cash flow analyses.
  • Experience utilizing a calling strategy to actively call on prospects/clients and establish a personally-developed network of clients and potential clients to source deals through various centers of influence.
  • Computer proficiency in Microsoft Office applications including; Word, Excel, and Teams.
  • Demonstrates a strong ability to build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders by communicating clearly, engaging in proactive collaboration, and leveraging cross functional insights. Aligns relationship building efforts with enterprise goals to accelerate performance and drive strategic results.
  • Builds trusted client relationships, whether internal or external, by identifying needs and delivering tailored solutions to enhance the overall client experience.
  • Travel will be required as necessary.

If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

This is a developmental territory management & production underwriting role focused on Middle Market accounts across the Manufacturing, Wholesale/Distribution, Real Estate, Retail, and Food Service industry segments. You will own a defined renewal book and new business goal, with personal underwriting authority and accountability for profitable results, and a targeted promotional path into the Territory Manager level.


This is a Work-From-Home (WFH) position involving both virtual and occasional in-person travel to key agency partners.


Territory: Northern & Southern California Metros, including the Bay Area, Los Angeles, and Orange County.


Preferably, this Associate Territory Manager will be based in California or a bordering state, though other locations within the Pacific time zone can be considered.


Minimum qualifications:

  • Multi-line commercial insurance underwriting experience, including underwriting authority
  • A passion for driving profitable growth through agency engagement

Preferred qualifications:

  • Underwriting experience with accounts larger than 100k in DWP
  • Industry segment experience in Manufacturing, Wholesale/Distribution, Real Estate, Retail, and/or Food Service & Accommodation
  • Insurance designations or coursework, such as CPCU, CIC, or AU

The internal title for this role is "Associate Territory Manager, Middle Market Business Development - Commercial Lines"


This role does not qualify for employer-sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the Stem OPT Extension program.


Job Description Summary

On our team, we look for that rare professional who is both analytical and a relationship-builder. Those who can combine those talents with their entrepreneurial drive and own and manage their territory can thrive and grow with us. If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, we want to hear from you!

As an Associate Territory Manager, you'll be the primary relationship manager for middle market new and renewal business, through direct contact with a territory of select agencies or brokers. We'll count on you to drive profit and premium to meet financial goals and objectives through development, negotiation and execution of business plans. Your leadership and influencing skills will be key as you help agencies create and implement sales strategies, processes and practices that drive new sales, increase shelf space, profit and member retention. Your collaboration with internal partners will be important to support and increase the overall Nationwide presence.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Underwrites new business, renewals and endorsements based on authority level and appetite. Decisions at this level may require review of additional variables, leveraging agency, sales and underwriting relationships, inspection reports and evaluation of exceptions.

  • Reviews individual risks for acceptability and handles those within authority based on company underwriting guidelines and standards. Analyzes quality and quantity of risks underwritten and prepares reports accordingly. May review agency books of business as well as profit/growth results and trends to recommend and implement action plans. May perform portfolio analysis or additional underwriting analysis in support of unit objectives.

  • Monitors market conditions, competitive landscape, and confirms information gathered within market space. Researches risk, environment and factors necessary to win the account.

  • Achieves production, profitability and service objectives. Quotes, prices and underwrites new and renewal policies and endorsements, primarily for complex or service sensitive accounts. Monitors risk selection and pricing decisions for entire agency plant, both on a book of business and individual account level basis.

  • Manages workflow and intricacies of underwriting assigned work by utilizing company tools and systems. Ensures file handling quality and workflow efficiency. Manages large, complex work and coordinates work with and through others to meet service level agreements. Effectively influences activities of Middle Market Business Development Team to facilitate the successful delivery and execution of select agency business plans.

  • Completes agency visits as appropriate to develop new accounts, service existing accounts, review agency performance, enhance agency relationship and to develop business solutions. Consults with agencies regarding risk management and coverage options to improve retention and profitability. Develops and maintains strong business relationships with agencies, producers and key groups. Effectively communicates with agencies to establish the company as the provider of choice for the territory for all enterprise products with an emphasis on commercial lines. Communicates product, technology changes and company objectives. Communicates and collaborates actively with team members and leadership to share industry trends, and field underwriting experience.

  • Drives robust agency business planning to deliver detailed performance plans with actions, account abilities and scheduled performance checkpoints. Ensures strong territorial objectives to maximize profit and pipeline management. Proactively identifies opportunities for all lines of business and refers to appropriate business leaders. Plans and coordinates the efforts of the Middle Market Business Development Team regarding new business, renewals, service plans, etc. Identifies prospects and recommends new agency appointments.

  • Markets Nationwide products and services to help drive agency and company results, including all enterprise products that may enhance offerings. Assists agency with strategies for pipeline management, producer development and to develop new business in targeted industries and preferred markets. Responds effectively to assess accounts and develop business propositions that win the business.

  • Leads delivery of appropriate customer service levels. Follows up and ensures proper handling of escalated customer service requests.

  • Ensures that tools, training and support are in place to positively impact success for the agencies and territory. Identifies and communicates training needs and opportunities. Participates in program and product orientation meetings in conjunction with Sales/Marketing partners as the underwriting subject matter expert.

  • Monitors business plan results to determine performance and development of any action plans to ensure alignment with underwriting philosophies, standards and performance expectations. Reviews business in process, lost business and drives implementation of business plan. Leads discussion for assigned agents in agency reviews.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to MM Business Development Director. Individual contributor.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate degree in business administration or management preferred. Technical insurance coursework toward designations of CPCU, CLU, FLMI, etc. is desirable.

Experience: Three years Commercial Lines underwriting experience required, additional sales experience preferred. Successful completion of the first phase (training) of the Associate Territory Manager role required.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Ability to manage heavy workload effectively and backup other team members as needed. Thorough working knowledge of commercial underwriting, pricing and coverage for commercial business. Knowledge of company sales and underwriting standards and practices company commercial products and programs. Knowledge of state statutes and regulations. Excellent interpersonal and sales skills. Ability to build and maintain cooperative and mutually rewarding internal and external partnerships. Must have the ability to perform duties with independent judgment with underwriting authority and company underwriting standards. Demonstrated decision-making ability required in day-to-day operations where there may be unclear or competing priorities, including evaluating and recommending solutions to customer service, work processing, underwriting selection and rating and best practices compliance. Strong drive for results.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)

Working Conditions: Heavy travel with extended stays may be required. Most incumbents work from a remote location. A valid drivers license and safe driving record are required.

ADA: The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some people assigned to the job to perform a somewhat different combination of duties.

Benefits

We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision,life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. To learn more about the benefits we offer,click here.

Nationwide is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where everyone feels challenged, appreciated, respected and engaged. Nationwide prohibits discrimination and harassment and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to any characteristic (or classification) protected by applicable law.


NOTE TO EMPLOYMENT AGENCIES:

We value the partnerships we have built with our preferred vendors. Nationwide does not accept unsolicited resumes from employment agencies. All resumes submitted by employment agencies directly to any Nationwide employee or hiring manager in any form without a signed Nationwide Client Services Agreement on file and search engagement for that position will be deemed unsolicited in nature. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is subsequently hired as a result of the referral or through other means.

Nationwide pays on a geographic-specific salary structure and placement within the actual starting salary range for this position will be determined by a number of factors including the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; the scope, complexity and location of the role as well as the cost of labor in the market; and other conditions of employment. If a Sales job, Sales Incentives, based on performance goals are possible in addition to this range.
