raw.description:
Technical Project Manager

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Technical Project Manager at 321, you will serve as the strategic leader responsible for planning, executing, and delivering complex technical projects including custom website development, enterprise system integrations, CRM implementations, and proprietary platform builds. You'll bridge the gap between technical teams and business stakeholders, translating strategic objectives into detailed technical requirements while managing timelines, budgets, and cross-functional resources to ensure successful delivery.

This role sits at the intersection of technical expertise, project leadership, documentation excellence, and AI-powered development methodologies. You'll bring deep understanding of software development lifecycles alongside proven ability to manage complex technical implementations. Your proficiency in AI-assisted development combined with strong technical writing skills will enable you to create comprehensive requirements documentation, guide development teams through AI-enhanced workflows, and deliver sophisticated solutions that leverage cutting-edge technologies. As part of an AI-first organization, you'll champion AI development practices, ensuring projects utilize intelligent tools to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and maintain competitive advantage.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Technical Project Planning & Execution

  • Own end-to-end project management for complex technical initiatives including custom website development, CRM integrations, API development, and proprietary platform builds like 321 AIM.
  • Develop comprehensive project plans including scope definition, technical architecture, resource allocation, timeline milestones, risk management, and budget tracking.
  • Lead technical discovery sessions with clients and internal stakeholders to understand business requirements, technical constraints, and success criteria.
  • Translate business objectives into detailed technical specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria that guide development teams.
  • Manage project budgets and timelines, tracking actuals against estimates and proactively addressing variances to protect profitability.
  • Coordinate resources across development, design, Client Success, and external vendors to ensure seamless collaboration and delivery.
  • Facilitate agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

Technical & Functional Requirements Documentation

  • Create comprehensive technical requirements documents (TRDs) that define system architecture, data models, API specifications, integration patterns, and technical constraints.
  • Write detailed functional requirements documents (FRDs) that describe user workflows, business logic, interface requirements, and acceptance criteria.
  • Document system integrations including API endpoints, authentication methods, data mapping, error handling, and testing procedures.
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate documentation creation, ensure completeness, and maintain consistency across technical specifications.
  • Develop user stories, use cases, and process flows that communicate requirements clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Create data flow diagrams, system architecture diagrams, wireframes, and technical specifications using industry-standard tools and notation.
  • Maintain living documentation that evolves throughout the project lifecycle, capturing decisions, changes, and lessons learned.
  • Ensure documentation meets compliance requirements for regulated industries including HIPAA, SOC 2, and data privacy standards.

AI-Powered Development Leadership

  • Champion AI-assisted development methodologies using platforms like Replit, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI-powered coding tools.
  • Guide development teams in leveraging AI for code generation, debugging, testing, documentation, and optimization to accelerate delivery cycles.
  • Architect solutions that integrate AI capabilities including natural language processing, machine learning models, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation.
  • Evaluate and implement AI development tools and platforms that improve team productivity, code quality, and project outcomes.
  • Define AI-specific requirements including model selection, training data needs, accuracy thresholds, and performance benchmarks.
  • Stay current on AI development trends, frameworks, and best practices, sharing knowledge with technical teams and stakeholders.
  • Assess technical feasibility of AI features, balancing innovation with practical constraints including cost, complexity, and time-to-market.

Website Development & CMS Projects

  • Manage custom website development projects from discovery through launch including design, development, content migration, and deployment.
  • Oversee CMS implementations and customizations across platforms including WordPress, HubSpot CMS, Webflow, and headless CMS solutions.
  • Define website requirements including information architecture, user experience flows, responsive design specifications, and performance targets.
  • Coordinate with Creative teams on design specifications, ensuring technical feasibility and maintaining design integrity through development.
  • Manage website integrations including CRM connections, marketing automation, analytics, payment processing, and third-party services.
  • Ensure websites meet accessibility standards (WCAG), SEO best practices, performance benchmarks, and security requirements.
  • Plan and execute website launches including DNS management, SSL certificates, quality assurance, and post-launch monitoring.

System Integrations & API Development

  • Lead complex integration projects connecting CRM platforms (HubSpot, Salesforce, High Level), marketing automation tools, and business systems.
  • Define integration requirements including data synchronization, real-time vs batch processing, error handling, and data validation rules.
  • Work with development teams to design and implement RESTful APIs, webhooks, and middleware solutions that enable seamless data flow.
  • Document API specifications including endpoints, authentication methods, request/response formats, rate limits, and error codes.
  • Manage third-party integrations and vendor relationships, ensuring SLAs are met and integration points remain stable.
  • Develop integration testing plans, coordinate QA activities, and validate data accuracy across connected systems.
  • Monitor integration performance and reliability, addressing issues proactively and implementing improvements.

Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Develop comprehensive testing strategies including unit testing, integration testing, user acceptance testing, and performance testing.
  • Create detailed test plans and test cases that validate functionality against requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Utilize AI-powered testing tools for automated test generation, bug detection, and quality assurance at scale.
  • Coordinate UAT sessions with clients and stakeholders, managing feedback and ensuring issues are resolved before launch.
  • Identify and manage project risks including technical constraints, resource availability, third-party dependencies, and scope creep.
  • Implement change management processes that assess impact, maintain scope control, and protect project timelines and budgets.
  • Ensure projects meet security standards, compliance requirements, and data protection regulations relevant to regulated industries.

Stakeholder Communication & Leadership

  • Serve as primary point of contact for technical project communication with clients, internal teams, and external vendors.
  • Lead client meetings including kickoffs, status updates, demo sessions, and strategic planning discussions.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into business language that non-technical stakeholders can understand and act upon.
  • Provide regular project status reporting including progress updates, milestone tracking, risk assessments, and budget reporting.
  • Facilitate decision-making when technical trade-offs arise, presenting options with clear pros, cons, and recommendations.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with clients through consistent delivery, proactive communication, and strategic guidance.
  • Mentor junior team members on project management methodologies, technical documentation, and AI development practices.

WHAT YOU HAVE

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project management, preferably managing web development, software projects, or system integrations in an agency or professional services environment.
  • Strong technical background with understanding of software development, system architecture, APIs, databases, and modern web technologies.
  • Deep expertise in AI-assisted development including hands-on experience with Replit, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar AI-powered development platforms.
  • Proven ability to write comprehensive technical and functional requirements documentation for AI-enhanced applications and intelligent systems.
  • Understanding of AI/ML concepts including model integration, training data requirements, API-based AI services, and practical AI implementation constraints.
  • Experience managing custom website development projects across various CMS platforms and modern web frameworks.
  • Expertise with CRM platforms (HubSpot, Salesforce, High Level) including custom integrations, API development, and complex implementations.
  • Strong understanding of API design, RESTful services, authentication protocols, data modeling, and integration patterns.
  • Proficiency with project management methodologies including Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid approaches.
  • Advanced skills in technical documentation including technical specifications, system architecture diagrams, data flow diagrams, and API documentation.
  • Experience with project management tools (ClickUp, Jira, Asana, or similar) and documentation platforms (Confluence, Notion, or similar).
  • Understanding of web security, HTTPS, authentication, data encryption, and compliance requirements for regulated industries (HIPAA, SOC 2).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and identify root causes.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to facilitate meetings, build consensus, and influence stakeholders.
  • Experience with AI-powered project management and documentation tools that accelerate planning, requirements gathering, and delivery.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage project budgets, track profitability, and make decisions that balance quality with financial constraints.
  • Experience working with regulated industries including healthcare, legal services, or financial services is highly valued.
  • Proficiency with version control systems (Git), CI/CD concepts, and modern development workflows.
  • PMP, CSM, CSPO, or similar project management certification is a plus.
  • Continuous learner who stays current on AI development tools, project management trends, and emerging technologies.
  • Self-motivated leader who can drive projects forward without direct authority over technical resources.
  • Detail-oriented with exceptional organizational skills and ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.

REPORTING STRUCTURE

This position reports to the SVP of Strategy. This position coordinates technical resources across development, Creative, Digital, and Client Success teams.

Salary: $75,000-$90,000 (negotiable based on experience)

Location: Remote within the United States or Canada (East Coast or Central time zones preferred)

About Us

At Kubermatic, we believe that businesses should focus on their core purpose: writing groundbreaking applications, not operations. In line with our commitment to make Kubernetes as easy as possible, we help IT teams worldwide to fully automate their Kubernetes and cloud native operations across multi-cloud, edge, and on-prem.

As one of the top corporate contributors to the Kubernetes project, we develop enterprise-grade software solutions and provide professional services and support to safely navigate and accelerate your cloud native transformation. Our open-source Kubermatic Kubernetes Platform makes it easy to operate thousands of Kubernetes clusters on any infrastructure.

If you are thrilled by the prospect of joining a technology start-up with a lot of room for your own ideas and personal growth, we definitely should at least have a chat.

Role Overview

As an Account Executive for North America, you will play a key role in expanding Kubermatic’s footprint across the US and Canada. You will own the full sales cycle - from prospecting and qualification to closing - and work closely with our technical, product, and marketing teams to help customers adopt modern Kubernetes and cloud‑native automation at scale.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a high‑ownership environment, understands the cloud‑native landscape, and enjoys working with engineering‑driven customers who value open source, automation, and platform engineering excellence.

What You Will Do

  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of enterprise and mid‑market prospects across North America.
  • Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, qualification, discovery, solution positioning, negotiation, and closing.
  • Understand customer challenges around Kubernetes operations, platform engineering, multi‑cloud, and on‑prem automation, and position Kubermatic’s solutions accordingly.
  • Work closely with Sales Engineering to run demos, technical deep dives, and proof‑of‑concept engagements.
  • Develop account strategies, stakeholder maps, and clear action plans for key opportunities.
  • Collaborate with our partner ecosystem (cloud providers, MSPs, integrators) to drive joint opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate forecasts, pipeline hygiene, and activity tracking in the CRM.
  • Represent Kubermatic at industry events, conferences, and community activities across North America.
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering to help shape our roadmap based on customer needs.

What You Bring

  • Experience in enterprise or solution sales in the US market, ideally in cloud, infrastructure, DevOps, or open‑source technologies.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding quota in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of modern cloud‑native concepts (Kubernetes, containers, DevOps, GitOps, automation).
  • Ability to navigate complex technical environments and multi‑stakeholder buying processes.
  • Experience working with Sales Engineering and technical teams in a consultative sales motion.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems and modern sales tools.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate technical value into business outcomes.
  • High degree of autonomy, ownership, and comfort working in a distributed, international team.
  • Located in the United States with eligibility to work without sponsorship.

About the team

Banks need flexibility in how they fund international payments, settle with Wise and convert currencies. Our Cash Management team builds the products that give them that control and make Wise work for more partners and their customers.

The problems are concrete. How can a bank lock in an exchange rate today and provide the funds later? How can it send payments first and settle with Wise afterward? We build the capabilities behind those choices, helping partners manage their cash around the needs of their business.

We’re a small, growing team developing new products in a domain with plenty to learn and shape. You’ll have a meaningful say in how we solve customer problems, design our systems and maintain engineering quality as we grow. The work combines product development with the challenge of building dependable services that move money across systems.

You’ll work closely with product managers, partner banks and engineers across Wise whose systems handle accounts, incoming payments and liquidity. Together, you’ll understand partner needs, agree how those systems fit together and turn complex requirements into practical products.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Engineer who enjoys understanding a customer’s problem, designing a solution and taking responsibility for how it performs in production.

This is a hands-on role with substantial ownership. You’ll have the autonomy to move work forward, alongside colleagues who contribute through shared design, reviews and pairing.

You will:

  • Own solutions from problem to production. Work with product managers and engineers to understand partner needs, shape the approach, and design, build, test and operate backend services.

  • Make thoughtful technical decisions. Explain tradeoffs clearly and balance delivery time, reliability and maintainability, including when the information available is incomplete.

  • Build across system boundaries. Work with other teams to agree clear interfaces and understand how changes affect the wider payment journey.

  • Improve the systems you operate. Strengthen testing and observability, diagnose production issues, and use what you learn to make services more dependable.

  • Help the team succeed. Contribute across workstreams, share domain knowledge and help other engineers grow through reviews, pairing and mentoring.

Our backend stack includes Java, Spring Boot, Kafka and PostgreSQL. You’ll deepen your understanding of funding, settlement and currency conversion, using that knowledge to make better product and engineering decisions. As the team’s scope grows, there will be opportunities to take on broader technical ownership and influence how we build.

What will you be doing?

  • Design, develop, and maintain highly scalable services in Java and Spring Boot within a microservices architecture.

  • Apply domain-driven design to build robust, scalable solutions.

  • Lead development efforts in event-driven architectures using Kafka or similar messaging systems.

  • Architect, design, and optimise relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) to ensure performance and scalability.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support partner integrations and expand the Wise payment platform globally.

  • Participate in code reviews, champion best coding practices and mentor junior engineers.

We’re looking for:

  • Hands-on experience building or making substantial contributions to large-scale distributed systems.

  • Strong backend engineering experience, including relational databases, event-driven systems and proficiency in an object-oriented language.

  • A product mindset: you can explain the customer problems behind your work, why your solution matters and how you assess whether it helps.

  • The ability to take ownership with a high degree of autonomy, make progress through ambiguity and involve others when their expertise is needed.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills. You can explain technical decisions, work effectively across teams and contribute to your colleagues’ success.

  • Curiosity about the business domain and a willingness to learn how our partners use the products you build.

Useful additional experience includes:

  • Java, Spring Boot, Kafka or PostgreSQL.

  • Payments, financial technology, funding, settlement or foreign exchange.

  • Using product metrics and data to understand customer behaviour and guide decisions.

You can learn our technologies and banking domain here. If you bring the core engineering experience, ownership and curiosity described above, we’d like to hear from you.

raw.description:
Who is Credible?

Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score. On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.

About the Role:

Credible is looking for an AI-native Principal Product Manager to take ownership of our personal loans lending marketplace, our largest marketplace. You will own and deliver features from ideation to launch alongside design, engineering, and data. Primarily you'll focus on the front-end experience that helps consumers discover and compare options across multiple lenders.

This role requires AI fluency in both how you work and what you build. In your workflow, you bring working concepts rather than documents describing them, using AI tools like Claude to prototype ideas, run your own analysis, and validate concepts before committing engineering resources.You bring the experience and rigor to know which few ideas are worth building, and the drive to see them through.

In the product itself, you will shape how Credible reaches users as loan discovery moves beyond the comparison page and into AI assistants and embedded experiences, and you will determine where AI belongs within our own funnel to make comparing and choosing a loan simpler. Where AI touches the product, you own the quality bar: defining what good output looks like, measuring it, and ensuring it stays accurate and compliant.

Teams will look to you and your product leadership to guide the vision and direction of the product and achieve team OKRs.

The role is full-time and compensation will be based on experience.

Responsibilities:

  • Think Strategically and Creatively: Deliver new features for growing the personal loans marketplace and align them with Credible's long-term vision. Synthesize market trends, regulatory shifts in the personal loan space, user needs, and rapidly advancing AI capabilities to continually reinvent the platform, including how it reaches users beyond our own site.
  • Own AI-Powered Product Surfaces: Shape how Credible helps consumers discover and choose loans through AI assistants, embedded experiences, and AI-assisted flows within our own funnel. Decide where AI meaningfully improves the experience and where it doesn't belong.
  • Own the Roadmap: Manage the roadmap for personal loans by identifying opportunities in the industry and within our own funnel, weighing tradeoffs, and prioritizing team resources. Decide not only what to build, but what to remove.
  • Prototype and Validate: Use AI tools like Claude to build working concepts, test them quickly, and validate ideas with real artifacts. Explore many approaches, and find the ones that resonate with users and lenders.
  • Make Data-Driven Decisions: Utilize data analysis, A/B testing, and user research to validate assumptions, uncover insights, and drive meaningful improvements to the business. Run your own queries and analysis rather than depending on others for every question.
  • Lead and Collaborate Across Functions: Proactively engage cross functional teams to brainstorm innovative solutions and lead their implementation. Collaborate with engineering, design, data, partnerships, and operations teams to deliver product enhancements and achieve team OKRs.
  • Operate Responsibly in a Regulated Space: Personal loans lending is compliance-constrained. Understand where AI-assisted work and AI-generated output need human review, where claims and disclosures matter, and how to move fast without creating regulatory or trust risk.

Education and Experience:

  • At least 7 - 10 years of experience in a Product Management role for web-based consumer Internet products
  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Deep, demonstrated fluency using AI tools in your actual workflow for prototyping, analysis, research synthesis, and writing, with a clear point of view on where they help and where they don't
  • Genuine interest in and ideas about building AI-powered product experiences, not just using AI to work faster
  • Ability to bring working concepts to life, whether through AI tooling, light coding, or strong partnership with engineering
  • Familiarity with how to evaluate AI output quality, or clear aptitude and appetite to own it
  • Ability to use data, your experience, and product instincts to identify the most impactful areas of focus, including running your own analysis
  • Strong analytical abilities across spreadsheets, SQL, and other analytics tools
  • Exceptional problem solving and communication skills
  • Strong project management skills, and willingness/ability to own critical parts of the product, end-to-end
  • Thrive on collaboration with other teams to accomplish shared goals
  • Technical aptitude sufficient to work closely with engineers, evaluate implementation approaches, and weigh cost/benefit tradeoffs
  • A bias toward experimentation and the discipline to walk away from your own ideas when the evidence says so

Why work at Credible?

We combine the intelligence, expertise, and confidence of a financial advisor with the approachability and honesty of a friend. In other words, we’re the friend you always wish you had in finance.

We are optimistic, challengers, trustworthy, clever, and smart. We are open and transparent. We strive to act as advisors by being friendly, objective, and open in our communication. We use language that is intelligent yet approachable. When appropriate, we’ll drop in a bit of wit to position ourselves as a fresh, reliable voice in the financial world.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

The Territory Manager role is ideal for a results-driven sales professional who enjoys building strong customer relationships, growing existing accounts, and uncovering new business opportunities within an assigned region. This position is well suited to candidates with experience in territory sales, channel sales, distributor management, or contractor-facing business development, particularly within building materials, construction products, manufacturing, or related industries.

In this role, you will be responsible for driving profitable sales growth, achieving or exceeding territory targets, and strengthening brand presence in the market. You will work closely with customers and channel partners to deliver clear, value-based product guidance, identify opportunities for expansion, and position solutions that support their business needs.

*This role is remote and open to candidates based in North Carolina, South Carolina, or Eastern Tennessee.

What You'll Do:

  • Grow and retain existing accounts by understanding customer needs, recommending solutions, and building long-term relationships.

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the territory.

  • Analyze market trends, customer insights, and competitor activity to inform sales strategy.

  • Conduct joint sales calls with customers, partners, and prospects.

  • Deliver product demonstrations, installations, and hands-on training.

  • Serve as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams.

  • Maintain accurate customer records and complete required reporting (e.g., sales activity, expenses, service/quality).

  • Support sales planning, including budgets and forecasts.

  • Represent the company within local industry and trade organizations.

  • Communicate company service guidelines and ensure customer understanding.

  • Develop strong product and market knowledge, including competitive offerings.

  • Build strategic partnerships by aligning with partners’ business goals and capabilities.

  • Develop and execute annual business plans with key partners, including regular performance reviews.

What You'll Need:

Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing or related field

Experience:

  • Minimum five (5) years of successful sales experience, preferably in the Building Materials industry

  • Experience in the Commercial & Industrial market preferred

  • Experience selling through distribution required

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of the building and construction industry and sales principles

  • Experience using ERP/CRM systems, such as Bridge or Salesforce

  • Ability to develop and execute practical, results-driven sales strategies

  • Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills

  • Able to build relationships, collaborate effectively, and support customers and colleagues

  • Strong decision-making, follow-up, and problem-solving skills

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • Comfortable working in both industrial/manufacturing and corporate settings, as needed

  • Proficient in Word, Excel and PowerPoint

raw.description:
A.I.S., Inc. (AIS) is a national scientific services firm supporting maritime activities requiring certification of compliance with environmental regulations as well as collecting data for use by Federal, State, Municipal, and other government agencies along the US coastline. AIS is looking for a Program Analyst to support the NOAA Fisheries, Alaska Region Fisheries Disaster Support Services program.

Primary Function:

The Fisheries Disaster Program Analyst supports NOAA Fisheries, Alaska Region in evaluating fishery disaster requests submitted under Section 312(a) of the Magnuson-Stevens Act. Working under the Regional Fishery Disaster Assistance Lead, the analyst reviews requests for completeness, coordinates with requesting states, tribes, and government entities, evaluates complete packages against established policy methodology, and drafts decision memos to support a determination by the Secretary of Commerce. The role also builds and maintains the tracking tools, templates, and file systems used to manage Alaska fishery disasters from declaration through grant close-out.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Provide program management support to the Regional Fishery Disaster Assistance Lead (Lead).
  • Serve as the point of contact for requesting entities from initial receipt of a request through the final decision and funding; answer questions and refer items outside the contractor’s scope to the Lead.
  • Review each disaster request against the required information in MSA Section 312(a); notify the requestor’s staff contact of any missing or incomplete information and inform the Lead by email of the deficiencies.
  • Evaluate complete request packages using the methodology in the Headquarters Policy Guidance, and notify the Lead when commencing review.
  • Draft decision memos on agreed-upon templates for the Lead’s review, incorporate requested edits, and update memos with the Lead’s recommended decision.
  • Serve as the initial point of contact for staff questions during the Headquarters and Region clearance process, working with the Lead as appropriate.
  • Develop an annotated Alaska fishery disaster request template that can be shared with requesters.
  • Build and maintain a database of Alaska fishery disasters to track multi-year disasters and grants, and monitor state, federal, and Pacific States Marine Fisheries Commission websites for related disaster-relief information.
  • Create and maintain a file management system for Alaska disasters spanning declaration through grant close-out.
  • Prepare annual reports on pending and approved Alaska fishery disasters and develop spend plans for leadership.
  • Submit monthly progress reports (accomplishments, issues encountered, and recommendations) and monthly invoices by the 15th of the following month.

Compensation: Candidates will be paid an hourly rate to be negotiated, and total compensation will vary depending on candidates’ depth of experience. This is a full–time position. AIS benefits package includes health and dental insurance, vacation, sick and holiday benefits.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Experience in program planning and management in a team environment.
  • Experience reviewing and evaluating basic quantitative data, such as population size data, and basic economic data.
  • Policy analysis experience and the ability to evaluate specific data and information against required standards.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Established skills with spreadsheet and word processing software, including current MS Office and Google Workspace (Google Office Suite) skills.
  • Proficiency with online seminar software such as Google Meet or Webex.
  • Ability to follow established procedures to accomplish specific tasks.
  • Must complete a background investigation prior to beginning work and be able to obtain a PIV/CAC and a NOAA email account.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with salmon management, including analysis of data or management reports.

Travel:

  • No Travel

Location:

  • Remote (off-site).
Salary: $30-$35/hour

We are hiring a Sr Architecture Governance Analyst at BCBST!

Join our Strategy and Architecture team and play a key role in how AI is evaluated, governed, and adopted across the organization. In this role, you will own and evolve AI governance workflows, coordinate complex reviews and approvals, and bring together technology, procurement, compliance, and senior leaders to support effective oversight of AI technologies and AI-enabled solutions. You’ll have the opportunity to strengthen a governance process, connect it with related enterprise functions, and independently identify and drive improvements as AI adoption continues to evolve.

To be successful, you’ll bring strong process management and facilitation skills, a high degree of ownership and accountability, and the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders through complex workflows. Strong candidates will have broad enterprise technology knowledge, an understanding of AI concepts and technologies, experience engaging senior leadership, and a track record of improving governance or operational processes. Experience with compliance, audit, policy, or regulatory considerations within a large IT organization is preferred.


Note:

  • This is a remote, work-from-home position, but the final round of interviews will take place on-site in our Chattanooga, TN office.
  • The role is primarily aligned to Eastern Time business hours, approximately 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. ET.
  • Limited travel may be required as needed.
  • Sponsorship is not available for this role.



Job Responsibilities


  • Governance Design & Operating Model - Develops, implements, and continuously improves governance processes, operating models, decision frameworks, supporting tools, standards, and escalation paths for enterprise technology, AI enablement, and vendor evaluation activities.
  • Governance Forum Leadership - Organizes and facilitates governance forums, advisory groups, and working sessions by managing intake, agendas, stakeholder participation, decision documentation, and action follow-up.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination - Coordinates the review of technology, AI, and vendor-related initiatives across business, architecture, security, privacy, legal, compliance, procurement, and delivery stakeholders to ensure informed and timely decision-making.
  • Demand & Roadmap Management - Maintains an integrated view of demand, priorities, dependencies, risks, decisions, and outcomes; translates stakeholder needs into prioritized requirements and process improvements.
  • Change Enablement & Adoption - Creates and maintains playbooks, templates, training materials, and communications; promotes adoption of approved processes and capabilities.
  • Risk & Performance Oversight - Develops reporting, metrics, and management oversight practices to measure demand, adoption, value, process effectiveness, and risk; supports compliance with enterprise policies and standards.

Job Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in a Computer Science related field or equivalent work experience is required. Equivalent years of experience are determined as one year of technical experience for every year of college.

Experience

  • 5 years – Experience in enterprise technology, product or program operations, governance, risk, procurement, portfolio management, business analysis, or a related field required.
  • 3 years – Experience leading or facilitating cross-functional governance, product, intake, prioritization, vendor review, or technology decision processes required.
  • Experience with product management, Agile, governance, risk, procurement, architecture, responsible AI, or technology lifecycle practices preferred.
  • Experience performing technology governance and risk management, with demonstrated ability to translate requirements into practical workflows, decisions, and outcomes.

Skills / Certifications

  • Demonstrated expertise establishing and improving governance processes that support policy adherence, transparent decisions, and accountable execution.
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to explain and operationalize technology, AI, procurement, risk, and governance requirements.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills and business acumen to communicate complex technology, AI, procurement, policy, and governance topics to technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Ability to facilitate structured discussions, synthesize diverse input, document decisions, resolve ambiguity, and drive closure without relying on direct authority.
  • Ability to manage roadmaps, backlogs, intake queues, action registers, dashboards, and supporting work-management tools.
  • Agile mindset and working knowledge of Agile or product management methodologies

raw.description:
The Center for International Environmental Law (CIEL) is a dynamic, nonprofit organization that works at the intersection of human rights and the environment. CIEL is comprised of attorneys, campaigners, researchers, and communicators who have extensive experience in leading international strategies to advance everyone’s right to a healthy environment. Many of our program areas explore innovative developments in international environmental law and human rights, including in their direct link with other international legal fields, such as international investment law or international trade law.

In some circumstances, CIEL may be able to offer legal fellowships to recent law school graduates so they may gain experience in the field of international environmental law. Legal fellows typically work full or part-time, often receiving credit from their schools.

Responsibilities of a legal fellow include researching and writing about areas of international law and policy; assisting with policy analysis and advocacy; attending meetings and conferences; assisting with the production of CIEL publications; and otherwise working closely with CIEL staff on various projects.

Please note the following provisions:

  • Legal fellows must come with their own funding (often from a university, but can also be a third party or scholarship).
  • We cannot guarantee a future position for legal fellows at CIEL.
  • We cannot guarantee a particular area of focus or interest.

Requirements:

  • When submitting the application, applicants must have recently completed, or are in the final stages of completing, a graduate degree in law (e.g, LLM, JD). The expectation is that this fellowship will take place after graduation.
  • Applicants must be willing to make a commitment of at least three months.
  • Successful applicants generally possess excellent research and writing skills and a strong dedication to public interest law.

FAQ:

  • May I undertake my internship remotely (US)?All CIEL Fellowships in the United States may be carried out remotely. Please note that we can only consider applicants for this US fellowship who will carry out their internship while physically residing in and working from the United States. Remote work from other countries cannot be accommodated. Fellows located in the Washington DC area may also work in a hybrid manner from our DC office.
  • May I undertake my internship remotely (Switzerland)?Fellowships with CIEL’s Geneva office may take place remotely if residing in and working from Switzerland; depending on space considerations, they may also be able to take place in a hybrid manner in our Geneva office.
  • Will CIEL sponsor a visa for me? CIEL in the United States is unable to sponsor visas. CIEL's Geneva location may be able to sponsor a student visa for you depending on your nationality/citizenship.
  • What should I submit as a writing sample?Feel free to submit something that you feel demonstrates your writing ability, preferably relevant to CIEL's work but that is not a requirement. This can include undergraduate work.

If you have further questions or need assistance, please contact .

HR Administration (approx. 60%)

raw.excerpt: About Us:Zepto is building the beating heart of Australia's real-time, account-to-account payments revolution.
raw.description:
About Us:

Zepto is building the beating heart of Australia's real-time, account-to-account payments revolution.

We're a rapidly-scaling business reimagining how money moves for some of Australia's largest merchants, organisations and payment platforms – disrupting a market that's been overdue for change for decades. This ambition has seen us recognised as FinTech Organisation of the Year at the Finnies Awards. Twice.

For passionate, action-oriented people, this ambition means genuine opportunity: to build category-defining infrastructure, own hard problems, and grow a career at the pace of the business around you. This isn't incremental work – it's the kind of experience that changes the trajectory of a career.

We believe in the power of positive human experiences, and that a deep sense of belonging creates cohesion in our culture. Even as a remote-first team, you'll be a contributor and custodian of that culture, solving complex problems alongside talented people who are just as driven to help us deliver on our brand promise and build 'a better way to pay' at Zepto.

About the Role:

Reporting to the Head of Solutions and Customer Success, as a Senior Solutions Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of engineering, product and sales - the technical backbone of our sales cycle and the trusted advisor our merchants and partners turn to for an end-to-end payments experience.

This is a hands-on, client-facing role built around technical pre-sales, solution design and integration consultation. You'll need real expertise in payments technology - how currency and data move through APIs, webhooks, settlement rails and reconciliation flows - and the ability to translate that complexity into a solution that a merchant's CTO, CFO and engineering team can all get behind.

You'll lead technical discovery, design and present tailored solutions, run proofs of concept, and own the technical thread from first conversation through to a live, successful integration. Your work directly shapes whether prospects convert, and whether customers see the value of our technology once they're live.

Working in a scale-up means you get the opportunity to flex your skills in a variety of ways. We are agile and always willing to roll up our sleeves to get things done. You can, however, expect your day to day to be involved in the following:

  • Own technical pre-sales end to end; leading discovery, scope alignment, gap analysis and solution design from first conversation through to signed deal and handover to delivery.
  • Architect payments solutions across Zepto's API and product suite; payment initiation, PayTo/PayID, direct debit, disbursements, reconciliation, webhooks - solving each merchant's specific technical constraints.
  • Run technical workshops and demos for technical and non-technical stakeholders alike, adapting the story to whoever's in the room.
  • Own the technical content of RFPs, RFIs and tenders, partnering with Commercial on positioning and competitive differentiation.
  • Be the technical voice in the sales cycle, fielding deep questions on APIs, integration patterns, compliance and security in real time.
  • Prototype and validate; building sandbox integrations and testing API flows to prove feasibility before a merchant commits engineering resources.
  • Bridge sales and product, feeding real merchant requirements and competitive gaps back into the roadmap.
  • Support technical delivery handover, making sure what's sold is what's built and customers are set up for a smooth go-live.

About You:

You're a technical pre-sales pro who can hold your own in front of an engineering team in the morning and a CFO in the afternoon. Specifically, we'd welcome any candidate who has:

  • 3+ years' experience in pre-sales, solutions engineering or solution architecture, ideally supporting technical sales cycles.
  • Strong, demonstrable payments experience; payment rails, gateways, settlement and reconciliation - ideally with exposure to the Australian landscape (NPP, PayTo, PayID, BECS, card schemes) or equivalent overseas. Time at a payments company, fintech, bank or PSP is highly valued.
  • Genuine comfort in the technical weeds of APIs - reading docs, constructing and debugging REST calls, interpreting JSON, and reasoning through webhook and event-driven patterns without needing an engineer to translate.
  • A track record in technical pre-sales specifically - running discovery, scoping integrations, presenting to technical and executive audiences, and responding to tenders. You sell the "how" as convincingly as the "why".
  • A tertiary qualification in computer science or a related field, or the equivalent built through 3+ years hands-on with code, APIs or technical systems.
  • Strong project management instincts - comfortable juggling multiple live deals and stakeholders without dropping the ball.
  • A self-directed streak and comfort with ambiguity - you're energised by startup pace and go looking for the process improvement rather than waiting for someone else to find it.

Why Zepto?

Headquartered in beautiful Byron Bay, Zepto has an inspiring founder story and is a customer-focused, culture-first organisation. You’ll be joining a team that champions curiosity and a pioneering perspective, and thrives in a fast-moving sector.

Just some of Zepto’s commitments to it’s people include:

  • Join a Talented Team: Work with world-class talent and leaders who support career growth
  • Flexible Work: A remote-first work culture, with the opportunity to work anywhere in Australia. You’ll also get access to premium co-working spaces and a Byron, Sydney & Melbourne Hub
  • Paid Parental Leave: 12 weeks Paid Parental Leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers
  • Wellbeing Focus: Access to Zepto’s Wellbeing Menu, which includes 3 x paid Wellbeing Days per year and access to an Employee Assistance Program
  • Annual Learning Budget: An individual learning budget, and 4 x paid Growth & Impact Days annually to focus on professional development
  • Remote-Work Support: A $500 Remote Work Budget to set up your home office upon commencement, and $300 annually from your 2nd Zeptoversary

Please note:As an organisation in the financial services industry, we conduct background checks as part of our recruitment process.

raw.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Dans ce rôle de Program Manager, vous pilotez plusieurs équipes techniques, coordonnez les parties prenantes et assurez la gestion des projets liés au domaine IT judiciaire. Vous prenez en charge la planification, la priorisation, le suivi d’avancement et le reporting, tout en coordonnant les chefs de projet concernés.

La fonction combine une dimension managériale et une implication technique forte. Vous faites référence pour les équipes sur les sujets d’architecture, d’infrastructure, d’intégration et de déploiement continu. Les décisions clés sont préparées avec l’appui du comité de pilotage.

Vous encadrez des équipes aux profils variés, actives à la fois sur le développement d’applications, la modernisation du parc existant et la mise en place ou la maintenance des infrastructures IT. Ces équipes couvrent notamment les applications historiques, les nouvelles solutions logicielles, les systèmes, les réseaux, le stockage de données et les pratiques DevOps.

Vous intervenez dans un environnement lié aux activités de police judiciaire et au traitement de dossiers sensibles, avec des enjeux élevés en matière de continuité, de sécurité et de coordination entre parties prenantes.

Missions principales

  • Prendre connaissance de l’existant et formuler des pistes techniques pour stabiliser certaines parties d’applications legacy.
  • Superviser la migration de fonctionnalités provenant d’autres solutions vers une application legacy de type client Windows lourd, en garantissant la compatibilité avec le socle technologique en place.
  • Veiller à l’intégration correcte des fonctionnalités migrées avec les autres modules applicatifs et les systèmes externes nécessaires à la collecte ou à l’échange de données.
  • Garantir la compatibilité des applications legacy avec les futures versions de Windows et la stabilité de leur exécution.
  • Encadrer l’équipe chargée de l’analyse de la nouvelle solution et contribuer activement à ses choix techniques.
  • Piloter les équipes responsables de l’implémentation d’une nouvelle solution web responsive.
  • Superviser les développements backend et frontend, ainsi que les tests unitaires et d’intégration.
  • S’assurer du versionnement correct du code source, de l’usage de Git et des bonnes pratiques associées, comme les branches, pull requests et code reviews.
  • Structurer et suivre la rédaction de la documentation technique par les équipes.
  • Encadrer les activités DevOps et la mise en place des pipelines de déploiement pour les applications, les services et l’infrastructure as code.
  • Superviser les équipes en charge de l’infrastructure, des réseaux, des systèmes, de l’intégration et du déploiement continu.
  • Accompagner des programmes de transformation numérique, notamment la modernisation d’applications et le passage d’un client lourd vers une application web moderne.
  • Veiller à l’intégration de la cybersécurité dès la conception, selon une approche security by design.
  • Suivre les aspects de modélisation logicielle à l’aide d’UML et BPMN.
  • Assurer un niveau de monitoring adapté avec des outils tels que Grafana et Prometheus.

📝 Votre profil

Vous êtes titulaire d’un bachelier en informatique et justifiez de plusieurs années d’expérience en développement logiciel, y compris dans des fonctions techniques, ainsi que d’une expérience dans une fonction similaire.

Vous avez une expérience confirmée en gestion de programme complexe, avec coordination de plusieurs projets et de multiples parties prenantes. Vous savez encadrer des équipes techniques hétérogènes et adapter votre style de management selon les personnes, les contextes et les priorités.

Vous êtes à l’aise dans un environnement Agile, en particulier Scrum. L’animation de Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-up, Review et Rétrospective fait partie de votre pratique quotidienne.

Sur le plan technique, vous disposez de bonnes connaissances en .NET (C#), appliquées notamment à des architectures microservices. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les API REST ou gRPC, les approches event driven et le développement d’applications web de type SPA dans une architecture micro-frontend, notamment avec Angular, ainsi qu’avec HTML et CSS.

Vous maîtrisez les mécanismes d’authentification via OpenID Connect et O365, côté backend comme côté frontend.

Vous avez une expérience confirmée en CI/CD et dans la mise en place de pipelines de déploiement avec GitLab. Vous maîtrisez également Kubernetes, Linux et les principes d’Infrastructure as Code. Une expérience en IaC constitue une plus-value importante.

Vous avez une bonne compréhension des enjeux de cybersécurité et de la mise en œuvre de solutions sécurisées. Une connaissance de la cryptographie est un atout.

Vous possédez également de bonnes bases en modélisation UML et BPMN, en monitoring avec Grafana ou Prometheus, ainsi qu’en bases de données relationnelles, notamment PostgreSQL.

Une expérience en Delphi et en développement d’applications Windows constitue un atout supplémentaire.

Vous communiquez clairement, savez fédérer des interlocuteurs techniques et non techniques, gardez le cap en contexte complexe et faites preuve d’initiative, de discernement et de sens des priorités. Vous êtes capable d’expliquer des concepts techniques à des non-spécialistes et de prendre en compte les dimensions humaines, organisationnelles et opérationnelles dans vos décisions.

Vous maîtrisez l’anglais ainsi qu’une des deux langues nationales. La connaissance active d’une langue nationale et au minimum passive de l’autre représente un avantage. La connaissance de l’environnement policier, et plus particulièrement du contexte de la police judiciaire, constitue un atout important.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

raw.excerpt: Job SummaryPosition SummaryWe are seeking Certified Pharmacy Technicians to support the Department of Veterans Affairs VISN 22 Clinical Contact Center (CCC) Pharmacy Service.
raw.description:
Job Summary

Position Summary

We are seeking Certified Pharmacy Technicians to support the Department of Veterans Affairs VISN 22 Clinical Contact Center (CCC) Pharmacy Service. As part of an interdisciplinary healthcare team, the Pharmacy Technician handles inbound pharmacy calls from Veterans, physicians, and other healthcare professionals, processing prescription requests and resolving medication-related inquiries with a focus on First Contact Resolution (FCR). This is a 100% remote position performed from an approved alternate worksite within 50 miles of the Albuquerque VA facility, using Government-furnished equipment.

Location: Remote – candidates must reside within a 50-mile radius of the New Mexico VA Health Care System, 1501 San Pedro Drive SE, Albuquerque, NM 87108

Position Type: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Anticipated Start: On or about September 16, 2026 (base year through September 15, 2027, plus one option year)

Schedule

  • The CCC operates 24/7/365; technician shifts vary between 6:00 AM and 11:00 PM Pacific Time based on staffing and workload needs.
  • Shifts are 8-hour tours with a minimum 12-hour rest period between shifts; work is limited to five days per week.
  • Weekend and holiday coverage may be required based on staffing needs.

Primary Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Process and submit patient requests for new prescriptions and renewals, including controlled substances, accurately and in a timely manner using approved CCC pharmacy protocols.
  • Answer telephone calls from patients, physicians, and healthcare professionals; use computerized prescription profiles to respond to inquiries within the technician scope of knowledge.
  • Document patient and staff interactions appropriately, including in the Computerized Patient Record System (CPRS) when required.
  • Respond to questions regarding expired, deleted, discontinued, or unavailable prescriptions; escalate professional-scope inquiries to a pharmacist.
  • Verify patient identity using two identifiers before communicating patient health information.
  • Meet national performance metrics and quality monitoring standards for inbound call management.
  • Follow pharmacy phone center scripting; handle, transfer, and hold calls efficiently and professionally.
  • Treat all Veterans with respect and dignity, resolving concerns at first contact whenever possible and referring to other VA resources as needed.
  • Seek assistance from Team Lead Technicians, pharmacists, or supervisors for unusual questions or unresolved caller concerns.
  • Maintain EHR access for all serviced sites and comply with all regulations governing access to computerized files.
  • Maintain active national pharmacy technician certification; complete additional duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active national certification as a Pharmacy Technician: PTCB Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT) or NHA Certified Pharmacy Technician (ExCPT). Certification must remain current and active throughout employment.
  • Graduate of an academic pharmacy technician training/educational program.
  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Minimum one (1) year of customer service-related experience.
  • Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English fluently (38 U.S.C. 7402(d), 7407(d)).
  • Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations.
  • Advanced typing and PC skills.
  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods (up to 8 hours), stoop, reach upward, and perform repetitive motions inherent to the role.

Pre-Employment & Compliance Requirements

  • Successful completion of VA fingerprinting, background investigation, and PIV sponsorship with two forms of approved photo ID prior to first day of work.
  • Credentialing through VetPro and approval by the VISN 22 facility boards (allow approximately 60 days for credentials review).
  • Proof of negative TB (PPD) test current within the past year (chest x-ray required if positive); repeated annually.
  • Proof of measles, mumps, and rubella immunization, or a rubella titer of 1.8 or greater.
  • Completion of all VA-mandated TMS training (e.g., Privacy & Information Security, HIPAA) prior to start and annually thereafter.
  • Must not appear on the HHS OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities.
  • Must meet all citizenship/work authorization requirements; employment is contingent on E-Verify.

Training & Equipment

  • An 80-hour onboarding/training period is provided to learn VA computer systems, processes, policies, and standards.
  • Government-furnished equipment provided: laptop, docking station, two monitors, keyboard, mouse, and PIV card.
  • Employee must maintain an approved alternate worksite suitable for remote patient-care work within 50 miles of the Albuquerque VA facility.

Physical Requirements

Physical Requirements: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods, use a computer keyboard and mouse, and communicate verbally and in writing. The employee may occasionally need to stand, walk, bend, or lift up to 15 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

About Aptive

Arrow ARC supports Veterans Health Administration facilities and offices across the U.S. with health care staffing and program support via the 10-year Integrated Critical Staffing Program (ICSP). We provide staffing solutions to address critical shortages in VHA medical facilities caused by turnover, recruitment issues, seasonal needs, surges or emergencies.

Arrow is a certified Service-Disabled, Veteran-Owned Small Business joint venture between Artemis ARC and Aptive Resources, two award-winning companies that share an agile, mission-focused, results driven approach in the federal sector.​ Arrow provides management consulting services and specializes in working with federal government agencies like the Department of Veterans Affairs and Office of Personnel Management.​

EEO Statement

raw.description:
About US

Founded in 2018, with employees across the world, The Block is the leading research, analysis, and news brand in the digital asset space. The Block's team spans 5 continents and 15+ time zones, covering the global cryptocurrency space 24/7. At The Block, we see digital assets as a ubiquitous part of the future. As this space continues to evolve, we view our role as the trusted moderator and authoritative voice for those who invest in, work with, make decisions about, or seek to understand digital assets. The Block delivers deep insight into how the emerging digital assets sector interacts with traditional finance, technology, governments, and markets. We reach hundreds of thousands of technologists, financial market participants, Fortune 500 professionals, global service providers, policymakers, and more through our main website, dedicated Research Portal, podcast, and events.

Why Join The Block

  • Shape the narrative of crypto education, media, and research
  • Join a company that's respected in the space and has the audience, platform, and reach to move markets
  • Work remotely with a high-performance team that values ownership, speed, and clarity
  • Be part of a business that's expanding beyond media into SaaS, certification, and enterprise offerings
  • Competitive comp, equity, and benefits package

About the role

  • We’re looking for a Strategic Partnerships Associate Director to help identify, develop, and manage high-impact partnerships across media, data, financial services, and the digital assets ecosystem. This is a single-threaded owner role reporting directly to the CEO and working closely with cross-functional teams to build relationships that expand The Block’s reach, strengthen its products, and create new commercial opportunities. You will shape partnership strategy from the top down and drive execution from the ground up — this is as much about running the weekly grind of a partnership as it is about setting its direction, turning strategic relationships into durable business outcomes.
  • You will help define where technical integration, commercial alignment, and joint go-to-market efforts can create the most value for The Block. You will develop a clear point of view, represent these partnerships with senior stakeholders, and personally drive the day-to-day work that spans multi-year planning and weekly execution — chasing down blockers, keeping work streams on track, and doing the detailed follow-through yourself rather than delegating it.

What you'll do

  • Serve as the primary owner and point of contact for our external partners, personally accountable for the direction, operating rhythm, and outcomes of each partnership, including the tactical work of keeping things moving week to week.
  • Develop and drive multi-year partnership strategies and joint plans that connect The Block's business priorities, product roadmap, and strategy with concrete partner initiatives — and then own getting those plans executed.
  • Build strong working relationships across partner organizations, including executives, media, branding, product management, engineering, sales, and marketing stakeholders.
  • Run a disciplined operating cadence across complex initiatives, with clear priorities, owners, timelines, coordination points, and follow-through you drive yourself.
  • Coordinate cross-functional work inside The Block to support partnership goals, aligning teams across editorial, research, media, product, engineering, sales, marketing, and the executive group.
  • Translate partner opportunities and requests into actionable internal plans, including roadmap discussions, integration needs, commercial motions, and executive recommendations.
  • Track and communicate measurable partnership outcomes such as pipeline influence, annual recurring revenue impact, integration progress, and joint go-to-market execution.
  • Represent the partnerships at the executive level by preparing clear recommendations, briefing executives, and helping drive alignment on investments, trade-offs, and next steps.

Tools we use: Slack, Google Analytics, OBS, Figma, Twitter/X Analytics, YouTube Studio, Wordpress…

What You’ll Bring

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • 3–4 years of experience building and managing strategic partnerships, business development relationships, or alliance programs with media, research, financial services, or crypto companies.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to operate as a single-threaded owner who is accountable for both strategy and execution, and comfortable doing the hands-on work personally rather than handing it off.
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders on high-visibility initiatives, including preparing executive briefings, framing recommendations, and driving follow-through.
  • Ability to assess opportunities and translate them into clear business plans and partnership proposals.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex partnership topics into clear recommendations for executives and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong project and program management skills, including the ability to organize complex workstreams, prioritize effectively, and keep multiple initiatives moving through direct, hands-on management.
  • Ability to influence without formal authority, build strong working relationships across internal and external teams, and navigate multiple priorities with sound judgment.
  • Highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment.

Bonus if you have:

  • Experience or strong knowledge of Wall Street, financial markets, institutional finance or digital assets.
  • Existing relationships across media, finance, data, or crypto industries.
  • MBA or other relevant advanced degree.

What Success Looks Like

After 3-6 months in this role, you will have:

  • Execute and formally launch 2 to 3 high-priority partnership initiatives within the first 6 months to significantly expand our brand visibility and or revenue opportunities.
  • Develop, present, and gain internal senior stakeholder approval on 2-3 comprehensive partnership business cases per quarter that align with our goals for market influence, thought leadership, audience growth and revenue goals.
  • Successfully advance at least 2 to 3 major partnership opportunities from the initial proposal phase through to final agreement negotiations within the first 6 months.

Work location & Authorization

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

This fully remote role is limited to candidates residing in the New York, New Jersey, or Connecticut tri-state area, within reasonable day-trip distance of NYC. The successful candidate should expect to travel into the city regularly for in-person client meetings, industry events, and team gatherings.

Compensation & Benefits

We offer competitive, location-based compensation.

Our total rewards include:

Remote work flexibility and office stipend

Paid time off (local holiday policies respected)

Health and wellness benefits (varies by location)

Flexible PTO

401(K)

Working Hours & Time Zones

This fully remote role is open only to candidates currently residing in New York, New Jersey, or Connecticut. The ideal candidate will be able to travel to New York City for in-person client meetings, industry events, and team gatherings frequently.
